title: Centimeter-scale fully suspended metal and metal oxide thin films by one-step transfer-free liquid metal capillary forming
summary: Fully suspended thin films can decouple substrate effects and provide additional tuning degrees of freedom compared with their substrate-supported counterparts, making them unique platforms for next-generation thin film devices. Here we report one-step, transfer-free and substrate-free fabrication of centimeter-scale ultrathin fully suspended metal and metal oxide film structures via liquid metal capillary forming. We show that, analogous to soap film formation, the instantaneously developed few-nanometer-thick native surface oxide can laminate various liquid metals into micrometer-thick metallic films. Surprisingly, the surfactant-like metal oxide bilayer can survive dewetting-induced liquid metal drainage, forming suspended two-dimensional films featuring an enormous lateral size-to-thickness ratio on the order of 10^7. We further demonstrate rapid prototyping of metallic minimal-surface thin-walled structures and ultra-sensitive acoustic wave detection with these suspended thin film platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了一种通过液态金属毛细力成形实现的一步法、无转移、无衬底制备厘米级超薄全悬浮金属及其氧化物薄膜结构的方法。类似于肥皂膜形成，金属表面瞬间形成的几纳米厚的原生氧化物可将液态金属层压成微米级金属薄膜，并能在去湿过程中存活，形成纵横比达10^7的悬浮二维薄膜，并展示了其在金属极小曲面薄壁结构快速原型制作和超高灵敏度声波检测方面的应用。
AI.motivation: 全悬浮薄膜能消除衬底效应并为器件提供额外调控自由度，是下一代薄膜器件的独特平台，但目前缺乏简单高效的制备方法。
AI.method: 利用液态金属表面瞬间生成的几纳米原生氧化物作为表面活性剂（类似肥皂膜形成的原理），通过毛细力成形实现一步法、无需转移和衬底的厘米级悬浮金属及金属氧化物薄膜制备。
AI.result: 成功制备了纵横比达10^7的悬浮二维金属薄膜，薄膜可在去湿诱导的液态金属排液过程中存活；并实现了金属极小曲面薄壁结构的快速原型制作以及超高灵敏度声波检测。
AI.conclusion: 液态金属毛细力成形是一种通用且高效的全悬浮薄膜制备策略，为下一代悬浮薄膜器件和传感应用开辟了新途径。

title: AC Field-driven orientational crossover and energy dissipation in suspended magnetic nanoparticles
summary: By combining the Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert equation with Brownian rotational dynamics of magnetic nanoparticles (MNPs), we theoretically investigate the role of particle rotation through easy-axis reorientation in magnetic fluid hyperthermia (MFH). Our results reveal a field-driven crossover in the stationary orientation of the easy axes, from predominantly perpendicular to predominantly parallel or antiparallel to the applied field as the field amplitude increases. Although the precise crossover field depends on particle size and excitation frequency, it occurs at approximately $0.5H_k$, where $H_k$ is the uniaxial anisotropy field. These orientational regimes are directly linked to the underlying microscopic dynamics and the associated MFH performance through the occurrence of switching and non-switching hysteresis cycles, predominantly associated with Néel magnetization reversal and Brownian particle rotation, respectively. The relative importance of these dissipation mechanisms also depends on frequency: at $f=1$ MHz, Brownian heating dominates at low field amplitudes, whereas Néel heating dominates at high fields. By contrast, at $f=100$ kHz, both contributions remain comparable over most of the investigated field range.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过耦合Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert方程与磁性纳米粒子的Brownian转动动力学，理论研究了磁流体热疗中易轴重取向对加热效率的影响。研究发现易轴取向存在场驱动的交叉转变（约0.5H_k），且Néel与Brownian两种耗散机制在不同频率和场强下的相对贡献不同。
AI.motivation: 磁流体热疗（MFH）中磁性纳米粒子的加热机制涉及Néel翻转和Brownian旋转两种耗散过程，此前研究中粒子易轴的重取向效应未被充分考虑，需要从理论上揭示粒子旋转对MFH性能的影响。
AI.method: 将Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert方程与磁性纳米粒子的Brownian转动动力学相结合，建立耦合理论模型，数值研究粒子易轴在磁场作用下的重取向行为及其对磁滞回线和加热效率的影响。
AI.result: 发现易轴取向存在场驱动的交叉转变，约在0.5H_k处从垂直于场方向转变为平行/反平行于场方向。转变场取决于粒径和频率。开关型和非开关型磁滞回线分别与Néel反转和Brownian旋转相关。在1 MHz下，低场时Brownian加热占主导而高场时Néel加热占主导；在100 kHz下两者贡献在全场范围内相当。
AI.conclusion: 粒子易轴旋转在MFH中起着关键作用，其取向状态直接决定不同的微观耗散机制，且频率依赖性显著影响两种加热机制的相对贡献，这为优化MFH实验参数提供了理论指导。

title: Wrinkling of Randomly Heterogeneous Film-Substrate Systems
summary: Wrinkling instabilities in stiff films on compliant substrates are strongly affected by spatial fluctuations in film stiffness. We develop a homogenized instability theory for one-dimensional film--substrate systems with random bending stiffness. The heterogeneous stability equation is reformulated as a Lippmann--Schwinger equation for the curvature field, and a strong-contrast expansion is derived using a local--nonlocal kernel decomposition and a cavity-field formulation. Truncation at third order yields an effective polarizability and a Dyson-type dispersion relation for predicting the critical load and wavenumber. The stiffness is modeled as an exponentially mapped Gaussian random field, allowing the required two- and three-point connected statistics to be obtained analytically. The theory is validated against generalized eigenvalue calculations and Fourier spectral simulations. Increasing stiffness contrast lowers the critical load and shifts the instability toward higher wavenumbers, producing shorter wrinkles. At weak contrast, the threshold follows the universal scaling $N_c^{(0)}-N_c\sim\varepsilon^2$, whereas at moderate and strong contrast the third-order approximation is more accurate than the second-order theory. Wavelength selection is controlled by the ratio of the dominant material wavelength $λ^\ast$ to the harmonic-mean reference wavelength $λ_H$. For $λ^\ast/λ_H<1$, the harmonic-mean model accurately predicts the wrinkle wavelength. The framework provides a mechanics-based tool for reliability assessment and design of statistically heterogeneous film--substrate systems.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了具有随机弯曲刚度的薄膜-基底系统起皱失稳的均质化理论。通过将异质稳定性方程重构为Lippmann-Schwinger方程，并利用强对比展开和腔场公式推导出有效极化率和Dyson型色散关系，可预测临界载荷和波数。理论通过广义特征值计算和傅里叶谱模拟验证，揭示了刚度对比度对临界载荷和皱纹波长的影响规律。
AI.motivation: 实际工程中薄膜-基底系统的刚度往往存在空间随机波动，而现有起皱失稳理论大多假设材料性质均匀。理解刚度空间波动如何影响失稳阈值和波长选择，对于薄膜系统的可靠性评估和设计具有重要意义。已有研究缺乏针对随机刚度场的系统性理论框架。
AI.method: 将异质稳定性方程重构为曲率场的Lippmann-Schwinger方程；采用局部-非局部核分解和空腔场公式推导强对比展开；在三阶截断下得到有效极化率和Dyson型色散关系；将刚度建模为指数映射的高斯随机场，解析获得两点和三点关联统计量；通过广义特征值计算和傅里叶谱模拟进行验证。
AI.result: 增大刚度对比度会降低临界载荷并将失稳移向更高波数，产生更短皱纹。弱对比度下阈值遵循普适标度N_c^(0)-N_c~ε²；中强对比度下三阶近似优于二阶理论。波长选择由主导材料波长λ*与调和平均参考波长λ_H的比值控制，当λ*/λ_H<1时，调和平均模型可准确预测皱纹波长。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为统计异质薄膜-基底系统提供了基于力学的可靠性评估和设计工具，揭示了刚度随机波动对起皱失稳的定量影响机制。

title: Vibrational spectroscopy identifies the bond asymmetry of hexagonal diamond
summary: Bulk hexagonal diamond has been synthesized by independent routes, but its structure remains contested: the two recent refinements disagree even on the sign of the difference between its two inequivalent bond lengths, 238~mÅ apart, and both depart from an earlier 2003 refinement. Here we test the competing structures with first-principles lattice dynamics. Relaxed hexagonal diamond has an interlayer bond \emph{longer} than the intralayer bonds by 24~mÅ in both functionals, an effect of its eclipsed conformation that scales with polytype hexagonality. The bright zone-center $A_{1g}$ mode gauges the interlayer bond at $\approx\!-2{,}100$~\icm~Å$^{-1}$, and neither refined coordinate reproduces the full pattern of measured modes. The only structure matching the twinned sample's three bands requires tens-of-gigapascals confining stress and lattice constants excluded by its own diffraction. Raman spectroscopy and diffraction jointly select a small positive bond asymmetry: inverting the spectrum of the phase-pure sample gives $\OB-\OA=24\pm3$~mÅ (95\% interval), and two determinations on separate samples give $+33\pm8$ and $+60\pm45$~mÅ. The 1{,}529~\icm{} feature cannot be assigned to homogeneous ideal 2H diamond, and the local HRTEM observation remains an open puzzle.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理晶格动力学研究体相六方金刚石（2H金刚石）的争议结构。研究发现在弛豫的六方金刚石中，层间键比层内键长24 mÅ，并利用拉曼光谱的A₁g模式作为层间键的探针。结果表明，先前两种精细结构都无法完整复现测量模式，唯一能匹配孪晶样品三个谱带的方案需要数十GPa的约束应力，但该应力与衍射得到的晶格常数相矛盾。联合拉曼光谱与衍射分析选择了一个小的正键不对称性：相位纯样品的谱带反转给出层间键-层内键差为24±3 mÅ，两个独立样品分别给出+33±8和+60±45 mÅ。1529 cm⁻¹特征无法归属于均匀的理想2H金刚石，HRTEM局部观测仍是一个悬而未决的谜题。
AI.motivation: 体相六方金刚石已通过多条独立路线合成，但其结构仍存在争议：最近两次结构精修甚至在两个不等价键长之差的符号上都存在分歧（相差238 mÅ），且都偏离了2003年的早期精修结果。这种结构不确定性阻碍了对该材料的深入理解与应用。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理晶格动力学方法测试竞争性结构。在两种泛函下弛豫六方金刚石结构，计算声子谱和拉曼活性模式，将理论预测的振动模式与实验拉曼光谱及X射线衍射数据进行比较，以区分相互竞争的结构模型。
AI.result: 弛豫的六方金刚石层间键比层内键长24 mÅ（两种泛函一致），这是其中重叠构象的效应，且随多型体的六方度缩放。区中心的A₁g明亮模式以约-2100 cm⁻¹/Å⁻¹的敏感性探测层间键长。两种精修结构均无法完整复现实验模式。唯一匹配孪晶样品三个谱带的结构需要数十GPa的约束应力，但其晶格常数与样品自身衍射结果矛盾。联合分析得出小正键不对称性：+24±3 mÅ（95%置信区间）及另外两个独立样品上的+33±8和+60±45 mÅ。
AI.conclusion: 拉曼光谱与衍射的联合分析支持六方金刚石中一个小的正键不对称性（层间键略长于层内键），排除了此前两种冲突的精修结构。然而，1529 cm⁻¹特征无法归属于均匀理想2H金刚石，HRTEM观测到的局部结构仍是开放问题，表明该材料可能包含更复杂的微观结构特征。

title: New Hydrolysis Rate Constants Reveal Longest Cyanide Persistence in Cool, Neutral Waters
summary: Hydrogen cyanide (HCN) is a key molecule in prebiotic chemistry, and its availability in water is limited by hydrolysis. In this work, we estimate the hydrolysis rates of \ce{HCN}, particularly the errors associated with the rates as a function of temperature, pH and in the presence of salts containing sulfite, sulfide and phosphate. For pure water, we find an acid-catalyzed hydrolysis rate constant at ${\rm 0 ^{\circ}C}$ of $\ln (k^+_{273}/1\,{\rm M^{-1} s^{-1}}) = -12.7 \pm 1.12$ with an activation energy of $67.1 \, {\rm kJ \, mol^{-1}}$. We find a base-catalyzed rate constant of $\ln (k_{273}^-/1\,{\rm M^{-1} s^{-1}}) = -9.0 \pm 1.27$ at ${\rm 0^{\circ}C}$ with an activation energy of $89.5 \, {\rm kJ \, mol^{-1}}$. These values are consistent with estimates from the literature within our uncertainties at ${\rm pH} > 8$ but diverge from literature values at lower pH. In the presence of salts, hydrolysis is accelerated under acidic conditions to 6--14$\times$ the acid-catalyzed rate without salts. However, at ${\rm pH \gtrsim 8}$ hydrolysis rates become $2.5\times$ times slower with sulfite and sulfide. These results demonstrate the importance of estimating uncertainties associated with rates when constraining the maximum concentrations of prebiotic molecules attainable in natural waters on the Earth and other planets.

AI.tldr: 本文估算了氢氰酸（HCN）在水中的水解速率及其不确定性，包括温度、pH和含亚硫酸盐、硫化物、磷酸盐环境的影响，发现酸性条件下盐类可将水解加速6-14倍，碱性条件下亚硫酸盐和硫化物可使水解减慢2.5倍。
AI.motivation: HCN是前生命化学中的关键分子，但其在水中的水解作用限制了其可用性。准确掌握HCN在不同条件下的水解速率及其不确定性，对于约束地球及其他星球天然水体中可达到的前生命分子最大浓度至关重要。
AI.method: 通过估算HCN在水中的水解速率，系统分析温度、pH及含有亚硫酸盐、硫化物和磷酸盐的盐溶液对水解速率的影响，并计算相关的误差范围。
AI.result: 纯水中0°C酸催化水解速率常数为ln(k⁺₂₇₃/1 M⁻¹s⁻¹) = -12.7 ± 1.12，活化能67.1 kJ/mol；碱催化水解速率常数为ln(k⁻₂₇₃/1 M⁻¹s⁻¹) = -9.0 ± 1.27，活化能89.5 kJ/mol。pH>8时与文献一致，但低pH时与文献有分歧。盐存在下，酸性条件水解加速6-14倍，pH≥8时亚硫酸盐和硫化物使水解减慢2.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明在约束地球及其他行星天然水体中前生命分子的最大浓度时，必须重视估算速率相关的不确定性，因为环境条件（如pH和盐类）对HCN水解速率有显著影响。

title: Memory with Onsager-Casimir symmetry: Rotating particle in a viscoelastic fluid
summary: We study the stochastic dynamics of a rotating Brownian particle in a non-Markovian fluid. Experimentally, we find that rotation enhances the long-time diffusivity of the particle and generates time-antisymmetric cross-correlations between orthogonal displacement components in the plane perpendicular to the rotation axis. To rationalize these observations, we introduce a minimal linear model in which a tracer is coupled to a slow bath degree of freedom and rotation enters through an advective coupling. Eliminating the bath variable yields a generalized Langevin equation with a non-reciprocal memory kernel. This kernel rotates in time, forming a logarithmic spiral, and it obeys Onsager-Casimir symmetry under reversal of the rotation vector, and the corresponding fluctuation-response relation. From the latter we obtain a geometric construction that links two-time cross-correlations to the transverse response of the particle in bulk. Unlike the ordinary Einstein relation, this relation involves the antisymmetric sector of the response. Our experiments and theory are in qualitative agreement, establishing rotating colloids in viscoelastic fluids as a minimal realization of Onsager-Casimir symmetry in time-nonlocal stochastic dynamics

AI.tldr: 本文研究了非马尔可夫流体中旋转布朗粒子的随机动力学。实验发现旋转增强了粒子的长时扩散率，并在垂直于旋转轴的平面内产生正交位移分量间的时间反对称交叉关联。作者引入一个最小线性模型，其中示踪粒子耦合到慢浴自由度，旋转通过平流耦合进入。消除浴变量后得到具有非互易记忆核的广义朗之万方程，该核在时间中旋转形成对数螺线，并满足在旋转矢量反转下的Onsager-Casimir对称性及相应的涨落-响应关系。
AI.motivation: 理解旋转对非马尔可夫流体中布朗粒子动力学的影响，特别是旋转如何改变扩散率和产生时间反对称交叉关联，以及这些现象如何体现时间非局域随机动力学中的Onsager-Casimir对称性。
AI.method: 结合实验观测与理论建模：(1) 在实验中测量旋转布朗粒子的扩散动力学；(2) 建立最小线性模型，将示踪粒子耦合到慢浴自由度，旋转通过平流耦合引入；(3) 消除浴变量推导出带非互易记忆核的广义朗之万方程；(4) 利用Onsager-Casimir对称性和涨落-响应关系，建立几何构造将双时间交叉关联与粒子在体相中的横向响应联系起来。
AI.result: 实验发现旋转增强粒子长时扩散率并产生时间反对称的正交位移交叉关联。理论模型重现了这些观测，得到旋转记忆核（对数螺线形式），并建立了涉及响应反对称扇区的新型涨落-响应关系，不同于普通爱因斯坦关系。
AI.conclusion: 实验与理论定性一致，确立了粘弹性流体中的旋转胶体作为时间非局域随机动力学中Onsager-Casimir对称性的最小实现。

title: Analytical Charge Density Profile of Vortex Core in Weak-Coupling Superconductor
summary: Self-consistent Bogoliubov-de Gennes calculations have long shown that solving the Poisson equation inside a superconducting vortex turns a one-signed charge depletion into a modulation that alternates in sign with period $π/k_F$. We give an elementary account of that result. Taking the Caroli-de Gennes-Matricon bound states in a step-like gap, we show that the normalization of the bound-state spinor is nearly independent of angular momentum, which collapses the mode sum into closed form. Inside the core the vortex winding removes one Bessel channel from a completeness sum, so the density vanishes on the vortex line and carries Friedel-like oscillations of wavevector $2k_F$; outside it the sum gives a $1/r$ envelope decaying over a coherence length, with a residual ripple. The bound-state charge does not integrate to zero, so neutrality obliges the extended states to compensate it exactly. That compensation is complete at long wavelength but fails at the diameter of the Fermi circle, and what survives is a sign-alternating $2k_F$ modulation reduced only by $4k_F^2/(4k_F^2+k_{TF}^2)$, a factor lying between one-half and three-quarters for any metal. The oscillation is therefore not a delicate effect but a consequence of neutrality and the inefficiency of screening at large momentum transfer: in the screened total the smooth terms cancel and only the ripple is left.

AI.tldr: 本文对超导涡旋内部电荷密度呈现交替符号的$2k_F$ Friedel振荡这一已知现象给出了简洁的解析解释。作者利用阶梯形能隙中的Caroli-de Gennes-Matricon束缚态，通过闭合形式的模式求和证明：该振荡不是精细效应，而是电荷中性要求与Thomas-Fermi屏蔽在大动量转移下效率低下的必然结果。
AI.motivation: 长期以来，自洽Bogoliubov-de Gennes计算已表明超导涡旋内部会由单一符号的电荷耗尽转变为周期为$π/k_F$的符号交替调制，但缺乏一个清晰、初等的物理解释来阐明这一结果的本质来源。
AI.method: 作者采用阶梯形能隙中的Caroli-de Gennes-Matricon束缚态模型，首先证明束缚态自旋子的归一化几乎与角动量无关，从而将模式求和化为闭合形式。在涡旋核心内部，涡旋缠绕序参数从完备性求和中移除一个Bessel通道，导致密度在涡旋线上为零并携带$2k_F$的Friedel振荡；在核心外部，求和得到以相干长度衰减的$1/r$包络。由于束缚态电荷不积分为零，通过中性条件要求扩展态精确补偿，作者分析了该补偿在大动量转移（费米圆直径）处失效，最终得到仅由因子$4k_F^2/(4k_F^2+k_{TF}^2)$抑制的符号交替$2k_F$调制。
AI.result: 作者证明：束缚态电荷与扩展态电荷在大波长下完全补偿，但在费米圆直径尺度上补偿失效，残留下符号交替的$2k_F$密度调制。该振荡的振幅被因子$4k_F^2/(4k_F^2+k_{TF}^2)$抑制，该因子对所有金属均介于1/2与3/4之间。在屏蔽后的总电荷中，平滑项相互抵消，仅剩波纹项。
AI.conclusion: 超导涡旋中的$2k_F$符号交替电荷振荡并非微妙或精细的效应，而是电荷中性要求与Thomas-Fermi屏蔽在大转移动量下效率不足的必然结果，且该效应在任何金属中都显著存在。

title: Ion Flow under an Applied Electric Field in Semiconducting and Metallic Carbon Nanotubes
comment: a short paper commenting on measurements of ion flow in carbon nanotubes
summary: Measurements made by Li, et. al., showed that the flow rates of potassium ions through 11nm long, subnanometer diameter, metallic and semiconducting carbon nanotubes under an applied electric field are almost the same. In contrast, measurements of the electrical conductivity of potassium chloride solution through 100 long metallic and semiconducting carbon nanotubes with diameters between 2.6-5.4nm by Cui, et. al., show that the ionic conductivity in the semiconducting nanotubes is larger than that of the metallic nanotubes. Possible theoretical origins of these differences are explored in this article.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了两种关于离子在碳纳米管中传输的实验结果差异的理论起源：Li等人的实验显示11nm长、亚纳米直径的金属性和半导体性碳纳米管中钾离子流率几乎相同，而Cui等人的实验显示100微米长、直径2.6-5.4nm的半导体性碳纳米管中离子电导率大于金属性碳纳米管。
AI.motivation: 两种实验观测结果表面矛盾——一种显示碳纳米管的电子性质（金属性或半导体性）对离子传输无影响，另一种显示有明显影响。理解这种差异的理论起源有助于深入理解离子在纳米尺度受限通道中的传输机制。
AI.method: 本文通过理论分析探索可能导致两种实验观测结果差异的潜在机制，包括考虑纳米管长度、直径、电子结构等因素对离子传输的影响。
AI.result: 论文探讨了可能解释两种实验结果差异的理论来源，但具体结果未在摘要中给出。
AI.conclusion: 两种实验的差异可能源于碳纳米管的长度、直径以及电子性质等参数的差异，本文试图从理论上阐明这些因素如何影响离子传输行为。

title: Mitigating ray effects in rarefied flow simulations using an ensemble-of-subproblems strategy with stochastic discrete velocities
summary: In this work, a ensemble-of-subproblems strategy with stochastic discrete velocities is extended to deterministic methods for mitigating ray effects in rarefied flow simulations. The strategy involves performing multiple independent subproblems, each using a small set of randomly sampled velocity points, and then averaging their solutions to obtain the final result. The core idea is to ensure that the distribution function at any velocity can contribute to the final result, approximating highly refined velocity-space resolution without increasing the memory requirement in any single subproblem. We incorporate this strategy within the DUGKS framework, and the resulting method is denoted as SDV-DUGKS. To evaluate the performance of the proposed method, we compare SDV-DUGKS with the original DUGKS on several test cases: (a) the Sod shock tube problem, (b) the one-dimensional Riemann problem, (c) the two-dimensional lid-driven cavity flow, and (d) the two-dimensional Riemann problem. The results show that, in the collisionless limit $\mathrm{Kn} \to \infty$: (1) for one-dimensional compressible flows, SDV-DUGKS reduces memory usage by approximately 2/3 compared with that of the original DUGKS while achieving good agreement; (2) for two-dimensional compressible flows, SDV-DUGKS requires one to two orders of magnitude less memory than the original DUGKS while achieving good agreement. Based on these results, it can be concluded that the proposed method serves as a reliable and effective tool for mitigating ray effects in rarefied flow simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将"子问题集成策略"与随机离散速度相结合的方法（SDV-DUGKS），用于缓解稀薄流模拟中的射线效应。该方法通过多次独立子问题（每次使用少量随机采样的速度点）并平均结果，在不增加单个子问题内存需求的前提下近似高分辨率速度空间。在无碰撞极限下，一维可压缩流动可减少约2/3的内存，二维可压缩流动可减少1-2个数量级的内存，同时保持良好精度。
AI.motivation: 稀薄流模拟中，传统确定性方法（如DUGKS）在速度空间离散时需要高分辨率来缓解射线效应（ray effects），但高分辨率会导致巨大的内存需求。已有的随机速度离散方法（ensemble-of-subproblems策略）多用于随机方法，本文希望将其扩展到确定性方法中，在保持精度的同时显著降低内存开销。
AI.method: 将ensemble-of-subproblems策略（多次独立子问题，每个子问题使用少量随机采样速度点，最后对结果取平均）引入DUGKS（离散统一气体动理学格式）框架，形成SDV-DUGKS方法。核心思想是保证任意速度上的分布函数都能对最终结果做出贡献，从而在不增加单个子问题内存需求的情况下逼近高分辨率速度空间精度。
AI.result: 在无碰撞极限（Kn→∞）下：（1）对一维可压缩流动（Sod激波管、一维Riemann问题），SDV-DUGKS相比原始DUGKS减少约2/3内存，且结果吻合良好；（2）对二维可压缩流动（二维方腔驱动流、二维Riemann问题），SDV-DUGKS内存需求比原始DUGKS低1-2个数量级，同时保持良好一致性。
AI.conclusion: SDV-DUGKS是一种可靠且有效的工具，能够在显著降低内存需求的同时缓解稀薄流模拟中的射线效应，为高Kn数下的确定性稀薄流动模拟提供了一种实用的替代方案。

title: Rhombohedral Graphene: A Tale of Many Crystals
summary: Experiments on rhombohedral graphene have uncovered an extraordinary wealth of correlated quantum phases - from chiral superconductors to electronic crystals - all within a single family of atomically thin materials. Here, we introduce a simple indicator, derived from the noninteracting band dispersion, that identifies strongly correlated regions in the phase diagram of rhombohedral graphene as a function of carrier density and displacement field. We develop a neural-network variational Monte Carlo method, combined with Hartree-Fock theory, to solve the interacting ground states. Our calculation reveals a variety of electron crystals with no classical analog. These include, at increasing density: Wigner crystal, self-doped Wiger crystal, as well as ''anticrystal'', a lattice of holes in an electron liquid. We discuss their experimental manifestations and possible connection to superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种基于非相互作用带色散的简单指标，用于识别菱面体石墨烯相图中的强关联区域。作者开发了神经网络变分蒙特卡洛方法与Hartree-Fock理论相结合的方法求解相互作用基态，发现了多种无经典类比的电子晶体相，包括Wigner晶体、自掺杂Wigner晶体以及"反晶体"（电子液体中的空穴晶格），并讨论了其实验表现及与超导的可能联系。
AI.motivation: 菱面体石墨烯实验展现出丰富的关联量子相（从手性超导体到电子晶体），但如何系统性地识别其强关联区域并理解这些复杂相的起源是一个关键挑战。
AI.method: 提出一个从非相互作用带色散推导的简单指标来定位强关联区域；将神经网络变分蒙特卡洛方法与Hartree-Fock理论结合，求解载流子密度与位移场空间中的相互作用基态。
AI.result: 发现了多种无经典类比的电子晶体相：随密度增加依次出现Wigner晶体、自掺杂Wigner晶体以及"反晶体"（电子液体中的空穴晶格），并讨论了它们的实验表现形式及其与超导电性的可能关联。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为菱面体石墨烯中丰富关联量子相的预测和理解提供了新的计算框架和物理图像，所发现的奇异电子晶体相可能与实验观察到的超导等量子相存在密切联系。

title: Configuration averaging of X-ray absorption spectra of disordered systems within the augmented-space full multiple-scattering formalism
summary: We present a formulation of the full multiple-scattering theory of X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) for disordered systems based on the augmented-space method of Mookerjee. Both substitutional (chemical) and thermal (vibrational) disorder are cast, on the same footing, as exact matrix elements of a non-random operator acting on an enlarged Hilbert space. The configuration-averaged scattering-path operator is thereby obtained by inverting a non-random secular matrix, with no expansion in scattering paths, without recourse to the single-site approximation and without any assumption on the shape of the disorder distribution. This is what the quantitative analysis of the near-edge region requires: XANES lies where the multiple-scattering series does not converge, so that a treatment of disorder tied to a path expansion is unavailable there. The inversion is carried out by a continued-fraction (Lanczos) recursion, which accesses the required matrix element without constructing the full configuration basis or diagonalising the augmented operator. The operator Debye-Waller factor of the harmonic theory is recovered as the Gaussian special case, and anharmonic disorder is included with no additional machinery, through the moments of a non-Gaussian displacement distribution. Where the series does converge, the construction also settles a question of principle: for statistically independent site variables, replacing each t-matrix by its configuration average is exact only for scattering paths in which every site occurs once, and for paths that revisit a site we obtain the exact second-order correction.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Mookerjee的增广空间方法，提出了无序系统中X射线吸收光谱（XAS）全多重散射理论的统一公式化，将化学（替代）无序和热（振动）无序统一处理为增广Hilbert空间中非随机算符的精确矩阵元，通过连分数（Lanczos）递归实现非随机久期矩阵求逆，避免了散射路径展开、单站点近似及对无序分布形状的假设，适用于多重散射序列不收敛的XANES区域。
AI.motivation: XANES（近边X射线吸收精细结构）区域位于多重散射序列不收敛之处，因此传统的基于路径展开的无序处理方法在该区域不可用。此外，现有方法多依赖单站点近似或对无序分布形状的特定假设，难以对无序系统进行定量的近边分析。需要一种不依赖路径展开、不依赖单站点近似、不假设无序分布形状的无序XAS理论框架。
AI.method: 将替代无序（化学）和振动无序（热）统一化为增广Hilbert空间中非随机算符的精确矩阵元；配置平均的散射路径算符通过对非随机久期矩阵求逆获得；求逆通过连分数（Lanczos）递归完成，无需构建完整配置基或对角化增广算符；谐振理论的算符Debye-Waller因子作为高斯特例被恢复；非高斯（非谐）无序通过位移分布的矩包含，无需额外机制。
AI.result: 建立了统一的、无需路径展开、无需单站点近似、不假设无序分布形状的XAS多重散射理论。恢复了谐振理论的算符Debye-Waller因子（高斯特例），并能处理非谐无序。此外，在序列收敛的区域，证明了对统计独立站点变量，用配置平均的t矩阵替代各t矩阵仅对每个站点只出现一次的散射路径是精确的，并给出了路径重访站点的精确二阶修正。
AI.conclusion: 该增广空间方法为无序系统中的XANES定量分析提供了理论基础，统一处理化学和热无序，克服了路径展开在XANES区域不收敛的根本性困难，同时解决了单站点平均替代的精确性原理问题。

title: Channel selection at identically vanishing dissipation difference: isolating the frenetic sector of the overdamped path measure
comment: 12 pages, 1 figure, 9 tables. Supersedes in part arXiv:2606.09684 and arXiv:2603.15230
summary: Transition-state and Kramers-Langer theory determine reaction channel selection from data at a single point: the saddle. We show this is insufficient in a precise, constructive sense. Using the standard split of the Onsager-Machlup path weight into a time-antisymmetric part fixed by the entropy flux and a time-symmetric part, the frenesy, we first settle when a dissipation-based criterion can distinguish two forward histories at all: the entropy difference between two histories sharing endpoints equals beta times the circulation of the non-conservative force around the loop they enclose, and vanishes identically for every gradient flow. We then construct a two-channel gradient landscape whose channels share both endpoints, whose barrier heights are equal identically, and whose saddle Hessians are the same matrix. The entropy sector is switched off by construction, all local saddle-point theories predict 50:50 exactly, and the branching ratio isolates the frenetic sector. Langevin simulation gives P(+) = 0.4568 +/- 0.0012. We identify a covariant geometric contribution to pathway selection within the frenetic sector, (1/2) ln det(D_perp H_perp), show that the divergence-of-drift observable proposed for this role is not coordinate-invariant whereas this one is, and find that it reproduces the measured branching to within 0.5 sigma with no fitted parameters. Stiff spectator modes cancel identically, since selection depends only on a ratio of determinants. We also give a parameter-free prediction: a solenoidal force of strength epsilon must contribute exactly 2*beta*epsilon/pi to ln[P(+)/P(-)]. These results are an exactly controlled counterexample to the sufficiency of local saddle-point data for channel selection.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构造一个精确可控的反例，证明了跃迁态理论和Kramers-Langer理论（仅依赖鞍点局部信息）不足以决定反应通道选择。作者利用Onsager-Machlup路径权重的分解（熵通量部分+时间对称的frenesy部分），构造了一个梯度景观，其两个通道共享端点、势垒高度完全相等、鞍点Hessian相同，因此所有局域鞍点理论都预测50:50，但Langevin模拟实际给出P(+)=0.4568±0.0012。作者识别出frenesy部分中一个协变几何贡献(1/2)ln det(D_perp H_perp)，该量具有坐标不变性，且无自由参数地复现了测量结果。此外还给出了参数无关的预言：螺线管力强度epsilon对ln[P(+)/P(-)]的贡献为2*beta*epsilon/pi。
AI.motivation: 传统跃迁态理论和Kramers-Langer理论认为反应通道选择仅取决于鞍点处的局部信息（势垒高度、Hessian矩阵等）。作者质疑这一假设是否充分，并通过精确构造的反例系统地证明在鞍点数据完全相同的条件下，通道选择仍可能偏离50:50，从而揭示存在超越局域鞍点信息的机制（frenetic部分）需要被考虑。
AI.method: 作者采用标准Onsager-Machlup路径权重分解，将其分为时间反对称部分（由熵通量固定）和时间对称部分（frenesy）。首先证明了耗散判据区分两条共享端点的前向历史的充要条件（熵差等于beta乘以环绕非保守力的环量，对梯度流恒为0）。然后构造双通道梯度景观，使其满足：两通道共享端点、势垒高度恒等、鞍点Hessian相同，从而关闭熵扇区（熵通量为零），使所有局域鞍点理论都预测50:50。通过Langevin模拟测量分支比，并推导出frenetic扇区内一个协变几何量(1/2)ln det(D_perp H_perp)来解释偏差。同时验证了该量的坐标不变性，并给出了螺线管力的参数无关预言。
AI.result: Langevin模拟得到P(+)=0.4568±0.0012，显著偏离50:50。作者识别出frenetic扇区内的协变几何贡献(1/2)ln det(D_perp H_perp)，该量与发散漂移量不同，具有坐标不变性，且无拟合参数地复现了测量分支比（在0.5 sigma以内）。刚性旁观模式因行列式比值而抵消。螺线管力贡献的预言为2*beta*epsilon/pi对ln[P(+)/P(-)]。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了一个精确可控的反例，证明局域鞍点数据（跃迁态理论和Kramers-Langer理论）对反应通道选择是不充分的。结果强调了frenetic（时间对称）扇区在通道选择中的关键作用，尤其是在熵扇区被关闭或无法区分的梯度流情形下。协变几何量的识别为理解通道选择机制提供了新的理论工具，且参数无关的预言（螺线管力的贡献）可直接通过实验或模拟验证。

title: Noise-enhanced temporal boundary states in non-Hermitian systems
summary: Time-periodic modulation introduces a synthetic degree of freedom to manipulate topological phases. This synthetic dimension can trigger a phase transition that localizes a boundary state at the temporal interface. Noise is widely deemed a fundamental threat to topological protection, universally anticipated to weaken or even destroy topological states. Here, we introduce periodically repeated temporal noise and fully random temporal noise into a 2D periodically driven non-Hermitian system. Paradoxically, under ensemble averaging, such temporal noise drives an exponential enhancement of the response intensity at the temporal interface. An averaged superoperator analysis shows that the noiseless band structure is preserved under both types of noise. Yet the noise increases the growth rate of growing modes while suppressing the decay rate of decaying ones. Finally, we experimentally realize the noise-enhanced temporal boundary state in a robotic metamaterial network. This finding establishes temporal noise as a constructive ingredient, enabling the unambiguous emergence of topological states and conferring exceptional robustness upon topological devices.

AI.tldr: 本文发现周期性重复和完全随机的临时噪声非但不会破坏拓扑保护，反而能指数级增强时间界面处的响应强度，并在机器人超材料网络中实验验证了噪声增强的时间边界态。
AI.motivation: 传统观点普遍认为噪声是拓扑保护的致命威胁，会削弱甚至破坏拓扑态。作者挑战这一传统认知，探索在时间周期性调制的非厄米系统中，时间噪声是否可能成为建设性因素，从而揭示噪声在拓扑系统中未曾预料的作用。
AI.method: 将周期性重复时间噪声和完全随机时间噪声引入2D周期性驱动非厄米系统。使用系综平均的超级算符分析证明噪声下无噪能带结构被保持，同时噪声增加增长模的增长率并抑制衰减模的衰减率。最后在机器人超材料网络中实验实现噪声增强的时间边界态。
AI.result: 在系综平均下，两种类型的噪声均驱动时间界面处响应强度呈指数级增强。噪声保持了无噪能带结构，但增加了增长模的增长率并抑制了衰减模的衰减率。实验在机器人超材料网络中成功实现了噪声增强的时间边界态。
AI.conclusion: 该发现将时间噪声确立为建设性成分，使拓扑态能够明确涌现，并为拓扑器件赋予卓越的鲁棒性，颠覆了噪声必然破坏拓扑态的传统认知。

title: Ferroelectric superconductivity in noncentrosymmetric metals
summary: It has recently been shown in experiments that certain materials can display both superconductivity and ferroelectricity, contrary to a long-standing conjecture that these two phenomena are incompatible, or at least unrelated. In this work we study superconductivity in ferroelectric metals, using a formalism of ionic polarization fields coupled to itinerant electrons, both of which are treated at the microscopic level. The ferroelectric order manifests as a spontaneous polarization that may be uniform or spatially modulated, and fluctuations of the polarization mediate interactions between the electrons. The polarization fluctuations give rise to attractive interactions that can lead to Cooper pairing in certain lattice configurations, analogous to the nonpolar phonons in conventional BCS theory. Working with a simplified BCS model, we derive conditions under which superconductivity can coexist with and even emerge from ferroelectricity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了铁电金属中的超导电性，通过微观层面的离子极化场与巡游电子耦合形式体系，证明极化涨落可以介导电子间的吸引相互作用，在特定晶格构型下可导致库珀配对，从而超导电性可以与铁电性共存甚至源于铁电性。
AI.motivation: 实验最新发现某些材料可同时表现出超导电性和铁电性，这与长期以来认为这两种现象不相容或至少无关的猜想相矛盾。作者希望从微观理论层面解释这一共存现象。
AI.method: 采用离子极化场与巡游电子耦合的微观形式体系，极化可以是均匀的或空间调制的自发极化。极化涨落介导电子间相互作用，产生吸引相互作用导致库珀配对（类比BCS理论中的非极性声子）。使用简化的BCS模型推导超导电性与铁电性共存和涌现的条件。
AI.result: 推导出了特定晶格构型下超导电性可与铁电性共存甚至从铁电性中涌现的条件，证实极化涨落可以作为配对媒介。
AI.conclusion: 铁电金属中的极化涨落可以充当类似声子的配对中介机制，使得超导电性能够与铁电性共存甚至由铁电性驱动产生，打破了传统认为两者不相容的观点。

title: Universal scaling of the Anomalous Hall voltage of magnetic layer with the adjacent conducting layer
summary: The anomalous Hall voltage of magnetic heterostructures plays a key role as the indicator for the magnetization state and its interplay with a variety of spintronic effects. In this letter, we report the observation, mechanism, and impact of the universal, dramatic scaling of the anomalous Hall voltage of magnetic heterostructures with the thickness and resistivity of the nonmagnetic conducting layers (e.g., normal metal) by combining transport experiments, analytical derivation, and finite-element analyses. We identify that the mechanism is the serial resistor effect of the magnetic and non-magnetic layers within the magnetic heterostructures and irrelevant to any Fermi surface variation or angular momentum injection from the nonmagnetic layer to the magnetic layer. We also show that the accuracy of the harmonic Hall voltage analyses of magnetic heterostructures are unaffected by the under-measuring of the anomalous Hall voltage and other transverse voltages due to the serial resistor effect. These findings provide crucial information for understanding a variety of spintronic phenomena involving the anomalous Hall and other transverse voltages.

AI.tldr: 本文通过输运实验、解析推导和有限元分析，报道了磁性异质结构中反常霍尔电压随非磁性导电层厚度和电阻率的普适性剧烈缩放现象，并揭示其机制为磁性层与非磁性层之间的串联电阻效应，与费米面变化或角动量注入无关。研究还表明该效应不影响谐波霍尔电压分析的准确性。
AI.motivation: 反常霍尔电压是磁性异质结构中磁化状态及其与自旋电子学效应相互作用的重要指标，理解其随非磁性层参数的变化规律对于正确解读各类自旋电子学现象至关重要。
AI.method: 结合输运实验测量、解析推导以及有限元分析三种手段，系统研究反常霍尔电压随非磁性导电层厚度和电阻率的变化规律，并验证串联电阻效应机制的普适性。
AI.result: 发现反常霍尔电压随非磁性导电层厚度和电阻率呈现普适性、戏剧性的缩放行为，其机制为磁性/非磁性层间的串联电阻效应，与费米面变化或角动量注入无关；同时证实串联电阻效应不会影响谐波霍尔电压分析的精度。
AI.conclusion: 该发现为理解涉及反常霍尔和其他横向电压的各种自旋电子学现象提供了关键信息，有助于更准确地解读磁性异质结构中的自旋相关输运测量结果。

title: A memory-efficient deterministic method for multiscale gas flows using an ensemble-of-subproblems strategy with stochastic discrete velocities
summary: Deterministic multiscale gas flow simulations have long suffered from the curse of dimensionality: the number of discrete velocities increases dramatically with the velocity space dimension and the Mach number, exhausting available memory and computational resources. To address this issue, this paper proposes a memory-efficient deterministic method based on an ensemble-of-subproblems strategy using stochastic discrete velocities. This strategy transforms the originally computationally expensive problem into a series of independently and efficiently solvable subproblems. To be concrete, the proposed method replaces the conventional large deterministic velocity set with multiple small random velocity sets. Each random set defines a subproblem, which is solved by a deterministic multiscale numerical scheme that computes macroscopic moments via Monte Carlo integration. The final flow field is obtained by arithmetic averaging over all sub-problems. In this work, we employ the discrete unified gas kinetic scheme (DUGKS) for spatial discretization and term the resulting method SDV-DUGKS. To validate the proposed method, several numerical test cases are conducted, including (a) the one-dimensional shock structure, (b) the two-dimensional cavity flow, and (c) supersonic flow around a square cylinder. The results of the one-dimensional shock structure confirm the feasibility of the proposed method. The two-dimensional cases demonstrate that, compared to its deterministic counterpart, the proposed method saves more than 80% of memory usage while maintaining comparable accuracy. These results indicate that the proposed method markedly reduces memory demand for multiscale flow simulations and exhibits strong potential to alleviate the curse of dimensionality that currently hinders deterministic multiscale numerical schemes from being applied to engineering problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于随机离散速度的集成子问题策略（SDV-DUGKS），通过将大规模确定性速度集替换为多个小规模随机速度集，将原本高维昂贵的确定性多尺度气体流动模拟分解为一系列独立可解的子问题，从而显著降低内存消耗并缓解维度灾难。
AI.motivation: 确定性多尺度气体流动模拟长期受困于维度灾难：随着速度空间维度和马赫数增大，离散速度数量急剧增加，耗尽内存和计算资源，严重阻碍了确定性多尺度数值方案在工程问题中的应用。
AI.method: 提出基于集成子问题（ensemble-of-subproblems）策略的记忆高效确定性方法，核心思想是用多个小的随机速度集替代传统的大型确定性速度集。每个随机速度集定义一个子问题，由确定性多尺度数值格式求解，宏观矩通过蒙特卡洛积分计算，最终流场通过对所有子问题结果进行算术平均获得。空间离散采用离散统一气体动理学格式（DUGKS），所得方法称为SDV-DUGKS。
AI.result: 通过三个数值测试验证：(a)一维激波结构确认方法可行性；(b)二维方腔流动和(c)方柱绕流超声速流动表明，与确定性对应方法相比，SDV-DUGKS在保持可比精度的同时节省超过80%的内存使用。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法显著降低了多尺度流动模拟的内存需求，展现出缓解当前阻碍确定性多尺度数值方案应用于工程问题的维度灾难的巨大潜力。

title: Shape of Wigner Crystals and Hole Self-Doping in a Mexican-Hat Dispersion
summary: We study Wigner crystals (WCs) induced by a strong Coulomb interaction from the ring-like Fermi surface of a Mexican-hat dispersion $ε_k= c_2k^2+c_4k^4$. We design orbital shape in order to minimize the energy of the WC, and find that a low ground-state energy requires an orbital shape with a depletion of electrons near $k=0$. To capture the Coulomb-induced correlations, we include a Jastrow factor as well as a factor describing the correlation between electrons and doped vacancies. Using variational Monte Carlo calculations, we calibrate the effective band parameters $c_2$ and $c_4$ to reproduce the two transitions observed experimentally as the electron density is lowered: from a spin-valley-polarized Fermi liquid with a disk-like Fermi surface, to one with a ring-like Fermi surface, and finally to a WC. We find that, even with an optimized orbital shape that depletes electrons near $k=0$, a WC with hole self-doping near $k=0$ can still be energetically favorable near the WC transition, provided that the electron-vacancy correlation is included. We also estimate the dispersion of the doped hole.

AI.tldr: 本文通过变分蒙特卡洛方法研究墨西哥帽色散下强库仑相互作用诱导的Wigner晶体（WC），发现最优轨道形状需在k=0处耗尽电子，并纳入Jastrow因子及电子-空穴关联后，WC在转变点附近仍可能通过空穴自掺杂而能量有利。
AI.motivation: 理解强库仑相互作用下从费米液体到Wigner晶体的转变物理，特别是墨西哥帽型费米面系统中电子关联效应和轨道形状对基态能量的影响。
AI.method: 设计优化的轨道形状以最小化WC能量；纳入Jastrow因子和电子-掺杂空穴关联因子；使用变分蒙特卡洛（VMC）计算，并校准有效带参数c2和c4以复现实验观察到的两个转变（自旋-谷极化费米液体→环状费米面→WC）。
AI.result: 低基态能量需要k=0处电子耗尽的轨道形状；即使采用优化轨道，在WC转变附近，包含电子-空穴关联后，k=0处空穴自掺杂的WC仍可能量有利；同时估计了掺杂空穴的色散。
AI.conclusion: 墨西哥帽色散系统中的WC转变伴随着k=0处的空穴自掺杂现象，电子-空穴关联对WC的稳定性至关重要，这为理解实验观测到的密度驱动相变提供了理论支持。

title: Resonant Raman spectroscopies beyond density-functional theory
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Supplemental Material included (5 pages, 4 figures)
summary: Resonant Raman spectroscopy probes, in a single measurement, how electrons and phonons couple in a material. Density-functional theory (DFT) typically reproduces well phonon frequencies, but resonant Raman intensities hinge on electron-phonon matrix elements and electronic transitions that are far more sensitive to the underlying exchange-correlation approximation. However, electron-phonon coupling has so far been accessible only through linear-response theories developed for a handful of semilocal DFT methods, leaving the sensitivity of resonant Raman intensities to the electronic-structure approximation essentially unexplored. Here, we introduce a general finite-difference framework that can compute resonant Raman tensors for any electronic-structure method capable of delivering forces, eigenvalues, and wavefunctions of pristine and displaced configurations. We apply the formalism to graphene and monolayer MoS$_2$, using hybrid functionals or meta-GGAs, and show that these approaches systematically enhance electron-phonon couplings relative to semilocal DFT, reflecting reduced dielectric overscreening. A decomposition of the Raman tensor shows that accurate intensities require electronic eigenvalues and electron-phonon matrix elements to be treated consistently at the same level of theory. Among the approaches tested, hybrid functionals provide the best overall agreement with experiment. Because the framework needs only quantities every electronic-structure code already produces, it opens the door to systematic, beyond-DFT Raman characterization or benchmarking against experiments, especially for 2D materials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种通用的有限差分框架，可基于任意电子结构方法计算共振拉曼张量，并将其应用于石墨烯和单层MoS₂，发现杂化泛函和meta-GGA相比半局域DFT会系统性增强电子-声子耦合，其中杂化泛函与实验吻合最佳。
AI.motivation: 传统DFT能较好复现声子频率，但共振拉曼强度依赖于电子-声子矩阵元和电子跃迁，这些对交换关联近似十分敏感。然而，电子-声子耦合此前只能通过少数半局域DFT方法的线性响应理论获取，导致共振拉曼强度对电子结构近似的敏感性基本未被探索。
AI.method: 提出一个通用的有限差分框架，只需利用任何电子结构方法都能产出的力、本征值和波函数（包括原始构型和位移构型），即可计算共振拉曼张量，从而突破半局域DFT线性响应方法的限制。
AI.result: 将该框架应用于石墨烯和单层MoS₂，使用杂化泛函或meta-GGA，结果表明这些方法相比半局域DFT系统性增强电子-声子耦合（反映介电过屏蔽减少）。拉曼张量分解显示，精确的强度要求电子本征值和电子-声子矩阵元在同一理论水平上一致处理。在测试的方法中，杂化泛函与实验总体吻合最佳。
AI.conclusion: 该框架仅需每个电子结构代码都已能产出的量，因此为系统性超越DFT的拉曼表征或对实验的基准测试（特别是二维材料）打开了大门。

title: Reduced Density Matrix Functional Theory Across Molecules and Periodic Systems: Screening and Coupled Optimization
summary: Reduced density matrix functional theory (RDMFT) provides a rigorous framework for treating strong electron correlation, yet its application to periodic systems has long been hindered by two fundamental challenges: the lack of transferable approximate functionals and the poor efficiency of orbital-occupation optimization. Here we show that these two longstanding obstacles can be overcome simultaneously. We develop a periodic implementation of RDMFT based on a coupled optimization framework that enables the efficient simultaneous optimization of natural orbitals and occupation numbers under periodic boundary conditions. Using this implementation, we demonstrate that physically motivated short-range screening transforms the Power functional into a transferable functional applicable to both molecules and periodic solids. Remarkably, short-range screening is found to play a dual role: besides substantially improving energetic accuracy, it fundamentally reshapes the optimization landscape, producing robust optimization step sizes and dramatically accelerating convergence. The coupled optimization framework consistently requires substantially fewer optimization iterations than conventional decoupled optimization for periodic calculations, while the screened $ω$P22 functional outperforms semilocal and hybrid density functionals in predicting representative surface reaction barriers. These results establish a computationally efficient periodic RDMFT framework and identify short-range screening as a promising design principle for developing transferable one-body reduced-density-matrix functionals.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了基于耦合优化框架的周期性约化密度矩阵泛函理论（RDMFT）实现，同时解决了缺乏可迁移泛函和轨道占据优化效率低两大长期难题。研究发现短程屏蔽可以将Power泛函转变为适用于分子和周期体系的迁移性泛函，且短程屏蔽起到双重作用：既提高能量精度，又重塑优化景观、加速收敛。筛过的ωP22泛函在表面反应势垒预测上优于半局域和杂化密度泛函。
AI.motivation: RDMFT为处理强电子关联提供了严格框架，但应用于周期体系长期受两大根本挑战阻碍：缺乏可迁移的近似泛函，以及轨道占据数优化效率低下。这两大障碍严重限制了RDMFT在固体和材料科学中的应用。
AI.method: 开发了基于耦合优化框架的周期性RDMFT实现，可以在周期边界条件下高效地同时优化自然轨道和占据数。利用物理上合理的短程屏蔽将Power泛函转变为可迁移泛函，并系统研究了短程屏蔽对能量精度和优化动力学的影响。
AI.result: 短程屏蔽发挥双重作用：（1）显著提高能量精度；（2）重塑优化景观，产生稳健的优化步长并大幅加速收敛。耦合优化框架相比常规解耦优化所需迭代次数显著减少，筛过的ωP22泛函在预测代表性表面反应势垒方面优于半局域和杂化密度泛函。
AI.conclusion: 建立了计算高效的周期性RDMFT框架，并确定短程屏蔽是开发可迁移的一体约化密度矩阵泛函的有前途的设计原则。

title: Algorithmic overlaps in the Baxter-Wu model: cluster dynamics under Novotny-Evertz updates
summary: We study the spatial overlap of successive spin configurations generated by Markov chain Monte Carlo simulations of the Baxter-Wu model. Using the Novotny-Evertz sublattice-freezing single-cluster update, we track the mean and variance of the algorithmic overlap across the critical region. We show that, even in this three-spin model, the overlap acts as an algorithmic observable that follows the thermodynamics of the transition: the single-cluster overlap mean behaves like an order parameter, dropping from a finite ordered-phase plateau toward zero across $T_c$. The overlap does not diverge at criticality, instead it remains finite and its finite-size value decays as a clean power law, $U_2(T_c)\sim L^{-ψ}$, over eleven sizes with an exponent $ψ{=}0.378(4)$ smaller than the value $\approx0.42$ found for the Ising and Potts models under standard Fortuin-Kasteleyn cluster dynamics, indicating that it reflects the Novotny-Evertz sublattice-freezing dynamics rather than any static property of the model.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Baxter-Wu模型中马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛模拟所产生的连续自旋构型的空间重叠。利用Novotny-Evertz子晶格冻结单簇更新算法，作者追踪了临界区域附近算法重叠的均值和方差，发现该重叠在临界温度处行为类似序参量，有限尺寸标度指数ψ=0.378(4)，小于Ising和Potts模型中的值≈0.42，表明该重叠反映的是算法动力学特性而非静态性质。
AI.motivation: 传统上算法重叠（algorithmic overlap）多用于研究Ising和Potts模型中的临界慢化与自旋玻璃行为，但尚未系统研究其在三自旋相互作用模型（如Baxter-Wu模型）中的表现。作者希望探究重叠是否也能作为这类模型中反映相变热力学的算法可观测量的普适性。
AI.method: 使用Novotny-Evertz子晶格冻结单簇更新算法对Baxter-Wu模型进行蒙特卡洛模拟，在临界区域跨越时追踪连续自旋构型之间空间重叠的均值和方差，并对临界温度处重叠的有限尺寸标度行为进行幂律拟合，跨越十一个系统尺寸。
AI.result: 单簇重叠的均值在临界温度处从有限的有序相平台跌向零，行为类似序参量；重叠在临界点不发散而是保持有限，其有限尺寸值满足幂律衰减U_2(T_c)~L^{-ψ}，得到的指数ψ=0.378(4)，明显小于Ising和Potts模型（Fortuin-Kasteleyn动力学）中约0.42的值。
AI.conclusion: 算法重叠在Baxter-Wu模型中同样遵循相变热力学，但其临界有限尺寸标度指数取决于所使用的簇更新算法动力学（Novotny-Evertz子晶格冻结 vs. Fortuin-Kasteleyn），而非模型的静态普适类，揭示重叠作为算法观测量的动力学依赖性。

title: {\it Ab initio} prediction of $d_{x^2-y^2}$-wave superconductivity in infinite-layer nickelates
summary: Infinite-layer nickelates have recently emerged as a new family of potential unconventional high critical temperature ($T_c$) superconductors. However, fundamental questions such as their superconducting (SC) pairing mechanism and gap symmetry remain under intense debate. Here we present a fully {\it ab initio} theoretical study on the SC properties of optimally doped nickelates $Re$$_{0.8}$Sr$_{0.2}$NiO$_2$ ($Re=$ La, Pr, Nd), based on the density functional theory for superconductors calculations with electron-phonon coupling (EPC), screened Coulomb repulsion and spin fluctuation (SF) interaction treated on an equal footing. We find that $Re_{0.8}$Sr$_{0.2}$NiO$_2$ are two-band superconductors with sign reversal $d_{x^2-y^2}(\pm)$-wave gap functions on the different Fermi surface (FS) pockets. Interestingly, when the SF interaction is turned off, $T_c$ becomes negligibly small ($\sim$0.01 K), thus demonstrating that the superconductivity in $Re_{0.8}$Sr$_{0.2}$NiO$_2$ is driven by SF interaction. Moreover, our {\it ab initio} calculations reveal that the SF interaction is an order of magnitude stronger than both EPC and Coulomb repulsion on the large quasi-two-dimensional FS pocket around the Brillouin zone (BZ) center, thus leading to the SF-mediated pairing mechanism, although the EPC dominates on the small three-dimensional electron FS pockets at the BZ corners. The emergence of nodal $d_{x^2-y^2}(\pm)$-wave gap structure is traced to the pronounced peaks in the Lindhard response function at the BZ corners. Our calculated FS, SC critical temperature, nodal gap structure and SC quasiparticle density of states are consistent with most available experiments. Furthermore, predicted unconventional SC properties such as scanning tunneling spectra of La$_{0.8}$Sr$_{0.2}$NiO$_2$ and Pr$_{0.8}$Sr$_{0.2}$NiO$_2$ are ready for immediate experimental verifications.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算，系统地研究了最优掺杂无限层镍酸盐Re₀.₈Sr₀.₂NiO₂（Re=La, Pr, Nd）的超导性质。研究发现这些材料是双能带超导体，具有节点dx²-y²(±)波能隙，并且超导主要由自旋涨落（SF）相互作用驱动，而非电子-声子耦合（EPC）。计算结果与大多数实验一致，并给出了可立即验证的预测。
AI.motivation: 无限层镍酸盐作为新型潜在高温超导体家族，其超导配对机制和能隙对称性等基本问题仍存在激烈争议，需要从第一性原理层面进行深入的理论研究。
AI.method: 基于超导体密度泛函理论（DFT for superconductors），将电子-声子耦合（EPC）、屏蔽库仑排斥和自旋涨落（SF）相互作用放在同等地位上处理，对最优掺杂的Re₀.₈Sr₀.₂NiO₂（Re=La, Pr, Nd）进行全从头计算。
AI.result: 发现：1) 这些材料是双能带超导体，具有符号反转的dx²-y²(±)波能隙；2) 关闭SF相互作用后Tc降至~0.01 K，证明超导由SF驱动；3) 在布里渊区中心的大准二维FS上，SF比EPC和库仑排斥强一个数量级；4) 节点能隙结构源于布里渊区角Lindhard响应函数的显著峰值；5) 计算结果与大多数实验一致。
AI.conclusion: 无限层镍酸盐Re₀.₈Sr₀.₂NiO₂的超导性由自旋涨落机制主导，具有节点dx²-y²(±)波能隙结构。论文还预测了La₀.₈Sr₀.₂NiO₂和Pr₀.₈Sr₀.₂NiO₂的扫描隧道谱等非常规超导性质，等待实验验证。

title: Planar Interfaces for Transmission of Chiral Spin Textures
summary: Lateral magnetic interfaces provide a direct way to test whether skyrmions remain robust when driven across abrupt changes in material parameters and magnetic order. Here we study skyrmion transmission across planar ferromagnet-ferromagnet (FM-FM), antiferromagnet-antiferromagnet (AFM-AFM), ferromagnet-antiferromagnet (FM-AFM), and antiferromagnet-ferromagnet (AFM-FM) interfaces using micromagnetic simulations and analytic reduced-coordinate criteria. The outcomes are organized into phase diagrams according to the morphology formed in the receiving region, distinguishing compact transmission from deformed skyrmions, stripe-domain states, amorphous textures, and relaxation into the background. Same-order FM-FM and AFM-AFM skyrmion transmission is captured by an analytically defined range of the reduced Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction, identifying the wall-softening regime that supports compact transmission without stripe formation. Mixed-order FM-AFM and AFM-FM interfaces are directionally distinct, requiring conversion between ferromagnetic magnetization and antiferromagnetic Néel textures. These results show that planar interfaces act as active transport elements and provide reduced design criteria for heterogeneous skyrmion tracks.

AI.tldr: 本文通过微磁模拟和解析降维判据，系统研究了斯格明子穿过平面磁性界面（FM-FM、AFM-AFM、FM-AFM、AFM-FM）时的传输行为，建立了相图区分不同类型的形貌结果，并给出了设计异构斯格明子赛道的关键判据。
AI.motivation: 横向磁性界面为测试斯格明子在突变的材料参数和磁序变化下是否保持鲁棒性提供了直接途径，理解这一过程对于异构斯格明子器件的设计至关重要。
AI.method: 采用微磁模拟结合解析降维判据，研究四种界面类型（同阶FM-FM和AFM-AFM，以及混合阶FM-AFM和AFM-FM）下的斯格明子传输行为，按接收区域形成的形貌构建相图。
AI.result: 发现了同阶界面传输可由降维Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用的解析范围描述，确定了支持紧凑传输而不形成条带的壁软化机制；混合阶界面表现出方向依赖性，需要在铁磁磁化与反铁磁Néel纹理之间转换。
AI.conclusion: 平面界面可作为主动传输元件，研究成果为异构斯格明子赛道提供了降维设计准则。

title: Consistent and bound-preserving finite-volume WENO scheme for compressible two-/$N$-phase flows with Phase-Field mechanism
summary: In the present study, we propose a consistent and bound-preserving finite-volume WENO scheme that satisfies the requirements of consistency, conservation, equilibrium, and bound preservation for compressible multiphase flows with the Phase-Field mechanism. The proposed WENO scheme is developed based on a new calculation of WENO weights determined by relative smoothness between stencils and on a coupled reconstruction of the masses and volume fractions. Consistency of reduction and volume fraction summation to unity are considered during the development so that fictitious phases, local voids, or overfilling are not produced numerically when there are $N$ ($N \geqslant 1$) different immiscible phases. The proposed WENO scheme is applied to the consistent and conservative Phase-Field method with adaptive mesh refinement enabled. Various benchmark compressible two- and $N$-phase flows are performed to verify the properties of the proposed WENO scheme as well as its variant with the consistent limiter. We finally demonstrate the capability of the proposed WENO scheme in shock-induced cavity collapse and shock-vessel-bubble interaction problems, with discussion of the necessity of bound preservation for high-order schemes and comparison of different compressible multiphase flow models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种一致且保界的有限体积WENO格式，用于带相场机制的可压缩多相流模拟，满足一致性、守恒性、平衡性和保界性要求，并通过激波诱导空腔坍塌和激波-容器-气泡相互作用等算例验证了其能力。
AI.motivation: 可压缩多相流的高阶数值格式需要同时满足一致性、守恒性、平衡态保持和保界性等严格要求，但现有WENO格式在这些方面存在不足，可能产生虚假相、局部空洞或过填充等数值问题，特别是当存在N个不混相时。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的WENO权重计算方法，基于模板间相对光滑度来确定权重；同时对质量与体积分数进行耦合重构；在开发过程中考虑降阶一致性和体积分数求和为1的约束，确保N个不相混相时不会产生数值虚假相。该格式应用于一致且守恒的相场方法，并启用了自适应网格细化，还考虑了带一致限制器的变体。
AI.result: 通过多种基准可压缩两相和N相流动算例验证了所提WENO格式及其带一致限制器变体的性能，并成功演示了该格式在激波诱导空腔坍塌和激波-容器-气泡相互作用问题中的能力，讨论了高阶级格式保界的必要性并比较了不同可压缩多相流模型。
AI.conclusion: 该WENO格式在一致性、守恒性、平衡态保持和保界性方面均满足要求，能有效处理N相可压缩多相流问题，特别在激波与气泡/空腔相互作用等复杂场景中表现出色，同时论证了高阶级格式中保界机制的重要性。

title: Chiral Magnon Mixing by Symmetry-Breaking in Collinear Ferrimagnets
summary: Magnons in ferromagnets possess spin angular momentum defined by right-handed precession of the moment around the magnetization direction. In antiferromagnets with no net magnetization, left-and right-handed magnons are degenerate in the absence of an applied field. Ferrimagnets possess uncompensated magnetic sublattices, which should natively possess right-and left-handed magnons where their energy is split by the internal molecular field. Here, we show that RMn6Sn6 (R = Tb, Er) ferrimagnets possess right and left-handed magnon bands that cross at finite momentum (k) within the basal plane, defining modes with opposite dynamical chirality. Depending on the symmetry of the ferrimagnetic order, which may be manipulated by varying the rare-earth magnetic anisotropy or with applied field, the band crossing may remain a nodal line or may be gapped. The gapped modes contain hybridized chiral excitations whose chirality becomes k-dependent.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了铁磁性材料RMn6Sn6（R = Tb, Er）中的手性磁振子。发现该材料具有左右手性磁振子能带，在基面内有限动量k处交叉，定义了相反动态手性的模式。通过改变稀土磁各向异性或施加外场，可以控制带交叉保持为节线或打开能隙，能隙模式包含手性随k变化的杂化手性激发。
AI.motivation: 铁磁体中的磁振子具有右手进动定义的自旋角动量；反铁磁体在无外加场时左右手磁振子简并；而铁磁体具有未补偿的磁性亚晶格，天然应具有左右手磁振子且能量被内部分子场劈裂。研究铁磁体中手性磁振子的能带结构及其调控机制具有重要意义。
AI.method: 以RMn6Sn6（R = Tb, Er）铁磁体为研究对象，分析其磁振子能带结构。通过改变稀土磁各向异性或施加外加磁场来操控铁磁有序的对称性，从而调控手性磁振子能带的交叉行为（保持节线或打开能隙）。
AI.result: RMn6Sn6铁磁体中存在左右手磁振子能带，在基面内有限动量k处交叉。根据铁磁有序的对称性，带交叉可以保持为节线或打开能隙。能隙中的模式包含杂化的手性激发，其手性随k变化。
AI.conclusion: 铁磁体RMn6Sn6为实现具有可调控手性特性的磁振子能带提供了理想平台，可通过对称性操控（各向异性或外场）实现对磁振子手性和能带拓扑的调控，这对于手性磁振子学等领域的应用具有重要意义。

title: Transient Liquid Phase Bonding of NiTi Using Cu- and Nb-base Interlayers
summary: Transient liquid phase (TLP) bonding was examined as an approach for joining NiTi to achieve a high joint efficiency while minimizing chemical variance within the joint region. Two bonding interlayer chemistries (Cu-base and Nb-base) were identified by screening thermodynamic criteria for TLP in ternary alloys using the CALPHAD method. These two systems were then experimentally evaluated with respect to their impact on solidification kinetics, microstructure in the joint region, and performance during quasistatic and cyclic tensile loading. For both interlayer chemistries, the composition profile and microstructure in the joint region confirmed an isothermal solidification mechanism. In addition, the joints were found to be fully dense and contain at most 1.2% intermetallic phases. Tensile testing showed excellent load transfer across the joints with approximately 4% recoverable strain and martensite onset stresses reaching 94% and 89% of the unbonded, annealed NiTi values for Cu-base and Nb-base interlayers, respectively. Lastly, a stable superelastic response was observed under cyclic loading for both bond chemistries, with spatial variation in the strain evolution linked to enhanced stiffness and hardness in the joint region arising from the substitutional Cu and Nb solutes, as confirmed via nanoindentation. This study demonstrates that TLP bonding of NiTi can produce high-strength and nearly intermetallic-free joints without sacrificing functional performance, such as the superelastic response.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了使用瞬态液相（TLP）键合技术连接NiTi形状记忆合金的方法，通过CALPHAD方法筛选出Cu基和Nb基两种中间层化学成分，实验评估了其对凝固动力学、微观组织和力学性能的影响。结果表明两种成分均实现了等温凝固机制，接头致密且金属间化合物含量最多1.2%，拉伸测试显示优异的载荷传递性能（约4%可恢复应变），并在循环加载下保持稳定的超弹性响应。该研究证明了TLP键合NiTi可以生产高强度、几乎无金属间化合物的接头而不牺牲超弹性等功能性能。
AI.motivation: 连接NiTi形状记忆合金时，传统焊接方法往往会导致接头区域化学成分变化和金属间化合物形成，从而降低接头效率和功能性能。作者旨在开发一种既能实现高接头效率又能最小化接头区域化学变化的连接方法。
AI.method: 1）利用CALPHAD方法对三元合金进行热力学筛选，确定合适的TLP键合中间层成分（Cu基和Nb基）；2）实验评估两种中间层对凝固动力学、接头区域微观组织的影响；3）进行准静态和循环拉伸加载测试以评估性能；4）通过纳米压痕确认接头区域溶质引起的刚度和硬度变化。
AI.result: 两种中间层化学成分均确认了等温凝固机制，接头完全致密且金属间化合物含量不超过1.2%。拉伸测试显示约4%的可恢复应变，Cu基和Nb基中间层的马氏体起始应力分别达到未键合退火态NiTi值的94%和89%。两种键合化学在循环加载下均表现出稳定的超弹性响应，接头区域的增强刚度和硬度与Cu和Nb置换溶质有关。
AI.conclusion: TLP键合能够生产高强度、几乎无金属间化合物的NiTi接头，且不牺牲超弹性等功能性能，为NiTi形状记忆合金的高效连接提供了可行方案。

title: Post-Collision Thermal Excitation and Survival-Limited Cluster Growth in the Gas Phase
summary: Gas-phase cluster growth by monomer addition is commonly modeled as an isothermal process. We develop a survival-limited framework in which association produces a thermally excited cluster that may dissociate before either cooling through bath-gas collisions or encountering the next monomer. A continuous-energy survival probability is first derived for an individual post-association thermal trajectory and is then marginalized over distributions of excitation energy, equilibrium energy, and monomer-arrival time using a trajectory functional. Molecular-dynamics simulations of water, silver, and gold clusters provide size-dependent caloric relationships and latent heats, while event-based Monte Carlo simulations independently test the survival formulation. Theory and Monte Carlo results agree closely. The ensemble-averaged survival probability exhibits strong and non-monotonic size dependence, with the largest thermal penalties generally occurring for the smallest clusters. Intermediate-size local maxima arise only when complete cluster-energy distributions are retained and result from competition between curvature-enhanced dissociation and the narrowing of the low-energy tail with increasing size. Surviving clusters are consequently drawn preferentially from the colder portion of the pre-collision energy distribution, and mean thermal trajectories can substantially underestimate population survival. To connect single-event survival to cumulative growth, we introduce a thermal forward-rate correction relative to an isothermal reference and incorporate it into a reversible birth--death model. Although the correction at each size may be moderate, its multiplicative accumulation can increase mean first-passage times by many orders of magnitude. The framework provides a general route for identifying post-collision stabilization as a control on gas-phase cluster growth.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个"生存受限"框架来建模气相团簇通过单体加成生长的过程。传统等温模型假设能量瞬间平衡，而作者考虑了缔合后团簇处于热激发态，可能在冷却或遇到下一个单体之前解离的情况。通过轨迹泛函推导连续能量生存概率，并用分子动力学和蒙特卡洛模拟验证。研究发现生存概率具有强且非单调的尺寸依赖性，热惩罚主要影响最小团簇，且热修正的累积效应可使平均首达时间增加多个数量级。
AI.motivation: 传统的气相团簇单体加成生长模型假设过程是等温的，忽略了缔合事件产生的热激发团簇可能在冷却前就发生解离这一关键物理过程。这导致对团簇生长动力学和稳定性的预测可能存在系统性偏差，尤其是在小尺寸团簇和快速生长条件下。
AI.method: 1) 建立连续能量生存概率公式：对单个缔合后热轨迹推导生存概率；2) 通过轨迹泛函对激发能、平衡能和单体到达时间的分布进行边缘化；3) 用分子动力学模拟（水、银、金团簇）获取尺寸依赖的量热关系和潜热；4) 用基于事件的蒙特卡洛模拟独立验证生存公式；5) 引入热前向速率修正，结合可逆生灭模型连接单次事件生存到累积生长。
AI.result: 理论和蒙特卡洛结果密切吻合。集合平均的生存概率表现出强且非单调的尺寸依赖性，最大的热惩罚通常出现在最小团簇上。中等尺寸的局部极大值仅在保留完整团簇能量分布时出现，源于曲率增强解离与低能尾随尺寸增大而变窄之间的竞争。生存团簇优先来自碰撞前能量分布的较冷部分，平均热轨迹会低估种群生存率。热修正虽在每个尺寸上适中，但其乘法累积可使平均首达时间增加多个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为识别后碰撞稳定化作为气相团簇生长的控制因素提供了一条通用途径，表明非等温效应在团簇生长中不可忽略，尤其是小尺寸团簇和累积生长过程中，热稳定化对团簇动力学有深远影响。

title: LieStoNet: Learning Lie Symmetries from Spatiotemporal Data for Stochastic Dynamical Systems
comment: 25 Pages, 7 figures. Accepted to the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Symmetry is central to modern machine learning and physics: invariances and equivariances improve sample efficiency, robustness, and out-of-distribution generalization, while symmetry principles guide scientific modeling. Yet for stochastic dynamical systems the relevant continuous symmetries are rarely known, and symmetry discovery for SDEs has remained essentially unexplored. We introduce \textit{LieStoNet}, an end-to-end, \emph{template-free} framework for discovering Lie-point symmetries of SDEs directly from spatiotemporal trajectories, without prespecifying symmetry groups, templates, or canonical coordinates. Building on the seminal SDE Lie-symmetry theory of Gaeta and Quintero (1999), which formalizes Lie-point SDE symmetries and their relation to Fokker-Planck symmetries, LieStoNet learns neural surrogates for drift and diffusion from increments, then learns projectable generators by enforcing the SDE determining equations, separately regularizing for closure under Lie brackets, adherence to the Lie algebra axioms (bilinearity, antisymmetry, Jacobi), and a non-redundant independent basis. The surrogate also defines an associated Fokker-Planck equation, enabling optional discovery of its Lie-point symmetries in parallel. Across multiple canonical SDEs with known analytic symmetries, LieStoNet recovers generators consistent with the ground-truth symmetry algebra, providing interpretable symmetry discovery for noisy dynamics. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/sumit-sinha-seas/LieStoNet_Final.git}{this link}.

AI.tldr: LieStoNet是一个无需模板的端到端框架，用于直接从时空轨迹中发现随机微分方程(SDE)的Lie点对称性，无需预先指定对称群、模板或规范坐标。该方法通过学习漂移和扩散的神经代理模型，并强制满足SDE判定方程，同时正则化Lie括号闭合性、Lie代数公理和独立基，从而恢复与真实对称代数一致的发生子。
AI.motivation: 对称性在现代机器学习和物理学中至关重要，但随机动力系统的连续对称性通常未知，且SDE的对称性发现此前基本未被探索。现有的对称性发现方法多针对确定性系统，需要预先指定对称群或模板，这限制了其在随机动力学中的应用。
AI.method: LieStoNet基于Gaeta和Quintero(1999)的SDE Lie对称理论，从状态增量中学习漂移和扩散的神经代理，然后通过学习投影生成元并强制执行SDE判定方程来实现对称性发现。框架还分别正则化Lie括号闭合性、Lie代数公理（双线性、反对称、Jacobi恒等式）以及非冗余独立基。代理模型还定义了相应的Fokker-Planck方程，可选地并行发现其Lie点对称性。
AI.result: 在多个具有已知解析对称性的经典SDE上，LieStoNet恢复的发生子与真实对称代数一致，提供了对含噪动力学的可解释对称性发现。
AI.conclusion: LieStoNet首次实现了对SDE的Lie点对称性自动发现，填补了随机动力系统对称性发现的研究空白，为噪声动力学中的对称性理解提供了可解释的工具。

title: Evidence for superconductivity at 190 K in a pressure-overdoped cuprate
summary: It is well established that the critical temperature ($T_c$) of cuprate superconductors can be tuned by pressure. For example, compression decouples the hole doping from chemical doping allowing for overdoped samples far beyond what is possible at ambient pressure. In this work, multiple techniques are used to probe the onset of the Meissner effect at $T_c$ as a function of pressure in $\mathrm{Pb_{0.4}Bi_{1.6}Sr_2Ca_2Cu_3O_{10+δ}}$ (Bi-2223) to 60 GPa in different compression environments. Samples compressed under quasihydrostatic conditions exhibit a distinctive non-monotonic pressure dependence of $T_c$ below 25 GPa, in agreement with previous reports. With further increase in pressure $T_c$ climbs continuously to 190 K at 60 GPa. Evidence for critical temperatures exceeding those reported to date for cuprates at ambient and high pressures, the results may be understood in terms of the proposed second superconducting regime at high hole doping.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Bi-2223铜氧化物超导体在60 GPa压力下的超导转变温度（Tc）行为。在准静水压条件下，样品在25 GPa以下呈现非单调的Tc压力依赖关系；随着压力继续增加，Tc持续攀升至60 GPa时的190 K，超过了此前报道的铜氧化物超导体临界温度。这一现象可能对应高空穴掺杂下的第二超导区域。
AI.motivation: 压力是调控铜氧化物超导体Tc的重要工具，它可以将空穴掺杂与化学掺杂解耦，使得样品能够达到环境压力下无法实现的过掺杂状态。探索高压下的超导行为有助于理解铜氧化物超导机制，并寻找更高的临界温度。
AI.method: 在准静水压和不同压缩环境下，利用多种实验技术探测Pb0.4Bi1.6Sr2Ca2Cu3O10+δ（Bi-2223）样品在最高60 GPa压力下Meissner效应（超导转变）的起始温度Tc。
AI.result: 准静水压条件下，25 GPa以下Tc呈现非单调的压力依赖（与先前报道一致）；压力继续增加时，Tc连续上升至60 GPa时的190 K，超过了迄今报道的环境压力及高压下铜氧化物超导体的临界温度。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在高空穴掺杂区域存在第二超导区域（second superconducting regime）的假说，这为理解铜氧化物高温超导机制及探索更高Tc提供了新的方向。

title: Skyrmion Excitations in the $ν=-1$ Quantum Hall state in Monolayer Graphene
summary: We investigate the skyrmion excited states atop the $SU(4)$ quantum Hall ferromagnetic ground state at filling factor $ν=-1$ in monolayer graphene. The competition among short-range anisotropic interactions, the Zeeman coupling, and sublattice symmetry-breaking potential gives rise to four distinct spin-valley-ordered ground-state phases. Combining effective field theory with the Hartree--Fock approximation, we develop a variational framework that incorporates both the long-range Coulomb interaction and the symmetry-breaking terms on an equal footing. Variational minimization determines the optimal skyrmion texture, including both its spatial radial profile and internal $SU(4)$ spinor structure. We establish the phase diagram of skyrmion excitations, identify thirteen distinct skyrmion phases under different external-field conditions, and determine their spin-valley textures, energies, and characteristic sizes. The robustness of the results against different radial ansätze demonstrates the reliability of our variational approach. Our work provides a systematic framework for studying skyrmion excitations in multicomponent quantum Hall ferromagnets and can be naturally extended to more general $SU(4)$ quantum Hall systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了单层石墨烯在填充因子ν=-1处SU(4)量子霍尔铁磁基态上的斯格明子激发态。通过有效场论与Hartree-Fock近似的变分框架，同时考虑长程库仑相互作用和对称性破缺项，确定了最优斯格明子纹理。研究建立了斯格明子激发相图，识别出十三种不同的斯格明子相，并确定了它们的自旋-谷纹理、能量和特征尺寸。
AI.motivation: 理解多组分量子霍尔铁磁体中的斯格明子激发，特别是单层石墨烯中SU(4)对称性下自旋-谷自由度的竞争效应，以及不同对称性破缺项如何影响斯格明子的结构和性质。
AI.method: 结合有效场论与Hartree-Fock近似，建立变分框架，将长程库仑相互作用与短程各向异性相互作用、Zeeman耦合及子格对称性破缺势能置于同等地位处理。通过变分最小化确定最优斯格明子纹理，包括空间径向轮廓和内部SU(4)旋量结构。
AI.result: 建立了斯格明子激发相图，识别出十三种在不同外场条件下的不同斯格明子相，确定了它们的自旋-谷纹理、能量和特征尺寸。通过对不同径向ansätze的对比验证了结果的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为研究多组分量子霍尔铁磁体中的斯格明子激发提供了系统框架，可自然推广到更一般的SU(4)量子霍尔系统。

title: Machine-Learning-Accelerated Metallene Stabilization from High-Throughput Sandwich Modeling
summary: Metallenes have appealing properties, but stabilizing them in a monolayer phase poses challenges for their synthesis. A recent experiment showed that the van der Waals squeezing method can stabilize certain metallenes in a MoS2 sandwich. This pioneering work motivates systematic studies, but such studies are experimentally impractical, while first-principles modeling remains prohibitive. Here, armed with universal machine-learning interatomic potentials, we constructed 1620 metallene sandwich heterostructures containing 6 different sandwich layers and 45 metals. We performed phonon calculations, which revealed 1208 dynamically stable structures. We found that transition-metal dichalcogenides, particularly MoSe2, are highly effective in stabilizing metallenes. Specifically, buckled hexagonal and honeycomb crystal lattices exhibit the greatest stability. We further evaluated the thermal stability of selected heterostructures with density-functional theory molecular dynamics simulations at room temperature. By uncovering the physical and chemical factors governing the stabilization of metallenes, our results provide systematic insights to guide and accelerate synthesis for future applications.

AI.tldr: 本文利用通用机器学习原子间势，系统构建了1620个金属烯三明治异质结构（包含6种夹层材料和45种金属），通过声子计算发现1208个动态稳定结构，揭示过渡金属二硫族化物（尤其是MoSe2）对稳定金属烯最为有效，并识别出buckled六边形和蜂窝晶格具有最高稳定性。该工作为金属烯的合成提供了系统性指导。
AI.motivation: 金属烯具有诱人的性质，但其单层相的稳定化面临合成挑战。近期实验证明范德华挤压法可在MoS2三明治结构中稳定某些金属烯，但系统性研究在实验上不可行，而第一性原理建模计算成本过高，亟需高效的计算方法进行大规模筛选。
AI.method: 使用通用机器学习原子间势（universal machine-learning interatomic potentials）构建了1620个金属烯三明治异质结构（6种夹层×45种金属），并执行声子（phonon）计算以评估动态稳定性；对筛选出的代表性结构进一步采用密度泛函理论分子动力学（DFT-MD）模拟评估其在室温下的热稳定性。
AI.result: 在1620个结构中发现了1208个动态稳定的结构。过渡金属二硫族化物（TMDs）特别是MoSe2在稳定金属烯方面最为有效。buckled六边形和蜂窝晶格表现出最大的稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 通过揭示控制金属烯稳定化的物理和化学因素，为未来金属烯的合成及实际应用提供了系统性的见解和加速合成指导。

title: Interplay of spin-orbit coupling, crystal field splitting and correlations: a ghost rotationally invariant slave boson treatment
summary: We investigate the interplay of spin-orbit coupling, crystal field splittings, and electronic correlations in the $t_{2g}$ Hubbard-Kanamori model within the recently formulated ghost rotationally invariant slave-boson method (GRISB). In particular, we study a tight binding model of Sr$_2$RuO$_4$ with parameters extracted from density functional theory and linearized quasiparticle self-consistent GW (LQSGW) calculations; we study the behavior of different physical quantities as the number of ghosts increases to examine the convergence of GRISB to dynamical mean field theory (DMFT) and experimental results; and we leverage the ability of GRISB to investigate the model over a wide range of parameters at low temperature. In particular, we examine both static and dynamical observables driven by the spin orbit coupling (SOC) and study how they vary as a function of the Hubbard $U$ and Hund's coupling $J$. GRISB converges quickly for most of these observables, and the calculations reveal the following: $U$ enhances the spin-orbit coupling while $J$ suppresses it. We also study the shape of the Fermi surface within different methodologies, and examine the Lifshitz transition which takes place as a function of strain in this material.

AI.tldr: 本文利用最新发展的ghost旋转不变slave-boson方法（GRISB）研究t₂g Hubbard-Kanamori模型中自旋轨道耦合、晶体场劈裂和电子关联之间的相互作用，并以Sr₂RuO₄为具体研究对象，系统考察了该方法向DMFT收敛的行为以及U和J对自旋轨道耦合的调控作用。
AI.motivation: 理解Sr₂RuO₄等强关联材料中自旋轨道耦合与电子关联的相互作用是凝聚态物理的关键问题，但DMFT等精确方法计算成本高昂，难以在大范围参数空间中系统研究。GRISB作为一种新方法，有望在较低计算成本下准确描述这些物理效应，因此需要系统验证其收敛性和可靠性。
AI.method: 采用GRISB方法研究t₂g Hubbard-Kanamori模型，基于DFT和LQSGW提取的Sr₂RuO₄紧束缚模型参数。通过增加ghost数量考察GRISB向DMFT的收敛行为，在低温下于大范围U和J参数空间中研究静态和动力学可观测量（尤其是自旋轨道耦合驱动的物理量），并考察费米面形状及应变诱导的Lifshitz相变。
AI.result: GRISB方法对大多数可观测量收敛迅速。关键发现：U增强自旋轨道耦合效应，而J抑制自旋轨道耦合。此外，系统研究了不同方法下费米面形状的差异，并考察了应变作用下发生的Lifshitz相变。
AI.conclusion: GRISB方法能够在低计算成本下高效、准确地研究包含自旋轨道耦合的强关联模型，为理解Sr₂RuO₄中U和J对自旋轨道耦合的相反调控作用以及应变驱动的费米面拓扑转变提供了系统的理论依据。

title: An essay on $d_0$ in neutron-based strain measurement techniques: equilibrium-based methods for non-destructive $d_0$ estimation
summary: Determination of the stress-free reference lattice spacing, $d_0$, is a central and often underestimated difficulty in diffraction-based strain measurement. Although commonly treated as a material constant, $d_0$ often varies with position and measurement direction as a result of composition, phase, texture and residual stress at the sub-bulk scale. While direct measurement of $d_0$ from coupons is usually preferable, this is sometimes impractical or even impossible. This paper reviews the $d_0$ problem in general and develops a hierarchy of non-destructive alternatives based on mechanical equilibrium. This ranges from established techniques based on force-balance, to the application of boundary conditions and finally an approach based on point-wise equilibrium within a sample, implemented through eigenstrain analysis. In all cases, examples are provided in the form of real samples including an additively manufactured Inconel cube, ancient Roman bronze medical probes and an ancient bronze dagger of purported Persian origin. These latter examples demonstrate that equilibrium can provide a practical physical constraint for estimating $d_0$ when destructive reference measurements are entirely inappropriate.

AI.tldr: 本文系统回顾了衍射应变测量中无应力参考晶格间距d₀的确定问题，并提出了一套基于机械平衡的非破坏性替代方法层次结构，涵盖力平衡、边界条件及逐点平衡（特征应变分析）等方法，并通过增材制造Inconel立方体、古罗马青铜医疗器械和疑似波斯古青铜匕首等实际样品进行了验证。
AI.motivation: d₀是衍射应变测量的核心参数，但常被误认为是材料常数，实际上会随位置和测量方向变化（受成分、相、织构和亚块体尺度残余应力影响）。直接测量d₀虽理想，但在许多场景下不切实际甚至不可能，尤其对于珍贵文物等不可破坏的样品，亟需开发非破坏性替代方案。
AI.method: 论文构建了基于机械平衡的d₀非破坏性估计方法层次结构：(1) 基于力平衡的传统技术；(2) 应用边界条件的方法；(3) 基于样品内逐点平衡并结合特征应变分析的方法。每个层次均通过实际样品进行验证。
AI.result: 通过增材制造Inconel立方体、古罗马青铜医疗器械和疑似波斯古青铜匕首三个实际样品验证了不同层次方法的可行性，尤其证明了在完全不适用破坏性参考测量的场景下，机械平衡可作为估计d₀的实用物理约束。
AI.conclusion: 机械平衡原理可为d₀的估计提供实用的物理约束，形成从力平衡到逐点平衡（特征应变分析）的方法层次。该方法对于不可破坏样品的衍射应变测量具有重要意义，为d₀问题提供了系统的非破坏性解决方案。

title: Degradation of Proton Exchange Membrane Water Electrolyzers in Accelerated Stress Tests of Dynamic Load Cycling
summary: Proton exchange membrane water electrolysis (PEMWE) is a promising technology for harnessing intermittent renewable energy. This study experimentally investigates the degradation of PEMWE under fluctuating power supply, characterized by dynamic load cycling under accelerated stress test (AST). We focus on the effects of key parameters of dynamic loading, including the peak voltage and cycling frequency, in a set of simplified AST protocols designed to represent selected features of dynamic load fluctuations associated with variable renewable-energy operation. The results unveil the intricate relationship between the structural characteristics of the catalyst layer and the electrochemical performance. An elevated peak voltage accelerates the degradation in the initial phase of the AST. However, a low cycling frequency can mitigate the degradation by limiting the rise in various resistance forms, whereas a higher cycling frequency exacerbates the degradation primarily by increasing mass transport resistance, suggesting a frequency-sensitive deterioration of the system's components.

AI.tldr: 本文实验研究了质子交换膜水电解（PEMWE）在波动电源（动态负载循环）下的降解行为，重点考察了峰值电压和循环频率两个关键参数对降解的影响，揭示了催化剂层结构特征与电化学性能之间的复杂关系。
AI.motivation: PEMWE是利用间歇性可再生能源的关键技术，但实际运行中电力波动会导致系统降解。理解动态负载下关键参数（峰值电压、循环频率）对降解的影响机制，对于优化PEMWE的运行策略和延长寿命至关重要。
AI.method: 通过加速应力测试（AST）设计了一套简化的动态负载循环协议，系统性地改变峰值电压和循环频率两个参数，用以模拟可变可再生能源运行中动态负载波动的典型特征，并进行实验研究。
AI.result: 研究发现：较高的峰值电压会加速AST初期阶段的降解；低循环频率可通过限制各种电阻形式的增长来缓解降解，而高循环频率主要通过增加传质阻力加剧降解，表明系统部件存在频率敏感的劣化机制。
AI.conclusion: 峰值电压和循环频率对PEMWE的动态降解具有差异化影响，揭示了催化剂层结构与性能间的内在联系，为实际可再生能源场景下PEMWE的寿命预测和运行优化提供了实验依据。

title: Universal Scaling of the Magnetocaloric Effect in 2D Ising Monolayers and Bilayer
summary: We report a Monte Carlo study of the magnetocaloric effect (MCE) in two-dimensional ferromagnetic Ising models on square, honeycomb, and triangular lattices with monolayer and bilayer configurations. Using Binder cumulant analysis, we determine the critical temperature ($T_c$) of each structure and find that $T_c$ increases with coordination number, from the honeycomb ($r=3$) to the triangular ($r=6$) lattice. In contrast, the magnetic entropy change ($-ΔS_M$) decreases with coordination number, reaching its maximum for the honeycomb lattice. After normalization by their peak values and appropriate temperature scaling, both $-ΔS_M$ and the field exponent $n$ collapse onto universal master curves for different magnetic fields and across all six lattice structures at a fixed low field. This demonstrates universal MCE scaling independent of coordination number and layer count. Critical scaling analysis further supports the observed universality and power-law behavior. Unlike $-ΔS_M$, the adiabatic temperature change ($ΔT_{ad}$) increases with coordination number, whereas the magnetic Grüneisen parameter ($Γ_M$) follows the same trend as $-ΔS_M$. Although the peak value of $-ΔS_M$ decreases with coordination number, the relative cooling power and cooling capacity remain nearly unchanged due to compensating broadening of the $-ΔS_M$ curves. The field dependence of $-ΔS_M$, relative cooling power, and cooling capacity follows power laws up to $\sim2.6$ T (assuming $J\approx1$ meV). Hysteresis analysis shows that lattices with lower coordination numbers exhibit a faster reduction in loop width with increasing temperature. These results establish the universal scaling behavior of the magnetocaloric effect in two-dimensional monolayer and bilayer magnetic lattices and provide guidelines for designing magnetic refrigerants.

AI.tldr: 本文通过蒙特卡洛模拟研究了二维铁磁Ising模型（方形、蜂窝、三角晶格，单层和双层构型）的磁热效应，发现临界温度随配位数增加而升高，但磁熵变却随之降低。通过归一化和温度缩放，所有晶格结构的磁熵变和场指数n均坍缩到通用主曲线上，证明了与配位数和层数无关的普适标度行为。
AI.motivation: 理解二维磁性材料中的磁热效应（MCE）及其普适标度行为，为设计高效磁制冷工质提供理论基础和设计指南。作者特别关注不同晶格几何（配位数）和层数如何影响磁热性能，以及是否存在跨结构的普适规律。
AI.method: 采用蒙特卡洛模拟方法，对三种2D晶格（square, honeycomb, triangular）的单层和双层结构进行模拟。使用Binder累积量分析确定临界温度；计算磁熵变(-ΔS_M)、绝热温度变化(ΔT_ad)、磁Grüneisen参数(Γ_M)、相对制冷功率(RCP)和制冷容量等关键磁热参数；通过归一化和温度缩放检验普适标度；进行临界标度分析和磁滞分析。
AI.result: 1) 临界温度随配位数从蜂窝(r=3)到三角(r=6)递增；2) 磁熵变峰值随配位数递减，蜂窝晶格最大；3) 所有六种结构的-ΔS_M和场指数n在归一化后坍缩到通用主曲线，验证了普适标度；4) ΔT_ad与配位数正相关，而Γ_M与-ΔS_M趋势相同；5) RCP和制冷容量几乎不随配位数变化（曲线展宽补偿了峰值下降）；6) 场依赖性在~2.6 T内遵循幂律；7) 低配位数晶格的磁滞回线宽度随温度下降更快。
AI.conclusion: 二维单层和双层磁晶格中的磁热效应表现出普适标度行为，与配位数和层数无关。该普适性为设计二维磁制冷材料提供了重要指导原则，表明可以通过调节晶格几何来优化特定的磁热参数（如磁熵变或绝热温度变化），而不牺牲整体制冷能力。

title: Anisotropic transport of Josephson vortices in atomic-layer superconductors on vicinal surfaces
summary: Atomic steps have strong influences on surface two-dimensional superconductors. Josephson vortices formed at the atomic steps under magnetic fields may dominate transport phenomena at low temperatures, but its experimental verification is still lacking. Here, we report the vortex transport properties of atomic-layer superconductor Si(111)-$(\sqrt{7}\times\sqrt{3})$-In with vicinal surfaces, for which Josephson vortices are directly observed by scanning tunneling microscopy. A sharp drop in resistance with decreasing temperature $T$, detected under out-of-plane magnetic field $B$, reveals a distinctive anisotropy with respect to the atomic step direction. The anisotropy of sheet resistance, proportional to that of vortex mobility, amounts to the order of $10^3$ at intermediate magnetic fields. In the high-$T$ and low-$B$ region, Josephson vortices exhibit thermally excited creep motions with anisotropic activation energy $U_\mathrm{act}$. A further increase in $B$ suppresses $U_\mathrm{act}$ toward zero anisotropically, resulting in one-dimensional pinning-free vortex flow at $0.10 \lesssim B \lesssim 0.20$ T. At the lowest temperatures, the vortex motion is governed by quantum tunneling. A $B$-$T$ phase diagram constructed based on these measurements reveals multiple regions characterized by directionally dependent vortex-transport mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过扫描隧道显微镜直接观测到Si(111)-(√7×√3)-In原子层超导体台阶面上的约瑟夫森涡旋，发现涡旋输运表现出显著的各向异性：电阻的急剧下降、涡旋迁移率各向异性高达10^3量级、热激活爬行、一维无钉扎涡旋流以及量子隧穿等多种输运机制，并据此构建了B-T相图。
AI.motivation: 原子台阶对表面二维超导体有强烈影响，在磁场下原子台阶处形成的约瑟夫森涡旋可能主导低温输运现象，但此前缺乏实验验证。作者希望填补这一空白，直接观测并表征台阶诱导的约瑟夫森涡旋的输运行为。
AI.method: 选择具有邻晶面的原子层超导体Si(111)-(√7×√3)-In作为研究对象，利用扫描隧道显微镜（STM）直接观测约瑟夫森涡旋，并在不同温度和面外磁场条件下测量电阻，分析电阻各向异性与原子台阶方向的关系，提取涡旋迁移率、激活能等关键参数。
AI.result: 发现面外磁场下电阻随温度降低的急剧下降呈现原子台阶方向相关的显著各向异性，涡旋迁移率各向异性达10^3量级；在中高磁场区涡旋呈热激活蠕变且激活能各向异性；在0.10-0.20 T区间出现一维无钉扎涡旋流；最低温区涡旋运动由量子隧穿主导，并据此构建了包含多个方向依赖输运机制的B-T相图。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次在实验上证实了原子台阶诱导的约瑟夫森涡旋对二维超导体输运的主导作用，揭示出丰富的各向异性涡旋输运行为，为理解台阶型超导体中的涡旋物理提供了重要实验基础。

title: Correlated Insulator Moiré Bolometer
comment: 37 pages and 20 figures (main text and SI together)
summary: Light incident on an insulator is generally not expected to turn it into a metal without invoking intense ultrafast excitation that leads to transient structural transitions. Here we show that magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene tuned to half filling of the moiré band provides a notable exception to this expectation. We find that weak beam of long-wavelength photons, with energies comparable to the flat-band width, selectively heat the low-heat-capacity electronic subsystem, thereby suppressing the correlated gap. This produces a giant resistance change governed not by a persistent photocarrier population, but by the extreme sensitivity of a many-body correlated gap to weak electronic heating. The resulting photon-driven insulator-to-metal transition produces a broadband low-noise photoresponse with voltage responsivity exceeding millivolts per nW of absorbed power. The mechanism is dual to superconducting hot-electron response: radiation-heated electrons suppress a many-body order, but in reverse the correlated insulator melts into a metal, providing robustness to magnetic fields of several tesla and a sharp insulator-to-metal resistive contrast. Our results establish correlated flat-band systems as a platform for ultra-sensitive detection of faint long-wavelength radiation.

AI.tldr: 本文发现在魔角扭曲双层石墨烯半填充状态（莫尔带半填充）下，弱长波光子束可通过选择性加热低热容电子子系统来抑制关联能隙，从而触发光子驱动的绝缘体-金属相变，实现宽带低噪声光响应，电压响应度超过毫伏/纳瓦。
AI.motivation: 传统观念认为，光照射绝缘体通常不会使其转变为金属，除非使用强超快激发导致瞬态结构转变。作者希望寻找例外情况，探索关联平带系统在弱光辐照下的新型光电响应机制。
AI.method: 利用魔角扭曲双层石墨烯在莫尔带半填充时的关联绝缘态；使用波长较长、能量与平带宽度相当（窄带宽度）的弱光子束选择性加热低热容电子子系统，从而抑制关联能隙，驱动绝缘体向金属转变。机制与超导热点响应相反：辐射加热电子抑制多体序，但这里关联绝缘体熔化为金属。
AI.result: 实现了宽带低噪声光响应，电压响应度超过毫伏每纳瓦吸收功率；该机制对几个特斯拉的磁场具有鲁棒性，并表现出尖锐的绝缘体-金属电阻对比度。
AI.conclusion: 关联平带系统可作为超灵敏探测微弱长波辐射的平台，为新型光电探测技术提供了可能性。

title: Breakdown of Universal Whirling Order in a Heisenberg Tsai-Type Approximant
summary: Noncoplanar whirling magnetic order has recently been proposed as a universal magnetic state in non-Heisenberg Tsai-type quasicrystal approximants. Here, X-ray resonant magnetic scattering measurements on Heisenberg and non-Heisenberg Au-Al-R (R = Gd, Tb) 1/1 approximants reveal a clear breakdown of this universality in the Heisenberg limit. While the non-Heisenberg Au-Al-Tb system is well described by the previously identified whirling magnetic structure, the Heisenberg Au-Al-Gd counterpart exhibits qualitatively different azimuthal-angle dependences that are incompatible with the universal whirling-order model. Despite nearly identical crystal structures and comparable magnetic energy scales, the two systems stabilize distinct antiferromagnetic ground states with the same propagation vector k = (1, 0, 0), demonstrating that the apparent universality of whirling order is not a consequence of Tsai-cluster geometry alone but requires spin anisotropy. These results further reveal the emergence of a competing manifold of nearly degenerate magnetic states in the Heisenberg limit.

AI.tldr: 本文通过X射线共振磁散射实验研究了Heisenberg和非Heisenberg Au-Al-R (R = Gd, Tb) 1/1近似晶体中的磁性序，发现非共面回旋磁性序的普适性在Heisenberg极限下被打破，表明该磁序需要自旋各向异性而非仅依赖Tsai团簇几何结构。
AI.motivation: 此前非共面回旋磁序被认为是非Heisenberg Tsai型准晶近似晶体的普适磁性基态，但其是否真的是普适的、以及其形成的物理机制（是否仅由团簇几何决定）尚不清楚。本文旨在检验这一普适性假说。
AI.method: 对Heisenberg Au-Al-Gd和非Heisenberg Au-Al-Tb 1/1近似晶体进行X射线共振磁散射测量，比较两者的方位角依赖关系，并与回旋磁序模型进行对比；同时比较两者的晶体结构和磁能尺度。
AI.result: 非Heisenberg Au-Al-Tb体系与已知的回旋磁结构高度吻合；而Heisenberg Au-Al-Gd体系展现出定性不同的方位角依赖，与普适回旋磁序模型不兼容。尽管两者晶体结构几乎相同且磁能尺度相当，但它们稳定了具有相同传播矢量k = (1,0,0)但性质不同的反铁磁基态。
AI.conclusion: 回旋磁序的表观普适性并非Tsai团簇几何结构的直接结果，而是需要自旋各向异性的参与。这一发现还揭示了在Heisenberg极限下存在竞争性的近简并磁态流形。

title: The AFLOW Library of Crystallographic Prototypes: Part 5
summary: The AFLOW library of crystallographic prototypes has been updated to incorporate an additional 344 entries, which now reaches 2,127 prototypes. ICSD and CCDC numbers have been added to the website alongside improvements to the user interface. New tutorials covering the basics of crystallography in the context of materials science have also been added. Lastly, we covered the current known applications of AFLOW prototype labels and materials data across research software.

AI.tldr: AFLOW晶体原型库已扩展到2,127个原型（新增344个），并在网站上添加了ICSD和CCDC编号、改进用户界面、新增晶体学教程，同时总结了AFLOW原型标签和材料数据在研究软件中的应用。
AI.motivation: 持续扩充和更新AFLOW晶体原型库，使其覆盖更全面的晶体结构类别，同时提升用户体验和资源可发现性，并明确该库在更广泛研究生态系统中的作用。
AI.method: 向AFLOW库中新增344个晶体原型条目（总数达2,127），在网站中集成ICSD和CCDC数据库编号，改进用户界面，添加晶体学基础教程，并系统梳理原型标签和材料数据在各类研究软件中的应用。
AI.result: AFLOW原型库达到2,127个晶体原型；网站功能增强（数据库编号链接、界面改进）；新增教学资源；全面综述了原型标签和数据在材料研究软件中的应用现状。
AI.conclusion: AFLOW晶体原型库通过持续扩充和功能升级，已成为材料科学中重要的晶体结构参考资源，并被广泛集成应用于各类研究软件中。

title: Committors and Reaction Rates from Trial Functions That Violate the Boundary Conditions
summary: The committor is the optimal reaction coordinate for a rare transition: it pinpoints the transition state and fixes the rate, and it governs events from protein folding to crystal nucleation. It minimises a Dirichlet energy, whose value at the minimum is the reactive flux, over functions that vanish on the reactant state and equal one on the product state. In high dimensions such a trial space is very hard to build. Here we rewrite the variational principle so that the boundary conditions are replaced by a normalisation of one boundary observable, the fidelity. Any trial function is then admissible, including functions that cannot satisfy the boundary values at all. On this basis we estimate the high-dimensional committor and rates from one-dimensional profiles along projected coordinates, taking as input only pre-existing equilibrium or reweighted configurations, a diffusion constant estimate, and the two state definitions. The optimum has a closed form that is cheap to evaluate. We obtain committors for AIB9 and villin HP-35 in full torsion space, and folding and unfolding rates for chignolin from umbrella sampling alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的变分原理来计算稀有转变的committor（最优反应坐标），通过用边界可观测量（fidelity）的归一化替代边界条件，使得任意试验函数都可接受。该方法仅需平衡或重新加权构象、扩散常数估计和两个态定义作为输入，即可从一维投影剖面估计高维committor和速率，且最优解具有闭式形式，计算便宜。作者在AIB9和villin HP-35的全扭转空间中获得了committor，并从伞形采样中获得了chignolin的折叠和去折叠速率。
AI.motivation: Committor是最优反应坐标，能精确定位过渡态并决定速率，对蛋白质折叠到晶体成核等过程至关重要。它最小化Dirichlet能量，但在高维空间中构建这样的试验空间非常困难，这是该领域的核心挑战。
AI.method: 将变分原理中的边界条件替换为对一个边界可观测量（fidelity）的归一化，使任何试验函数都可接受（包括无法满足边界值的函数）。在此基础上，从沿投影坐标的一维剖面估计高维committor和速率，输入仅为预存的平衡/重加权构象、扩散常数估计和两个态定义。最优解具有闭式形式，计算成本低。
