AI.result: 在AIB9和villin HP-35的全扭转空间中成功获得了committor估计，并仅通过伞形采样数据获得了chignolin的折叠和去折叠速率。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过放宽边界条件约束，实现了对高维committor和反应速率的实用估计，所需输入成本低，有望广泛应用于各类稀有转变研究。

title: Gap distributions between successive personal bests in cricket: Data and Models
summary: Successive personal best performances provide a natural measure of progression in an athlete's career. Classical record theory predicts a universal gap distribution, $P(g)\sim 1/g$, for independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) sequences. However, sporting careers are shaped by learning, aging, changes in ability, and external influences that violate these assumptions. We investigate the statistics of inter-record gaps, defined as the number of innings between successive personal best scores, in cricket. Using career records of leading Test, ODI, and T20 players obtained from ESPN Cricinfo. We find that the empirical distributions are well described by truncated power law $P(g) \propto g^{-α} e^{-λg}$ with exponents in the range (0.799 $\leq α\leq$ 0.843). Much of this deviation disappears when the temporal ordering of innings is destroyed, indicating that career evolution plays a key role in shaping record occurrence. Bootstrap-shuffled careers, which preserve individual score distributions and career lengths while removing temporal ordering, yield significantly larger exponents ($α\approx 0.939\text{--}0.979$). These findings show that the progression of personal best performances retains information about the temporal organization of a player's career and cannot be fully explained by simple stochastic record processes. More generally, they illustrate how record statistics are altered in nonstationary and path-dependent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究板球运动员个人最佳成绩之间的间隔（inter-record gaps）统计，发现其服从截断幂律分布，指数范围在0.799-0.843之间。通过bootstrap打乱时间顺序的对照实验表明，职业发展的时间演化对记录的塑造起关键作用，简单的随机记录过程无法解释观察到的现象。
AI.motivation: 经典记录理论预测独立同分布序列中的记录间隔遵循普适的1/g分布，但真实运动员生涯受学习、衰老、能力变化和外部因素影响，违反独立同分布假设。作者希望通过板球运动员的真实职业数据，检验记录间隔统计是否偏离经典理论，并探究职业演化（时间非平稳性）对记录统计的影响。
AI.method: 利用ESPN Cricinfo上顶尖Test、ODI和T20板球运动员的职业记录数据，计算连续个人最佳成绩之间的间隔（以局数为单位）。用截断幂律分布P(g) ∝ g^{-α} e^{-λg}拟合经验分布。作为对照，使用bootstrap方法打乱球员的局数顺序（保留个人得分分布和职业生涯长度），比较打乱前后的幂律指数差异。
AI.result: 经验分布很好地由截断幂律描述，指数α范围在0.799到0.843之间。当打乱局数的时间顺序后，指数显著增大到约0.939-0.979，更接近经典理论的预测。这表明时间顺序破坏后，大部分对经典理论的偏离消失。
AI.conclusion: 个人最佳成绩的进展保留了球员职业生涯时间组织的信息，不能完全由简单随机记录过程解释。该研究展示了在非平稳和路径依赖系统中记录统计如何被改变，对理解复杂系统中极端事件和记录行为具有更广泛的意义。

title: Bulk Ising superconductivity in an intercalated TaSe2 bilayer structure
summary: Ising spin-orbit coupling in bulk systems has drawn considerable interest for its ability to conveniently construct spin-orbit environments and enable exotic quantum phenomena. In this work, we synthesize intercalated 2Hb-TaSe$_2$ bilayers with noncentrosymmetric structure and, through multifaceted analysis, present multiple lines of evidence for the emergence of bulk Ising superconductivity. Resistivity measurements reveal anisotropic superconducting behavior, with a remarkably large in-plane upper critical field $B_{c2}^{\|}$ that exceeds the Pauli limit $B_{p}$. Band structure calculations further show band splitting accompanied by out-of-plane spin polarization. Collectively, these observations point to the presence of Ising superconductivity. Additional measurements of the thickness-dependent ratio $B_{c2}^{\|}$/$B_{p}$ and the superconducting diode effect not only further support the Ising superconducting nature of this material, but also reveal additional features of bulk Ising superconductivity evolving with thickness. Our findings provide valuable insights that may contribute to the search for bulk Ising superconductors.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过插层方法合成了非中心对称的2Hb-TaSe₂双层材料，并通过多种实验手段（电阻率测量、能带结构计算等）提供了体相Ising超导电性的多重证据，包括各向异性超导行为、超过Pauli极限的面内上临界场以及伴随面外自旋极化的能带劈裂。此外，厚度依赖的Bc2∥/Bp比值和超导二极管效应进一步揭示了体相Ising超导电性随厚度演化的特征。
AI.motivation: 体相系统中的Ising自旋轨道耦合因其能够方便地构建自旋轨道环境并实现奇异的量子现象而受到广泛关注，但体相Ising超导体的搜寻仍具挑战性，作者希望合成并确认这类材料。
AI.method: 合成插层2Hb-TaSe₂双层材料，采用电阻率测量表征超导行为和各向异性，通过能带结构计算分析能带劈裂和自旋极化，并结合厚度依赖的Bc2∥/Bp比值和超导二极管效应进行综合分析。
AI.result: 电阻率测量显示各向异性超导行为，面内上临界场Bc2∥显著超过Pauli极限Bp；能带结构计算显示伴随面外自旋极化的能带劈裂；厚度依赖测量和超导二极管效应进一步支持Ising超导特性并揭示其随厚度演化的特征。
AI.conclusion: 该工作在体相材料中确认了Ising超导电性的存在，为寻找体相Ising超导体提供了有价值的见解和新的研究方向。

title: Spin selectivity induced by non-collinear spins in Rashba wires
summary: We report a previously overlooked general mechanism to obtain highly efficient spin selectivity in conventional time-reversal symmetric one-dimensional systems without invoking phase decoherence. We reveal that Rashba quantum wires featuring non-collinear spin states at the Fermi level inherently possess spin-selective transport properties. We show that this spin noncollinearity can be systematically designed and engineered by introducing an additional pseudospin degree of freedom - such as valley, sublattice, or orbital angular momentum - into spin-orbit coupled systems. By applying this framework to multi-subband semiconducting quantum wires and oxide nanowires, we establish a generalized route toward quantum-coherent spin selectivity up to 10 %. Our findings offer practical design principles for spin-selective transport devices.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了一种在传统时间反演对称的一维系统中实现高效自旋选择性的通用机制，无需依赖相位退相干。研究发现Rashba量子线中费米能级上的非共线自旋态天然具备自旋选择性输运特性，可通过引入额外的赝自旋自由度（如谷、子晶格或轨道角动量）进行系统设计和调控，并在多子带半导体量子线和氧化物纳米线中实现了高达10%的量子相干自旋选择性。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为在时间反演对称系统中，由于Kramers简并的存在，自旋选择性输运难以实现，通常需要依赖相位退相干或磁性破缺机制。作者希望寻找一种无需相位退相干即可实现高效自旋选择性的通用机制，填补这一研究空白。
AI.method: 作者提出了一个理论框架：通过引入额外的赝自旋自由度（如谷、子晶格或轨道角动量）到自旋轨道耦合系统中，系统性地设计和调控Rashba量子线中费米能级的自旋非共线结构，从而工程化实现自旋选择性输运。该框架被应用于多子带半导体量子线和氧化物纳米线两类系统进行验证。
AI.result: 该机制在多子带半导体量子线和氧化物纳米线中实现了高达10%的量子相干自旋选择性，且不依赖于相位退相干过程。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为自旋选择性输运器件提供了实用的设计原则，开辟了在常规时间反演对称一维系统中实现高效自旋选择性的新路径。

title: Negative thermal expansion, lattice dynamics, and complex magnetism in TbFeO$_3$
summary: We report a temperature-dependent investigation of orthoferrite TbFeO$_3$ using x-ray diffraction, DC magnetization, and Raman scattering, complemented by room-temperature x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. X-ray diffraction reveals negative thermal expansion over 5-300 K, with a small but systematic increase in unit-cell volume upon cooling in the absence of any structural phase transition. Raman scattering measurements identify the Raman-active phonon modes and show clear deviations from the conventional Klemens anharmonic decay model, particularly in phonon frequencies, indicating the presence of spin-phonon coupling. Two modes of $A_g$ and $B_{1g}$ symmetry exhibit a crossover from Gaussian-dominated line shapes at low temperatures to mixed Gaussian-Lorentzian profiles at higher temperatures, reflecting a transition from inhomogeneous broadening to lifetime-driven dynamics. High-energy Raman spectra reveal two-magnon excitations associated with the Fe sublattice, consistent with linear spin-wave theory, whose spectral weight shows only weak temperature dependence. In addition, a broad Raman mode emerging below $\sim 175$ K exhibits an order-parameter-like temperature evolution and coincides with the onset of phonon anomalies, while no corresponding strong anomaly is observed in the two-magnon response. Taken together, these results establish TbFeO$_3$ as a system with pronounced interplay among lattice dynamics, spin correlations, and emergent local magnetic-lattice anomalies.

AI.tldr: 本文通过变温X射线衍射、直流磁化、拉曼散射及X射线光电子能谱对正交铁氧体TbFeO₃进行了系统研究，揭示了负热膨胀、自旋-声子耦合、双磁振子激发以及低温下新兴的局域磁-晶格异常等现象，确立了该材料中晶格动力学、自旋关联与局域磁结构之间复杂的相互作用。
AI.motivation: 理解TbFeO₃中晶格、自旋和磁结构之间的耦合机制，特别是负热膨胀现象及自旋-声子耦合的微观起源，为研究稀土正铁氧体家族的复杂物理性质提供基础。
AI.method: 综合运用变温X射线衍射（5-300 K）、直流磁化测量、变温拉曼散射光谱以及室温X射线光电子能谱，并结合线性自旋波理论对双磁振子激发进行分析。
AI.result: 发现：(1) 5-300 K范围内存在负热膨胀且无结构相变；(2) 拉曼声子频率偏离Klemens非谐衰减模型，表明存在自旋-声子耦合；(3) Ag和B1g模式从低温高斯线型转变为高温高斯-洛伦兹混合线型；(4) 高能拉曼谱中观察到与Fe子晶格相关的双磁振子激发，其谱权重对温度依赖较弱；(5) 约175 K以下出现一个具有序参量演化特征的新拉曼模式，与声子异常起始温度一致，但双磁振子响应无对应强异常。
AI.conclusion: TbFeO₃是一个展示晶格动力学、自旋关联与新兴局域磁-晶格异常之间显著相互作用的体系，为深入理解稀土正铁氧体中的多体耦合效应提供了重要实验证据。

title: Machine Learning Compatible CALPHAD-type Optimization from Phase Equilibria by Auto-differentiation
summary: To accurately determine phase boundaries and phase transitions, thermodynamic models that describe free energies of phases often have to be optimized based on experimentally observed phase equilibria. While different approaches exist for thermodynamic optimizations, these approaches are often implemented in ways that are not compatible with machine learning workflows that requires differentiable calculation of loss function. In this work, we derive a phase equilibrium loss function based on thermodynamic potentials that can be efficiently evaluated and enable gradient based optimization by auto-differentiation in the PyTorch package. By minimizing this loss function, general thermodynamic model parameters can be optimized with respect to experimental phase equilibria data. Using thermodynamic models in the CALculation of PHAse Diagram (CALPHAD) framework, We illustrate successful and efficient optimization in different systems including ternary ones with more than 100 parameters. As the loss function is defined independently of the details of the thermodynamic models, it can be used to optimize machine learning thermodynamic models in general. In particular, we demonstrate a top-down optimization of atomistic potential from target phase equilibria.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于热力学势的相平衡损失函数，可通过PyTorch自动微分实现梯度优化，用于根据实验相平衡数据优化热力学模型参数，并已成功应用于CALPHAD框架及机器学习热力学模型。
AI.motivation: 传统热力学优化方法不兼容需要可微损失函数的机器学习工作流，难以高效利用实验相平衡数据来优化热力学模型。
AI.method: 基于热力学势推导相平衡损失函数，利用PyTorch的自动微分实现梯度优化；损失函数定义与具体热力学模型无关，可泛化至任意模型。
AI.result: 在CALPHAD框架下成功高效优化了包括三元系在内超过100个参数的系统，并展示了从目标相平衡对原子间势进行自上而下优化的能力。
AI.conclusion: 该损失函数为将实验相平衡数据整合进机器学习驱动的热力学建模提供了通用且高效的途径。

title: Inhomogeneous Ising Model on 2D kagomé Lattice: Fermionic field approach
summary: We investigate the two-dimensional inhomogeneous Ising model (2DIM) on the kagom'e lattice by mapping it onto a particular non-symmetric eight-vertex model and constructing the corresponding $R$-matrix. Using a fermionic representation, we evaluate the partition function and derive explicit expressions for the main thermodynamic quantities. In the thermodynamic limit, we obtain an exact equation for the critical surface determining the phase transition of the model. We also calculate the free energy, specific heat, and spontaneous magnetization in the ferromagnetic case. Furthermore, we show that when one or two coupling constants vanish, the model reduces, respectively, to the square-lattice and one-dimensional Ising models. In both limits, our results reproduce the corresponding exact critical couplings and free energies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了kagomé晶格上的二维非均匀Ising模型(2DIM)，通过将其映射到非对称八顶角模型并构造相应的R矩阵，利用费米子表示计算了配分函数，推导出热力学量的显式表达式，得到了临界曲面的精确方程，并在铁磁情况下计算了自由能、比热和自发磁化强度。
AI.motivation: 二维Ising模型是统计力学中最重要的可解模型之一，但kagomé晶格上的非均匀Ising模型尚未被完全求解。通过建立与八顶角模型的联系并利用可积性，可以为这类模型的严格解提供新的途径。
AI.method: 将kagomé晶格上的2DIM映射到非对称八顶角模型，构造相应的R矩阵；利用费米子表示计算配分函数；在热力学极限下推导临界曲面的精确方程；计算自由能、比热和自发磁化强度等热力学量。
AI.result: 获得了临界曲面的精确方程；计算出铁磁情况下的自由能、比热和自发磁化强度；当部分耦合常数消失时，模型分别退化为方格晶格和一维Ising模型，且结果与已知精确解吻合。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为kagomé晶格上的非均匀Ising模型提供了完整的严格解框架，验证了在极限情况下与已知模型的一致性，对理解二维可积统计模型具有重要意义。

title: $d$-spacing distributions as a probe of nematoelastic response in iron-based superconductors
summary: Electronic nematicity in iron-based superconductors (FeSCs) couples bilinearly to orthorhombic strain, allowing nematic correlations to appear in the lattice response. Here we use neutron Larmor diffraction to measure the temperature-dependent distribution of relative $d$ spacings in electron-doped Ba(Fe$_{1-x}$Co$_x$)$_2$As$_2$, hole-doped Ba$_{0.83}$K$_{0.17}$Fe$_2$As$_2$, FeSe, and Fe$_{1.07}$Te. In Ba(Fe$_{1-x}$Co$_x$)$_2$As$_2$ crystals without intentionally applied uniaxial stress, the in-plane distribution width, $\varepsilon_{\rm FWHM}$, increases on cooling in the tetragonal phase and can be described phenomenologically by a Curie--Weiss-like form. The fitted scale $T^*$ decreases with Co doping and evolves similarly to the nematic phase diagram inferred from elastoresistance, although the two experiments probe different response functions. Related broadening in Ba$_{0.83}$K$_{0.17}$Fe$_2$As$_2$ and FeSe supports extending this interpretation beyond electron-doped BaFe$_2$As$_2$. By contrast, Fe$_{1.07}$Te shows no extended Curie--Weiss-like regime without applied stress, whereas uniaxial pressure produces a strongly anisotropic broadening that can contain contributions from both the field-biased lattice response and inhomogeneous loading. A mean-field model with bilinear nematoelastic coupling and spatially varying symmetry-breaking stress explains the Curie--Weiss-like broadening in terms of the renormalized orthorhombic compliance. Neutron Larmor diffraction therefore provides a bulk-sensitive probe of nematic-related lattice broadening that complements electronic and elastic measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文利用中子Larmor衍射技术，测量了多种铁基超导体中晶格d间距的分布宽度随温度的变化，发现电子掺杂和空穴掺杂的BaFe2As2体系以及FeSe在四方相中表现出居里-魏斯型的晶格展宽，其特征温度T*与向列相图演化一致，而Fe1.07Te则无此行为。通过平均场模型证明该展宽源于双线性向列-弹性耦合与空间变化的对称性破缺应力的相互作用，提供了一种体敏感的向列相关晶格响应探针。
AI.motivation: 铁基超导体中的电子向列性与正交晶格应变呈双线性耦合，导致向列涨落可出现在晶格响应中，但目前缺乏体敏感的晶格尺度探针来直接探测向列相关的晶格不均匀性。以往研究多依赖电子输运（如弹性电阻）或表面敏感的测量，需要一种能够反映体相晶格响应的方法来补充和完善向列相图的认知。
AI.method: 使用中子Larmor衍射技术测量温度依赖的相对d间距分布宽度（ε_FWHM），研究对象包括电子掺杂Ba(Fe1-xCox)2As2、空穴掺杂Ba0.83K0.17Fe2As2、FeSe和Fe1.07Te。实验分为无外加单轴应力条件和施加单轴压力两种情况，并结合平均场模型（含双线性向列弹性耦合和空间变化的对称性破缺应力）解释居里-魏斯型展宽的物理来源。
AI.result: 在Ba(Fe1-xCox)2As2中，无外加应力时面内分布宽度随冷却在四方相中增大，符合居里-魏斯型行为，拟合的T*随Co掺杂降低并沿弹性电阻得到的向列相图演化。类似展宽也在Ba0.83K0.17Fe2As2和FeSe中观察到。Fe1.07Te在无外加应力时无居里-魏斯型展宽，而在单轴压力下表现出强烈的各向异性展宽。平均场模型成功解释了居里-魏斯型展宽与重整化正交晶系柔量的关系。
AI.conclusion: 中子Larmor衍射提供了一种体敏感的向列相关晶格展宽探针，可补充电子和弹性测量手段，帮助更全面地理解铁基超导体的向列性及其与超导电性等性质的关联。

title: How NOT to build control-target gates in semiconductor quantum dots and beyond
summary: Universal quantum computation requires single-qubit control together with at least one entangling two-qubit gate. CNOT and CROT gates are two famous examples of such gates, wherein the state of one qubit (control) dictates the transformation applied to the other (target). By using a simple derivation motivated by symmetry, we show that current device architectures of semiconductor-based quantum dot devices prevent efficient implementation of a CNOT and other asymmetric control-target gates via Heisenberg exchange, Coulomb repulsion, or other interaction that is invariant under spin exchange. Guided by this general principle, we propose a heterogeneous blueprint of double quantum dot devices that enables efficient implementation of the CNOT by breaking the spin exchange symmetry. Crucially, our numerical simulations predict that this novel device blueprint can enable a single-pulse fault-tolerant 100-ns CNOT gate in isotopically purified silicon.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对称性论证表明，基于自旋交换不变相互作用（如海森堡交换、库仑排斥）的现有半导体量子点架构无法高效实现CNOT门。作者提出一种打破自旋交换对称性的异质双量子点器件蓝图，数值模拟预测可在同位素纯化的硅中实现单脉冲、容错、100纳秒的CNOT门。
AI.motivation: 通用量子计算需要单量子比特控制加上至少一个纠缠双量子比特门，CNOT和CROT是典型例子。现有半导体量子点器件架构依赖自旋交换不变（spin-exchange invariant）的相互作用，但作者怀疑这种对称性限制了非对称控制-目标门（如CNOT）的高效实现，因此需要从原理上澄清这一限制并寻找突破方案。
AI.method: 作者通过一个由对称性驱动的简单推导，证明了基于自旋交换不变相互作用（海森堡交换、库仑排斥等）的现有量子点设备架构无法高效实现CNOT及其他非对称控制-目标门。基于该一般性原理，他们提出了一种异质双量子点（heterogeneous double quantum dot）器件蓝图，通过打破自旋交换对称性来实现高效的CNOT。
AI.result: 数值模拟预测，该新型器件蓝图能够在同位素纯化的硅中实现单脉冲、容错、100纳秒的CNOT门。
AI.conclusion: 这项研究为半导体量子点量子计算提供了一条清晰的设计原则：要实现高效的CNOT等非对称逻辑门，必须打破自旋交换对称性。所提出的异质量子点方案有望在实际硅基器件中实现高速、容错的CNOT门，对通用量子计算具有重要意义。

title: Spin-orbit-entangled frustrated magnetism in fcc Ba$_2$(Yb,Nd)NbO$_6$ double perovskites
summary: The search for candidate Kitaev materials has largely focused on 4$d$ and 5$d$ transition-metal compounds with various lattice geometries. In contrast, investigations of rare-earth 4$f$ systems have thus far been restricted mainly to honeycomb and triangular lattices. In this work, we investigate the rare-earth-based double perovskites Ba$_2$YbNbO$_6$ and Ba$_2$NdNbO$_6$, which crystallize in a face-centered cubic structure. Magnetization and heat-capacity measurements establish isolated ${j_{\rm eff}} = 1/2$ Kramers doublet ground states arising from strong spin-orbit coupling (SOC) and crystal electric-field effects, which are further supported by density-functional theory calculations. Millikelvin-temperature thermodynamic measurements reveal long-range magnetic order with moderate frustration in both compounds. The emergence of magnetic order may be understood within an order-by-disorder scenario, as theoretically proposed for rare-earth fcc lattices with finite Kitaev interactions. Our results thus identify Ba$_2$YbNbO$_6$ and Ba$_2$NdNbO$_6$ as promising rare-earth spin-orbit-entangled magnets and motivate further experimental and theoretical investigations aimed at determining the complete exchange tensor to elucidate the microscopic origin of the underlying magnetic interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了两种稀土基双钙钛矿材料 Ba₂YbNbO₆ 和 Ba₂NdNbO₆，它们具有面心立方结构。通过磁化和比热测量，确认了由强自旋轨道耦合和晶体电场效应产生的孤立 j_eff=1/2 Kramers 双重态基态，并得到密度泛函理论计算的支持。毫开尔文温度的测量揭示了两种化合物中存在具有中等阻挫的长程磁有序，可通过理论上提出的"有序由无序"机制理解。该工作将这两种材料确定为有前景的稀土自旋轨道纠缠磁体。
AI.motivation: Kitaev 材料的搜索主要集中在 4d 和 5d 过渡金属化合物，而对稀土 4f 体系的研究仅限于蜂窝和三角晶格。作者希望探索面心立方结构中稀土基材料作为 Kitaev 候选材料的可能性。
AI.method: 对 Ba₂YbNbO₆ 和 Ba₂NdNbO₆ 进行磁化率和比热测量，结合密度泛函理论计算，在毫开尔文温度下进行热力学测量以研究磁有序行为。
AI.result: 两种化合物均表现出由强自旋轨道耦合和晶体电场效应产生的孤立 j_eff=1/2 Kramers 双重态基态；在毫开尔文温度下观察到具有中等阻挫的长程磁有序，其行为与稀土面心立方晶格中具有有限 Kitaev 相互作用的"有序由无序"理论预测一致。
AI.conclusion: Ba₂YbNbO₆ 和 Ba₂NdNbO₆ 被确认为有前景的稀土自旋轨道纠缠磁体，为深入理解面心立方晶格中的 Kitaev 相互作用和磁有序微观机制提供了新的研究平台。

title: Spin- and Angle-resolved Photoelectron Spectroscopy Study of the Quantum Spin Hall Insulator Bismuthene and its Precursor Phase
summary: Recent studies have revealed that a confined bismuth layer at the graphene/SiC interface can be reversibly switched between a topologically trivial precursor phase and the quantum spin Hall insulator bismuthene. Here, we present a detailed spin- and angle-resolved photoelectron spectroscopy study of both structures, resolving the spin texture of their low-energy electronic states. Owing to the strong intrinsic spin-orbit coupling of bismuth and the asymmetric confinement potential at the interface, the valence bands of both structures are Rashba-split. We demonstrate the expected spin-momentum locking for both phases and Kramers' doublets through the investigation of the valence bands' spin polarization at multiple positions in reciprocal space.

AI.tldr: 本文通过自旋和角度分辨光电子能谱（SARPES）详细研究了石墨烯/SiC界面处受限铋层的两种相：拓扑平庸的前驱相和量子自旋霍尔绝缘体铋烯，解析了它们低能电子态的自旋织构，证实了两相中价带均因强自旋轨道耦合和非对称限制势而发生Rashba劈裂，并展示了预期的自旋-动量锁定和Kramers双重态。
AI.motivation: 此前研究已发现石墨烯/SiC界面处的受限铋层可在拓扑平庸相与量子自旋霍尔绝缘体（铋烯）之间可逆切换，但对其低能电子态的自旋织构缺乏详细的实验表征。理解两相的自旋-动量锁定关系对于拓扑相变机制和自旋电子学应用至关重要。
AI.method: 采用自旋和角度分辨光电子能谱（spin- and angle-resolved photoelectron spectroscopy, SARPES），在倒空间多个位置测量两相结构价带的自旋极化，以解析Rashba劈裂能带的自旋织构并验证Kramers双重态。
AI.result: 两相结构的价带均因铋的强本征自旋轨道耦合和界面处非对称限制势而发生Rashba劈裂；通过多个倒空间位置的测量，证实了两相均表现出预期的自旋-动量锁定行为以及Kramers双重态。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了两种可切换相（拓扑平庸前驱相与量子自旋霍尔绝缘体铋烯）的低能电子态自旋织构的直接实验证据，深化了对界面受限铋层拓扑相变中自旋电子结构的理解。

title: Front Selection Is Not Determined by Renormalization-Group Stability
summary: The Fisher--Kolmogorov--Petrovsky--Piskunov equation provides a paradigmatic example of front propagation and asymptotic-state selection. Using a unified renormalization-group (RG) framework, we show that its traveling-wave solutions form a continuous family of RG fixed points and that all fronts with $v \ge 2$ are RG-stable. Nevertheless, the asymptotically selected front is not determined by RG stability. The FKPP equation therefore provides an explicit example in which RG fixed-point stability and asymptotic-state selection are distinct concepts.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过统一的重整化群（RG）框架分析了Fisher-Kolmogorov-Petrovsky-Piskunov（FKPP）方程，发现其行波解构成连续族的RG不动点，且所有速度v≥2的前锋都是RG稳定的。然而，渐近态选择并不由RG稳定性决定，这表明RG不动点稳定性与渐近态选择是两个不同的概念。
AI.motivation: FKPP方程是前锋传播和渐近态选择的经典范例，但长期以来关于RG稳定性与渐近态选择之间的关系存在模糊认识。本文旨在澄清RG框架下二者是否等价的问题。
AI.method: 采用统一的重整化群（RG）框架分析FKPP方程的行波解，考察其速度谱中所有v≥2的前锋解的RG稳定性，并将其与系统实际的渐近态选择行为进行比较。
AI.result: FKPP方程的行波解构成连续族的RG不动点；所有v≥2的前锋均是RG稳定的；但渐近选定的前锋并非由RG稳定性决定，RG稳定性与渐近态选择是两个独立的概念。
AI.conclusion: FKPP方程为RG不动点稳定性不等于渐近态选择提供了明确的反例，提示在研究非线性动力学系统时，需要区分这两个概念，不能简单地将RG稳定性等同于实际的渐近行为选择。

title: Electron-like high-temperature superconductivity induced by compressive strain in La2PrNi2O7 thin films
summary: The realization of high-temperature superconductivity in bilayer nickelates under epitaxial compressive strain is widely interpreted as mimicking the effects of high hydrostatic pressure. To test the equivalence of these mechanisms, we investigated a comprehensive strain continuum ranging from compressive (-2.14%) to tensile (+0.91%). Crucially, via ozone-assisted atomic-layer epitaxy, we realized high-temperature superconductivity in as-grown La2PrNi2O7 films on NdAlO3 substrates, which induce the most extreme compressive strain in this material system. Under extreme compression (-2.14%), these films exhibit a Tc_onset of 60 K, zero resistance at 33 K, and a diamagnetic response at 20 K, with magnetotransport measurements confirming a quasi-two-dimensional superconducting nature. Comparing our phase diagram with reported data reveals distinct lattice responses: unlike in pressurized crystals, the superconducting window in epitaxial films diverges significantly in the out-of-plane parameter c (or c/ap ratio) but remains consistent with the bulk regarding the in-plane parameter ap. Crucially, while superconductivity in both systems emerges from the suppression of spin-density waves (SDW), Hall measurements reveal a fundamental electronic dichotomy: optimal superconducting films are intrinsically electron-like (exhibiting a negative Hall coefficient), in stark contrast to the hole-like nature (positive Hall coefficient) of high-pressure bulk crystals and non-superconducting tensile films. Ultimately, both tuning strategies effectively modulate the underlying correlation landscape - the true driver of superconductivity - transcending the constraints of specific Fermi surface topologies. This work establishes a macroscopic platform for probing the multi-orbital physics of nickelates, offering a new dimension for investigating high-temperature superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 本文通过臭氧辅助原子层外延技术，在NdAlO3基底上制备了La2PrNi2O7薄膜，在-2.14%极端压应变下实现了60 K起始转变温度的高温超导，并系统比较了外延应变与静水压两种调控机制对镍酸盐超导的影响，揭示了两者在晶格响应和电子特性上的根本差异，最终表明两种策略均通过调制关联景观而非费米面拓扑来驱动超导。
AI.motivation: 双层镍酸盐在外延压应变下的高温超导通常被认为与高压效果等效，但这种等效性尚未被严格验证。理解外延应变与静水压两种调控机制的异同对于阐明镍酸盐超导机理至关重要。
AI.method: 采用臭氧辅助原子层外延技术制备La2PrNi2O7薄膜，在NdAlO3基底上实现-2.14%的极端压应变，同时覆盖从-2.14%到+0.91%的完整应变连续区；结合磁输运、霍尔测量及相图对比系统研究超导性质。
AI.result: 在-2.14%压应变下薄膜呈现60 K起始超导转变、33 K零电阻和20 K抗磁响应，具有准二维超导特性。与高压体材料相比，外延薄膜在面外晶格参数c上超导窗口显著发散，而面内参数ap保持一致；两者超导均源于自旋密度波抑制，但最优超导薄膜呈电子型（负霍尔系数），与高压体材料的空穴型（正霍尔系数）截然不同。
AI.conclusion: 外延应变与高压通过共同调制关联景观这一根本驱动因素来实现超导，超越了具体费米面拓扑的限制。该工作建立了研究镍酸盐多轨道物理的宏观平台，为高温超导研究提供了新维度。

title: Magnetoelastic control of quantum correlations and field sensitivity in a spin-1/2 Heisenberg dimer
summary: We investigate the thermodynamic and quantum properties of a magnetoelastic spin-1/2 Heisenberg dimer, where the exchange interaction depends on the dimer displacement. By combining an exact treatment of the spin sector with a harmonic description of the vibrational degree of freedom, we obtain an effective model in which each spin configuration is associated with a distinct vibrational mode, leading to a non-factorizable partition function. We analyze the thermal behavior and identify regimes corresponding to entangled and fully polarized states. Quantum correlations are analyzed through concurrence and local quantum uncertainty, showing that while entanglement is rapidly suppressed by temperature, nonclassical correlations persist over a broader range due to the competition between spin sectors. We further examine the magnetic Fisher information, which provides a measure of the sensitivity of the system to the external magnetic field. Its behavior reveals enhanced response in crossover regions where magnetoelastic effects induce strong redistribution of the level populations. Our results demonstrate that magnetoelastic coupling plays a central role in controlling both quantum correlations and magnetic response, establishing a direct link between entanglement, nonclassical correlations, and thermodynamic sensitivity in coupled spin-dimer systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究磁弹性自旋-1/2海森堡二聚体的热力学与量子性质，其中交换相互作用依赖于二聚体的位移。通过精确处理自旋部分并用量谐振子描述振动自由度，作者构建了每个自旋构型对应不同振动模式的有效模型，得到不可分解的配分函数。分析了热行为、量子关联（并发度和局部量子不确定性）以及磁Fisher信息，发现磁弹性耦合在调控量子关联和磁响应中起核心作用。
AI.motivation: 探究磁弹性耦合如何影响自旋二聚体系统的量子关联（包括纠缠和非经典关联）以及对外部磁场的热力学响应，建立纠缠、非经典关联与热力学敏感性之间的直接联系。
AI.method: 将自旋-1/2海森堡二聚体的自旋自由度精确求解，同时用谐波描述振动自由度，从而构建每个自旋构型对应不同振动模式的有效模型。利用并发度和局部量子不确定性分析量子关联，通过磁Fisher信息评估系统对外部磁场的敏感性。
AI.result: 纠缠被温度迅速抑制，但非经典关联因自旋扇区间的竞争而在更广范围内存活。磁Fisher信息在交叉区域表现出增强响应，此处磁弹性效应引发能级布居的强重新分布。
AI.conclusion: 磁弹性耦合在控制量子关联和磁响应中发挥核心作用，为耦合自旋二聚体系统中纠缠、非经典关联与热力学敏感性之间建立了直接联系。

title: Magnetic circular dichroism of THz modes and selection rules of Raman-active optical phonons in the polar altermagnet candidate \ce{Mn2Mo3O8}
summary: We investigated the magnetic and vibrational excitations in the collinear altermagnet candidate \ce{Mn2Mo3O8} by temperature dependent Raman scattering and magneto-optical THz time-domain transmission spectroscopy. By comparison to \textit{ab initio} calculations accurately capturing the eigenfrequencies of the vibrational eigenmodes, we identify all optical phonons, including the lowest-lying Raman modes of $A_1$ and $E_2$ type, which had remained elusive in a previous Raman study. Moreover, we compare the selection rules for optically active phonons in the paramagnetic and the magnetically ordered phases of \ce{Mn2Mo3O8} and analyze the Raman selection rules with respect to pseudo-angular momentum conservation. No evidence of the expected splitting of the degenerate paramagnetic $E_2$ optical phonons into modes with circular polarization upon magnetic ordering could be resolved, likely due to weak spin-orbit coupling typical for Mn$^{2+}$. In contrast, we observe strong magnetic circular dichroism at a broad THz excitation band, emerging in the magnetically ordered state. This band, potentially originating from two-magnon excitations, is only electric-dipole active and features a field-dependent two-component fine structure. Its magnetic circular dichroism vanishes above the spin-flop transition at 4~T.

AI.tldr: 本文通过温度依赖的拉曼散射和磁光太赫兹时域透射光谱，系统研究了共线交变磁体候选材料Mn2Mo3O8的磁性和振动激发，并结合第一性原理计算识别了所有光学声子，包括先前未发现的低能A1和E2模式。研究发现磁有序态中无法分辨预期的简并E2声子分裂（因Mn²⁺自旋轨道耦合弱），但观察到一个宽频太赫兹激发带的强磁圆二色性，可能源于双磁振子激发，且该信号在自旋翻转转变处消失。
AI.motivation: 交变磁体（altermagnet）是近年提出的新型磁性材料类别，其磁性和振动激发性质尚未被充分探索。Mn2Mo3O8作为共线交变磁体候选材料，其声子识别和磁光性质（如磁圆二色性）对于理解自旋-声子耦合和磁振子激发至关重要。
AI.method: 采用温度依赖的拉曼散射光谱和磁光太赫兹时域透射光谱（THz-TDS）两种互补技术，结合第一性原理（ab initio）计算精确获取振动本征模式的频率，用于识别所有光学声子。同时分析了顺磁态与磁有序态的光学声子选择定则，并从中子动量守恒（pseudo-angular momentum conservation）角度讨论拉曼选择定则。
AI.result: 成功识别了Mn2Mo3O8的所有光学声子，包括先前研究中遗漏的最低位A1和E2拉曼模式。未观察到磁有序时简并E2声子分裂为圆偏振模式（归因于Mn²⁺弱的自旋轨道耦合）。但在磁有序态观察到一个宽频太赫兹激发带展现出强磁圆二色性，该带可能源于双磁振子激发，仅具有电偶极活性，显示出场依赖的双组分精细结构，并且在4 T自旋翻转跃迁以上消失。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作系统表征了交变磁体候选材料Mn2Mo3O8的声子谱和磁激发，建立了识别最低能声子模式的完整实验图谱。虽然由于弱自旋轨道耦合未观察到预期声子分裂，但发现的磁圆二色性太赫兹带（潜在双磁振子）为研究该材料中的磁激发动力学提供了重要实验依据，其场依赖行为揭示了自旋结构的敏感响应。

title: Uncertainty-guided active learning for surrogate prediction of stream-finishing wear fields
summary: In stream finishing, the wear experienced by a workpiece depends strongly on its orientation within the rotating abrasive media. Determining suitable orientations to achieve uniform wear requires evaluating the wear-rate field over all feasible orientations. Although the discrete element method (DEM) accurately resolves particle interactions, simulating hundreds of feasible orientations for a new geometry is computationally expensive. We present an uncertainty-guided surrogate framework that predicts, directly from geometry, the three fields governing erosion: per-triangle normal impact velocity, tangential impact velocity, and particle impact flux. These fields are combined through the Finnie wear model to reconstruct the wear-rate distribution. The surrogate employs a deep ensemble whose disagreement estimates epistemic uncertainty, enabling an active-learning strategy that selectively performs DEM simulations for the most uncertain orientations. Trained using only $13\%$ of the $696$ feasible orientations, the surrogate achieves Spearman rank correlations of $0.93$, $0.89$, and $0.93$ for the normal impact velocity, tangential impact velocity, and particle impact flux, respectively. Moreover, the predicted uncertainty is well calibrated, reliably anticipating prediction error and the fidelity of the reconstructed wear field, which matches DEM with a Spearman rank correlation of up to $0.97$ for low-uncertainty orientations and degrades in a controlled manner as uncertainty increases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种不确定性引导的代理框架，用于从工件几何形状直接预测流态抛光中的磨损率分布。通过深度集成深度网络预测三个关键场（法向冲击速度、切向冲击速度、粒子冲击通量），并结合Finnie磨损模型重建磨损率。采用主动学习策略，仅使用13%的可行方向进行DEM模拟训练，即可实现高精度预测（Spearman相关系数最高达0.97），且不确定性校准良好。
AI.motivation: 在流态抛光中，工件的磨损强烈依赖其在旋转研磨介质中的取向，而确定合适取向以实现均匀磨损需要评估所有可行方向的磨损率场。虽然离散元方法（DEM）能精确解析粒子相互作用，但对新几何形状模拟数百个可行方向计算成本过高，亟需高效的替代方法。
AI.method: 构建一个不确定性引导的深度集成代理框架：1）直接从几何预测三个控制磨损的场（每三角形法向冲击速度、切向冲击速度和粒子冲击通量）；2）通过Finnie磨损模型组合这些场来重建磨损率分布；3）利用深度集成的团内分歧估计认知不确定性；4）采用主动学习策略，仅对最不确定的方向执行DEM模拟，迭代改进模型。
AI.result: 仅使用696个可行方向中的13%（约90个）训练，代理在法向冲击速度、切向冲击速度和粒子冲击通量上分别达到0.93、0.89和0.93的Spearman秩相关系数。预测的不确定性校准良好，能可靠预测误差和重建磨损场的保真度。重建的磨损场与DEM的Spearman秩相关系数在低不确定性方向可达0.97，且随不确定性增加以可控方式退化。
AI.conclusion: 该不确定性引导的代理框架显著降低了流态抛光磨损场评估的计算成本，在保持高精度的同时通过主动学习和不确定性量化实现了高效的DEM模拟采样策略，为复杂几何工件的抛光取向优化提供了实用的替代方案。

title: Quantum resetting with memory
summary: We introduce a quantum stochastic resetting protocol with uniform memory, in which each resetting event returns the system to a state visited at a time chosen uniformly from its entire history. The resulting dynamics is nonunitary, non-Markovian and a direct quantum generalization of the classical preferential relocation model. Working in the energy eigenbasis, we derive the exact evolution of every density-matrix element for an arbitrary time-independent Hamiltonian and show that the Hamiltonian enters the dynamics only through the corresponding Bohr frequencies. This leads to a natural distinction between two classes of quantum systems: gapped and gapless. In \emph{gapped systems} (systems with a discrete energy spectrum), while the diagonal elements remain unchanged, the off-diagonal elements of the density matrix in the energy eigenbasis decay algebraically with a continuously varying exponent and with an amplitude that oscillates periodically in $\log t$. The system therefore approaches a stationary state that is independent of the resetting rate and retains a strong memory of the initial state. In \emph{gapless systems} (systems with a continuous energy spectrum), arbitrarily small Bohr frequencies prevent stationarity. Instead, the position distribution spreads on the universal (ultra-slow) scale $\log(rt)/r$, independently of the initial state and of the details of the Hamiltonian. We illustrate these results with a two-level system, a harmonic oscillator, and a free quantum particle, and contrast them with their classical counterparts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种具有均匀记忆的量子随机重置协议，每次重置将系统返回到其整个历史中均匀选取的一个状态。该动力学是非酉、非马尔可夫的，是经典优先重定位模型的量子推广。作者推导了任意时间无关哈密顿量下密度矩阵各元素的精确演化，发现哈密顿量仅通过玻尔频率进入动力学，从而区分了有隙（离散能谱）和无隙（连续能谱）两类量子系统：有隙系统中非对角元素以可变指数代数衰减并对数时间周期性振荡，最终达到与重置率无关的稳态；无隙系统中位置分布以普适的超慢尺度 log(rt)/r 扩展。
AI.motivation: 随机重置是近年来在经典和量子系统中广泛研究的重要机制，但现有量子重置协议大多是马尔可夫式的（即重置到固定初态）。作者希望引入一种更具普遍性的重置协议——重置到历史中随机均匀选取的状态，这更贴近经典优先重定位模型，并探索这种非马尔可夫量子动力学的新奇行为。
AI.method: 在能量本征基下工作，对任意时间无关哈密顿量推导密度矩阵每个元素的精确演化方程。关键在于证明哈密顿量仅通过对应的玻尔频率（能量差）进入动力学，从而将系统分为有隙（离散能谱）和无隙（连续能谱）两大类。分别分析两类系统中对角元和非对角元的演化行为。
AI.result: （1）有隙系统：对角元保持不变，非对角元以连续可变的指数代数衰减，振幅在对数时间尺度上周期性振荡；系统达到与重置率无关的稳态，且保留初始态的强记忆。（2）无隙系统：任意小的玻尔频率阻止稳态的出现，位置分布以普适的超慢尺度 log(rt)/r 扩展，与初始态和哈密顿量细节无关。作者以二能级系统、谐振子和自由量子粒子为例进行了验证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了量子均匀记忆随机重置的完整理论框架，揭示了有隙与无隙系统之间本质不同的重置动力学行为，并展示了量子系统与经典系统在重置过程中的显著差异，为后续研究提供了新的理论基础和分类视角。

title: Spin Josephson diode effect induced by higher-harmonic spin Josephson currents in a diffusive Josephson junction
summary: We theoretically investigate the spin Josephson diode effect (SJDE) in a diffusive Josephson junction with a Rashba metal layer under a ferromagnetic exchange field. Within the quasiclassical Green's function framework, we derive analytical expressions for the first- and second-harmonic spin Josephson currents. The interplay between Rashba spin-orbit interaction and the exchange field breaks inversion and time-reversal symmetries, generating additional cosine terms in the spin current-phase relations and a finite phi0 phase shift. This phase shift induces an intrinsic asymmetry between forward and backward spin currents, leading to the SJDE without an external magnetic field. Numerical results show that the efficiency decreases with increasing metal thickness due to suppression of the second-harmonic component, while its dependence on spin-orbit interaction strength reflects competing effects between phase shift enhancement and harmonic suppression. These findings demonstrate that the interplay between harmonic components provides a mechanism for nonreciprocal spin transport without requiring suppression of spin-singlet correlations.

AI.tldr: 该论文理论研究了扩散型约瑟夫森结中基于Rashba金属层和铁磁交换场的自旋约瑟夫森二极管效应（SJDE），在准经典格林函数框架下推导出自旋约瑟夫森电流的一次和二次谐波解析表达式，发现无外磁场条件下可产生自旋电流的非互易输运。
AI.motivation: 探索自旋约瑟夫森二极管效应的物理机制，特别是在不依赖自旋单态关联抑制的情况下实现非互易自旋输运的可能性，为自旋电子学器件设计提供理论基础。
AI.method: 采用准经典格林函数框架，系统研究扩散型约瑟夫森结（含Rashba金属层与铁磁交换场）中的自旋Josephson效应，推导自旋电流-相位关系中一次和二次谐波的解析表达式，分析Rashba自旋轨道耦合与交换场的协同作用对对称性破缺及相位偏移的影响。
AI.result: 数值结果显示：SJDE效率随金属层厚度增加而降低（归因于二次谐波分量的抑制）；效率对自旋轨道耦合强度的依赖反映了相位位移增强与谐波抑制之间的竞争效应。
AI.conclusion: Rashba自旋轨道耦合与交换场的相互作用通过产生有限phi0相移和额外的余弦项，打破了反转和时间反演对称性，从而在不需外磁场的情况下实现自旋约瑟夫森二极管效应；谐波分量之间的相互作用为无自旋单态关联抑制的非互易自旋输运提供了新机制。

title: Time-dependent Berry curvature and quantum metric of Floquet-Bloch states
summary: The quantum geometry of Bloch bands, characterized by the Berry curvature and the quantum metric, underpins a wide range of linear and nonlinear responses in static systems. Here, we extend this framework to periodically driven (Floquet) systems by introducing a time-dependent Berry curvature and quantum metric defined directly in the Floquet-Bloch basis. We derive optical sum rules that relate the Fourier components of these geometric quantities to the optical conductivity and demonstrate that, under ideal Floquet-band occupations, the first-order DC Hall and longitudinal responses at harmonic frequencies vanish identically. We further introduce a mixed Berry curvature involving time and momentum derivatives, which gives rise to a non-adiabatic quantized charge-pumping mechanism that occurs naturally during each driving period without requiring adiabatic evolution. In addition, we identify the time-domain quantum metric as a measure of the energy fluctuations of a Floquet band and interpret its mixed components as quantifying polarization-energy correlations. A comprehensive symmetry analysis reveals how time-reversal, sublattice (chiral), particle-hole, inversion, rotational, and reflection symmetries constrain the time-dependent quantum geometric tensor and its associated topological invariant. Numerical simulations of the Rudner-Lindner-Berg-Levin model and a fully symmetric Floquet model confirm the analytical predictions. These results establish the time-dependent quantum geometric tensor as a unified framework for describing the geometric, topological, and dynamical properties of periodically driven quantum systems, with direct implications for optical spectroscopy, quantum transport, and topological charge-pumping experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了量子几何框架到周期驱动（Floquet）系统，引入了时间相关的Berry曲率和量子度量，推导了光选择和规则，发现了非绝热量子电荷泵浦机制，并建立了统一的时变量子几何张量理论。
AI.motivation: 静态系统中Berry曲率和量子度量已广泛用于理解各种线性和非线性响应，但周期驱动（Floquet）系统中的量子几何框架尚未建立。作者希望将这一成熟框架扩展到Floquet系统，以统一描述驱动系统的几何、拓扑和动力学性质。
AI.method: 在Floquet-Bloch基中直接定义时间依赖的Berry曲率和量子度量；推导光学求和规则将几何量的傅里叶分量与光学电导联系起来；引入包含时间和动量导数的混合Berry曲率；通过对称性分析揭示各种对称性对时变量子几何张量的约束；用Rudner-Lindner-Berg-Levin模型和全对称Floquet模型进行数值验证。
AI.result: 证明了在理想Floquet带占据下，谐波频率处的直流Hall和纵向响应消失；发现了非绝热量子电荷泵浦机制；揭示了时域量子度量与Floquet带能量涨落的关系；完成了全面的对称性分析；数值模拟证实了所有解析预测。
AI.conclusion: 时变量子几何张量为周期驱动量子系统的几何、拓扑和动力学性质提供了统一框架，对光学光谱学、量子输运和拓扑电荷泵浦实验具有直接意义。

title: Pressure-induced self-doping and Fermi surface reconstruction in UAs2
summary: Superconductivity has recently been reported in the heavy-fermion compound UAs2 under pressure, with the highest Tc among uranium-based correlated 5f-electron superconductors. To elucidate its microscopic origin, we investigate its electronic structure using density functional theory combined with dynamical mean-field theory (DFT+DMFT). At ambient pressure, our calculations reproduce the characteristic Kondo-lattice electronic structure, with flat hybridization bands near the Fermi energy around the Γ and M points, in good agreement with angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES). Under pressure, we find a systematic transfer of electrons from the more localized 5f5/2 orbitals to the more itinerant 5f7/2 orbitals, while the total U-5f occupancy remains nearly unchanged. This orbital-selective charge redistribution constitutes a pressure-induced self-doping effect that drives the 5f5/2 electrons from a localized Kondo regime toward a mixed-valence regime with enhanced charge fluctuations, leading to a dramatic reconstruction of the low-energy electronic structure. Remarkably, superconductivity emerges in the pressure range where the Fermi surface consists of two disconnected sheets with enhanced nesting, but disappears when they bend and merge into a corrugated three-dimensional cylinder. Our results provide an electronic-structure basis for understanding superconductivity in UAs2 and suggest that Fermi-surface nesting and charge fluctuations may contribute to the enhanced superconducting Tc, pointing to a possible distinction from conventional heavy-fermion superconductors.

AI.tldr: 本文利用DFT+DMFT方法研究了重费米子化合物UAs2在压力下的超导电性，发现压力诱导的轨道选择性电荷转移（自掺杂效应）使5f5/2电子从局域Kondo区进入混合价态区，增强电荷涨落，并在费米面出现双片层结构增强嵌套的压力区间内出现超导，为理解UAs2的高Tc超导提供了电子结构基础。
AI.motivation: UAs2在压力下展现出铀基5f电子超导体中最高的Tc，但其超导微观起源尚不清楚，需要从电子结构层面阐明其超导机制。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论结合动力学平均场理论（DFT+DMFT）计算UAs2在常压及加压下的电子结构，并与ARPES实验对照验证。
AI.result: 常压下重现了Kondo晶格电子结构，与ARPES一致；加压下发现电子从局域的5f5/2轨道转移到巡游的5f7/2轨道（自掺杂效应），导致5f5/2电子进入混合价态区；超导出现在费米面由两个分离片层构成且嵌套增强的压力区间，消失于费米面弯曲合并为三维圆柱体时。
AI.conclusion: 费米面嵌套和电荷涨落可能共同贡献于UAs2增强的超导Tc，暗示其超导机制可能区别于传统重费米子超导体。

title: Ultrahigh Intrinsic Hole Mobilities in $M$N$_2$ ($M$= Mo and W) at Room Temperature
summary: High-mobility $p$-type semiconductors are essential for advanced electronic devices but remain scarce. Here, using a hierarchical screening framework that combines first-principles calculations with Boltzmann transport theory, we identify $M$N$_2$ ($M$= Mo and W) family as polar semiconductors with exceptionally high intrinsic hole mobilities. In particular, 1H-WN$_2$ exhibits a room-temperature hole mobility exceeding $10^{4}$~$\mathrm{cm^2\,V^{-1}\,s^{-1}}$. This exceptional transport performance arises from the synergistic suppression of polar-optical-phonon and acoustic-phonon scattering, together with a reduced intervalley-scattering phase space induced by spin--valley locking. These effects arise from anomalously small Born effective charges, strong covalent N--N bonds, and orbital hybridization between N-$2p_x$/$2p_y$ and W-$5d_{xy}$/$5d_{x^2-y^2}$ in the N$_2$-dimer-based structure. Our results establish MoN$_2$ and WN$_2$ as a promising class of high-mobility polar semiconductors and introduce a crystal-structure-based strategy for concurrently suppressing multiple electron--phonon scattering channels, thereby revising design principles for high-mobility materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分层筛选框架（第一性原理计算结合玻尔兹曼输运理论），发现MN₂（M=Mo, W）族极性半导体具有极高的本征空穴迁移率，其中1H-WN₂的室温空穴迁移率超过10⁴ cm²V⁻¹s⁻¹。优异的输运性能源于极性光学声子散射与声学声子散射的协同抑制，以及自旋-谷锁定导致的谷间散射相空间缩减。这些效应源于反常小的玻恩有效电荷、强共价N-N键以及轨道杂化等结构特征。
AI.motivation: 高迁移率p型半导体对先进电子器件至关重要，但此类材料十分稀缺，亟需发现和设计新型高迁移率极性半导体材料。
AI.method: 采用分层筛选框架，结合第一性原理计算与玻尔兹曼输运理论，系统评估MN₂（M=Mo, W）材料的载流子迁移率，并从电子-声子散射机制的角度深入分析迁移率异常高的物理根源。
AI.result: 1H-WN₂的室温空穴迁移率超过10⁴ cm²V⁻¹s⁻¹，超越了多数已知p型半导体。发现该优异性能源于三种散射通道（极性光学声子、声学声子、谷间散射）的协同抑制，这与材料的特殊晶体结构特征（N₂二聚体结构）密切相关。
AI.conclusion: MoN₂和WN₂被确立为高迁移率极性半导体的新候选材料；提出了一种基于晶体结构设计策略来同时抑制多个电子-声子散射通道的新思路，为高迁移率材料的设计原理提供了重要修订。

title: Enhanced and robust superconductivity in La0.8Sr0.2NiO2 membranes compressed up to 210 GPa
summary: The discovery of superconductivity in infinite-layer nickelate thin films has opened a new frontier for exploring unconventional oxide superconductors beyond the copper oxide family. However, the presence of substrate hampers investigations under very high pressure. Recently, this problem was circumvented by a study of freestanding Nd0.85Sr0.15NiO2 membranes, which revealed that superconducting transition temperature kept increasing as the pressure was ramped up to 91 GPa, without showing signs of saturation. Naturally, one wonders what would happen at even higher pressures. Here, we report that superconductivity in a freestanding La0.8Sr0.2NiO2 membrane persists under applied ultrahigh pressures up to 210 GPa. The superconducting transition onset temperature exhibits a continuous dome-like evolution, increasing from 16 K at ambient pressure to a peak of 74.5 K at 146 GPa, and then gradually decreasing to 57.4 K at 210 GPa. Such robustness of superconductivity against ultrahigh pressure has not been observed in high-Tc oxide superconductors before.

AI.tldr: 本研究报道了在高达210 GPa的超高压下，自支撑La0.8Sr0.2NiO2薄膜的超导性持续存在。超导转变起始温度呈现连续的穹顶状演化：从常压下的16 K升高到146 GPa时的峰值74.5 K，然后逐渐下降到210 GPa时的57.4 K。这种超导性在超高压下的鲁棒性在高温氧化物超导体中前所未有。
AI.motivation: 无限层镍酸盐薄膜超导性的发现开辟了铜氧化物之外的新型氧化物超导研究前沿。此前对自支撑Nd0.85Sr0.15NiO2薄膜的研究显示，在高达91 GPa的压力下超导转变温度持续升高且未出现饱和迹象。这自然引发了一个问题：在更高压力下会发生什么？
AI.method: 本研究采用自支撑La0.8Sr0.15NiO2薄膜（去除基底），在高达210 GPa的超高压条件下测量超导转变温度，系统研究压力对超导性的影响。
AI.result: 超导转变起始温度呈现穹顶状压力依赖：从常压16 K持续上升到146 GPa时的峰值74.5 K，之后在210 GPa时逐渐降至57.4 K。超导性在完整210 GPa压力范围内均持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 自支撑La0.8Sr0.2NiO2薄膜的超导性在超高压（最高210 GPa）下表现出极强的鲁棒性，这是高温氧化物超导体中前所未有的。超导转变温度的压力依赖呈现穹顶状行为，而非此前Ni基镍酸盐中观察到的单调上升趋势。

title: Suppressed plasmon excitations, enhanced damping and static screening in Kek-Y strained $α-\mathcal{T}_3$ model
summary: We performed a rigorous theoretical and numerical investigation into the polarization function, plasmon excitations, and plasmon damping in the Kek-$α$ model, a two-dimensional material combining the key features of the $α-\mathcal{T}_3$ lattice and Kekule-distorted graphene. Unlike conventional Kek-Y graphene, the Kekule modulation in the Kek-$α$ model affects only one of the two sublattices, giving rise to a fundamentally new model with unusual electronic properties. The low-energy spectrum consists of two degenerate flat bands and two inequivalent Dirac cones with different Fermi velocities, referred to as the fast and slow cones. The particle-hole continuum responsible for Landau damping exhibits two distinct branches associated with transitions involving these Dirac cones. An additional particle-hole mode originates from electron transitions associated with the fast Dirac cone, appearing above the main diagonal. As the parameter $α$ increases, the contribution from the fast Dirac cone becomes dominant. The additional transitions involving the flat bands and the fast Dirac cone substantially reduce the region where undamped plasmons can exist, similarly to the conventional $α-\mathcal{T}_3$. Consequently, stable plasmons are observed only for relatively small values of $α$ or at very small wave vectors. These unusual electronic and collective properties make the Kek-$α$ model a promising platform for future plasmonic and nanoscale electronic applications.

AI.tldr: 本文对Kek-α模型（结合α-T₃晶格和Kekulé畸变石墨烯的二维材料）的极化函数、等离子体激元和等离子体阻尼进行了严格的理论与数值研究。该模型的低能谱包含两个简并平带和两个不等价、费米速度不同的狄拉克锥（快锥和慢锥），由此产生两条不同的粒子-空穴连续谱分支。研究发现，随着α参数增大，快狄拉克锥的贡献占据主导，且平带与快锥的额外跃迁显著缩小了无阻尼等离子体存在的区域，仅在较小的α值或极小的波矢下才存在稳定等离子体。
AI.motivation: 传统Kek-Y石墨烯的Kekulé调制作用于两个子格，而Kek-α模型仅影响其中一个子格，形成具有全新电子性质的基本模型。深入了解该模型的集体激发（等离子体激元）及其阻尼机制，对于探索其在纳米电子学和等离激元学中的潜在应用至关重要。
AI.method: 采用严格的理论推导结合数值计算，系统研究Kek-α模型的极化函数、等离子体色散关系及朗道阻尼机制，分析不同α参数下快慢狄拉克锥对集体激发的贡献，并考察粒子-空穴连续谱的结构及其对稳定等离子体存在区域的影响。
AI.result: 低能谱由两个简并平带和两个费米速度不同的不等价狄拉克锥（快锥和慢锥）组成；粒子-空穴连续谱存在与两个狄拉克锥相关的两条不同分支，主对角线之上还出现源于快锥电子跃迁的额外粒子-空穴模式；随α增大快锥贡献占主导，平带与快锥的额外跃迁显著缩减了无阻尼等离子体的存在区域，仅有小α或小波矢下才观察到稳定等离子体。
AI.conclusion: Kek-α模型展现出独特的电子和集体激发性质，使其成为未来等离激元学和纳米电子应用的有前景的平台。稳定的等离子体仅在较小α值或极小波矢下存在，这一特性为调控等离激元行为提供了新的自由度。

title: All-Electric Topological Phase Transitions in Proximity-Coupled Bilayer MnBi2Te4 Heterostructures
summary: The intrinsic magnetic topological insulator MnBi2Te4, in the two-dimensional limit, hosts thickness dependent axion and quantum anomalous Hal (QAH) insulating states governed by antiferromagnetic interlayer coupling. However, controlled interconversion between these phases typically requires extreme external magnetic fields exceeding 9 T, limiting practical tunability. Using complementary first-principles calculations and effective Hamiltonian modeling, we demonstrate a field-free, reversible mechanism to engineer topological phase transitions by exploiting magnetic proximity at the interfaces with a ferromagnetic insulator. Gate-tunable magnetic anisotropy within the ferromagnetic insulator dynamically modulates the proximity-induced exchange bias, enabling all-electric switching of interlayer coupling and band topology in ultrathin MnBi2Te4. Crucially, long-range Heisenberg Monte Carlo simulations reveal that the magnetic ordering temperature of the encapculated MnBi2Te4 film is dramatically elevated. By eliminating the high-field requirement and simultaneously improving thermal stability, this gate-tunable paradigm solves a critical bottleneck in topological physics and offers a viable route toward scalable, high-temperature topological electronics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算和有效哈密顿量建模，演示了一种无需外磁场、可逆的机制来调控超薄MnBi2Te4中的拓扑相变。该方法利用与铁磁绝缘体的界面磁邻近效应，通过栅极调控铁磁体中的磁各向异性来动态调节邻近所致的交换偏置，实现层间耦合和能带拓扑的全电学切换。同时，海森堡蒙特卡洛模拟表明封装后的MnBi2Te4薄膜磁有序温度显著提升，为可扩展的高温拓扑电子学提供了可行路径。
AI.motivation: MnBi2Te4作为本征磁性拓扑绝缘体，在二维极限下表现出厚度依赖的轴向子绝缘态和量子反常霍尔绝缘态，但两者之间的可控转换通常需要超过9特斯拉的极端外磁场，严重限制了实际可调谐性和器件应用。
AI.method: 采用互补的第一性原理计算与有效哈密顿量建模，研究MnBi2Te4与铁磁绝缘体界面的磁邻近效应。通过栅极调控铁磁绝缘体中的磁各向异性，动态调制邻近诱导的交换偏置，实现层间耦合和能带拓扑的全电学切换。此外，利用长程海森堡蒙特卡洛模拟评估封装后MnBi2Te4薄膜的磁有序温度。
AI.result: 成功实现了无外磁场条件下的可逆拓扑相变调控，通过全电学方式切换层间耦合和能带拓扑；同时海森堡蒙特卡洛模拟揭示封装后的MnBi2Te4薄膜磁有序温度显著提升，改善了热稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 该栅极可调范式消除了高磁场需求并同步提高了热稳定性，解决了拓扑物理中的关键瓶颈，为可扩展的高温拓扑电子学器件提供了可行且实用的路线。

title: Atomic-scale reactivity of the CeO$_2$~(100) surface reconstructions by scanning probe microscopy
summary: The atomic-scale structure and reactivity of the CeO$_2$(100) surface remain poorly understood because its intrinsic polarity and low stability lead to complex reconstructions. Here, we combine scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) and atomic force microscopy (AFM) experiments using oxygen-terminated probes with first-principles modeling to investigateCeO$_2$(100) films at the atomic scale. STM revealsthe patterns associated with the CeO$_4$-pyramid-terminated (2$\times$2) and oxygen-terminated c(2$\times$2) reconstructions, the latter forming small patches at step edges. AFM imaging andforce spectroscopy provide direct identification of the exposed surface atomic species and revealfeatures compatible with adsorbate-related perturbations. Density functional theoryand AFM simulations reproduce the main experimental observations and show that the interaction with the probe isgoverned by the short-range Pauli repulsion for the oxygen-terminated surface, while that for the CeO$_4$-terminated surface is markedly affected by electrostatic contributions, highlighting the limits of simple probe models for describing copper-oxide probes on strongly corrugated polar oxide surfaces. For CeO$_4$-terminated surfaces, STM alone is not a robust fingerprint of the local reduction state, as STM simulations of the oxidized and reduced surfaces yield a similar apparent contrast due to the interplay between the vacuum decay of the local density of states and the highly corrugated surface geometry. In contrast, for the oxygen-terminated reconstruction, STM is sensitive to the reduced state and provides information on the distribution of Ce$^{3+}$ and Ce$^{4+}$ ions in the first Ce layer. These results establish an experimental-theoretical framework that connects surface reconstruction, atomic-site assignment, local force response, and adsorbate sensitivity on complex oxide surfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文结合STM/AFM实验（氧端探针）与第一性原理建模，系统研究了CeO₂(100)表面的原子级结构与反应性，揭示了CeO₄-金字塔端接(2×2)和氧端接c(2×2)两种重构的形貌与化学特性，并阐明了STM在两种重构上对Ce³⁺/Ce⁴⁺分布检测灵敏度的差异。
AI.motivation: CeO₂(100)表面因其固有极性和低稳定性导致复杂重构，其原子级结构与反应性长期缺乏清晰认识，亟需结合实验与理论手段在原子尺度上进行表征。
AI.method: 结合扫描隧道显微镜（STM）和原子力显微镜（AFM）实验（使用氧端探针），配合密度泛函理论（DFT）和AFM模拟，对CeO₂(100)薄膜进行原子级成像、力谱分析和理论建模。
AI.result: （1）STM观测到CeO₄-金字塔端接(2×2)和氧端接c(2×2)重构，后者以小块斑片形式存在于台阶边缘；（2）AFM成像与力谱直接识别了表面暴露原子种类，并观察到与吸附物相关的扰动；（3）DFT和AFM模拟显示：氧端表面与探针的相互作用由短程Pauli排斥主导，而CeO₄端表面受静电贡献显著影响；（4）对CeO₄端表面，STM无法可靠区分氧化/还原态；对氧端表面，STM能灵敏反映还原态并给出首层Ce层中Ce³⁺/Ce⁴⁺分布信息。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了连接表面重构、原子位点归属、局域力响应与吸附物敏感性的实验-理论联合框架，为复杂氧化物表面的原子级理解提供了重要范式。

title: Pressure-induced concurrent amorphization and superconductivity in topological material NbNiTe5
summary: We have systematically studied the structural and electronic properties of a topological material NbNiTe5 under high pressure. The evolution of the normal state resistance shows a non-monotonic trend from 0.7 GPa to 5.1 GPa, in accordance with the second-order transition along the inter-layer direction observed in X-ray diffraction and Raman spectra. At around 10 GPa, the sample starts amorphization, which is concurrent with the emergence of superconductivity. Upon further compression, the structural disorder enhances and the superconducting transition becomes clearer, suggesting that the superconductivity is modulated by the degree of disorder in NbNiTe5 under high pressure. Within 45.7 GPa, the superconducting transition temperature (Tc) slowly rises from 0.6 K at 9.5 GPa to 1.4 K at 45.7 GPa. Our findings extend the family of transition metal chalcogenide superconductors and shed new light on understanding superconductivity in disordered systems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了拓扑材料NbNiTe5在高压下的结构与电子性质，发现约10 GPa时样品开始非晶化并伴随超导性出现，超导转变温度从9.5 GPa的0.6 K缓慢升至45.7 GPa的1.4 K，表明超导电性受结构无序度调控。
AI.motivation: 探索拓扑材料NbNiTe5在高压下的结构相变与电子性质演变，特别是在无序体系中理解超导电性的起源与调控机制，并扩展过渡金属硫族化合物超导家族。
AI.method: 结合高压电阻测量、X射线衍射和拉曼光谱等实验手段，系统表征NbNiTe5在0.7至45.7 GPa压力范围内的正常态电阻、结构演化和超导转变行为。
AI.result: (1) 0.7至5.1 GPa区间电阻呈非单调变化，对应沿层间方向的二阶结构相变；(2) 约10 GPa时样品开始非晶化，同时超导性出现；(3) 超导转变温度随压力从0.6 K（9.5 GPa）缓慢升高至1.4 K（45.7 GPa），且无序增强时超导转变更清晰。
AI.conclusion: NbNiTe5在高压下通过结构与电子性质的协同演变实现超导电性，超导电性与结构无序度密切相关，为理解无序体系中的超导机制提供了新的视角，并扩展了过渡金属硫族化合物超导家族。

title: Microwave Response of the Superconducting Diode Effect in Proximitized Bilayer Graphene Interferometers
summary: Microwave irradiation has emerged as a promising means to tune the superconducting diode effect (SDE) in Josephson junction devices. Previous experimental studies have mainly focused on the adiabatic-driving regime, in which the diode efficiency increases monotonically with microwave power and can approach the ideal value of unity. Beyond this regime, however, the microwave response of the SDE remains largely unexplored experimentally. In this work, we investigate the microwave response of the SDE in bilayer-graphene-based superconducting quantum interference devices (SQUIDs) under a broad range of driving frequencies. We show that increasing the driving frequency changes the response characteristics of the diode efficiency to microwave power--the dependence of the diode efficiency evolves from monotonic enhancement with increasing microwave power in the adiabatic regime to non-monotonic behavior beyond this regime, and ultimately to sign-reversal as well oscillatory characteristics at sufficiently high frequencies. We find that these experimentally observed frequency-dependent power response characteristics of the diode efficiency can be qualitatively captured by simulations based on the resistively shunted junction model using the device current-phase relations extracted from the experiments. These results establish SQUIDs made from bilayer graphene as a versatile platform for studying dynamic properties of superconducting junction devices.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了双层石墨烯超导量子干涉器件（SQUID）中超导二极管效应（SDE）在宽频率范围内的微波响应，实验发现随驱动频率升高，二极管效率对微波功率的依赖从绝热区的单调增强演变为非单调、符号反转及振荡行为，并通过电阻分流结模型模拟进行了定性解释。
AI.motivation: 先前对SDE微波响应的实验研究主要集中在绝热驱动区域，该区域内二极管效率随微波功率单调增加并可接近理想值1。然而，超出绝热区域后的微波响应特性在实验上尚未被充分探索，因此需要系统研究更宽频率范围内的SDE微波响应行为。
AI.method: 该工作利用基于双层石墨烯的SQUID器件，在广泛的驱动频率范围内实验测量超导二极管效应对微波功率的响应。通过改变驱动频率，观测二极管效率-微波功率依赖关系的变化，并使用基于实验提取的电流-相位关系的电阻分流结（RSJ）模型进行数值模拟，与实验结果进行对比验证。
AI.result: 实验发现二极管效率对微波功率的响应随驱动频率升高发生显著变化：在绝热区表现为随功率单调增强，超出该区域后变为非单调行为，在足够高的频率下出现符号反转和振荡特征。这些实验观察到的频率依赖性功率响应特征可被基于RSJ模型的模拟定性复现。
AI.conclusion: 该研究确立了双层石墨烯SQUID作为研究超导结器件动态特性的多功能平台，拓展了对超导二极管效应非绝热驱动响应的实验认知，为理解和调控超导器件的非线性动态行为提供了新的实验依据。

title: Quantum geometry and RKKY in flat bands
summary: Flat conduction bands quench the group velocity and thus challenge conventional, dispersion-driven pictures of the Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) interaction, where localized moments are coupled via an effective exchange mediated by conduction electrons. Here we show that RKKY interactions in the flat-band limit are not extinguished by the vanishing group velocity but are instead mediated by the quantum geometry of Bloch states. Starting from a microscopic RKKY derivation, we demonstrate that the Brillouin-zone-averaged quantum metric controls the long-wavelength structure of the static susceptibility, thereby determining the magnetic correlation length and the spin stiffness. As a result, the finite spatial spread of Wannier functions provides an effective long-range coupling channel even when single-particle dispersion is absent. Furthermore, we establish the general principle that the ordering temperature is governed by the quantum metric in finite and low-dimensional samples, effectively circumventing the thermodynamic-limit constraint of the Mermin-Wagner theorem. Specifically, our theoretical investigation reveals that increasing the quantum metric enhances magnetic rigidity and leads to a corresponding rise in the critical temperature within finite-sized systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了平坦能带极限下的RKKY相互作用，发现尽管群速度为零，量子几何（尤其是量子度量）仍然能够介导局域磁矩间的有效交换耦合，并控制磁性关联长度、自旋刚度和有限尺寸系统中的临界温度。
AI.motivation: 传统RKKY理论依赖色散关系描述传导电子介导的局域磁矩耦合，但在平坦能带中群速度消失，这一图像失效。作者旨在回答：平坦能带中RKKY相互作用是否仍然存在以及其物理机制是什么。
AI.method: 从微观RKKY推导出发，分析静态磁化率的布里渊区平均量子度量，建立其与长波长磁结构、磁性关联长度和自旋刚度的联系。进一步通过量子度量分析有限尺寸和低维系统中的有序温度，规避Mermin-Wagner定理的热力学极限约束。
AI.result: 证明了平坦能带中RKKY相互作用并未因群速度消失而湮灭，而是由Bloch态的量子几何介导；量子度量控制磁关联长度和自旋刚度；有限尺寸系统中增加量子度量可增强磁刚性并提高临界温度。
AI.conclusion: 平坦能带系统的磁性耦合由量子几何而非色散主导，量子度量是决定磁有序的关键量。这一原理表明在有限和低维系统中，通过调控量子度量可以增强磁性有序，为平坦能带系统的磁性调控提供了新的理论框架。

title: Conditional grain-graph diffusion for property-guided inverse design of polycrystalline microstructures
summary: Graph representations compactly encode polycrystalline microstructures while retaining grain topology and grain boundary information. We present a conditional graph diffusion framework for property-guided inverse design of dual-phase Ti-6Al-4V microstructures. An enhanced grain graph neural network (GNN) with grain boundary edge features, learnable node and edge embeddings, and multi-statistic pooling serves as a forward surrogate for stress prediction and candidate evaluation. The conditional diffusion model generates candidates through reverse diffusion under prescribed α-phase volume fraction, elastic modulus, and yield-stress proxy targets. Across four target regimes and independently seeded starting sets, generated candidates consistently approach the prescribed properties, including a target outside the property envelope of the existing microstructures. Local crystallographic consistency is evaluated post-generation from deviations from the Burgers orientation relationship (BOR). BOR-aware ranking increases mean BOR consistency by up to 44.9% and 56.4% for the in- and out-of-envelope targets, respectively, while maintaining property alignment. Finite element validation of the five best candidates in each primary design case yields a maximum absolute relative error of 1.0% in their mean properties. In a representative benchmark, diffusion requires 32 candidate evaluations per input graph, compared with approximately 40,000 for random search and evolutionary optimization, and reduces runtime by approximately two orders of magnitude in the tested implementations. These results establish conditional grain-graph diffusion as an efficient framework for property-guided polycrystalline microstructure design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种条件图扩散框架，用于双相Ti-6Al-4V微结构的性质引导逆向设计。该框架结合增强型晶粒图神经网络（GNN）作为正向代理模型，以及条件扩散模型通过反向扩散生成满足特定性质目标的候选微结构。实验表明，生成候选能够逼近目标性质（包括超出已有微结构性质包络的目标），通过Burgers取向关系（BOR）感知排序可将BOR一致性提升至56.4%，有限元验证最大绝对相对误差仅1.0%，且扩散方法的候选评估次数比随机搜索和进化优化少约三个数量级，运行时间降低约两个数量级。
AI.motivation: 多晶微结构的逆向设计是一个重要但具有挑战性的问题。需要一种能够紧凑表示多晶微结构（保留晶粒拓扑和晶界信息）并高效生成满足特定力学性质（如α相体积分数、弹性模量、屈服应力）的设计方案的方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建增强型晶粒GNN作为正向代理模型，包含晶界边特征、可学习的节点和边嵌入、多统计量池化。2) 采用条件扩散模型，通过反向扩散在预设性质目标条件下生成微结构候选。3) 生成后进行BOR一致性评估和BOR感知排序筛选。4) 对最佳候选进行有限元验证。
AI.result: 生成候选在四个目标区间和独立种子起始集下均逼近预设性质，包括超出已有微结构性质包络的目标。BOR感知排序将BOR一致性提高44.9%（包络内）和56.4%（包络外），同时保持性质对齐。有限元验证显示最大绝对相对误差仅1.0%。扩散方法每次输入图仅需32次候选评估，而随机搜索和进化优化约需40,000次，运行时间降低约两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 条件晶粒图扩散被证明是一种高效的性质引导多晶微结构设计框架，在保持物理一致性（BOR关系和力学性质）的同时，显著提升了逆向设计的效率。

title: Cryogenic focused-ion-beam microstructuring enabling quantitative $c$-axis transport measurements in Tl$_2$Ba$_2$CuO$_{6+δ}$
summary: Absolute transport measurements in correlated quantum materials are often limited by disorder, inhomogeneity, geometric uncertainty, and small crystal size. Focused ion beam (FIB) technology offers a route to overcome many of these limitations by enabling transport devices with precisely defined geometry to be fabricated from lamellae extracted from carefully selected regions of a crystal, but its application to cuprate superconductors has been hindered by ion-beam-induced damage. Here we study the clean overdoped cuprate Tl2201 and show that conventional FIB processing causes thermally driven oxygen loss, while cryogenic FIB microstructuring largely suppresses this degradation and preserves the crystal structure from the bulk to the atomic scale. Microstructured devices quantitatively reproduce established in-plane resistivity and Hall carrier density measurements without rescaling. Applying this approach to $c$-axis transport, we obtain absolute $ρ_c(T)$ values approximately three times larger than previously reported, bringing the transport anisotropy into quantitative agreement with the known Fermi surface geometry within an isotropic relaxation-time approximation. These results resolve a long-standing discrepancy between transport and quantum oscillation measurements in overdoped Tl2201 and establish cryogenic FIB microstructuring as a route to reliable quantitative transport measurements in quantum materials where disorder, inhomogeneity, geometry, or small crystal size have previously limited experimental accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了低温聚焦离子束（cryogenic FIB）微加工技术用于铜氧化物超导体Tl2201的定量输运测量。研究发现常规FIB加工会导致热驱动的氧流失，而低温FIB能显著抑制这种退化，保持晶体结构从体相到原子尺度完整。利用该方法，研究者获得了比此前报道大约3倍的绝对c轴电阻率值，使输运各向异性与已知费米面几何定量一致，解决了过掺杂Tl2201中输运与量子振荡测量之间的长期矛盾。
AI.motivation: 相关量子材料中的绝对输运测量常受限于无序、不均匀性、几何不确定性和小晶体尺寸。FIB技术可通过精确几何定义的输运器件来克服这些限制，但应用于铜氧化物超导体时受到离子束诱导损伤的阻碍。作者旨在解决这一难题，实现可靠的定量输运测量。
AI.method: 研究者对比了常规FIB加工与低温（cryogenic）FIB微加工对清洁过掺杂铜氧化物Tl2201的影响，证明低温FIB可抑制热驱动的氧流失，保持晶体结构从体相到原子尺度的完整性。随后利用低温FIB制备的微结构器件进行面内电阻率和霍尔载流子密度测量，并拓展至c轴输运测量以获得绝对ρ_c(T)值。
AI.result: 低温FIB加工的微结构器件定量复现了已确立的面内电阻率和霍尔载流子密度测量结果（无需重新标定）。c轴输运测量获得的绝对ρ_c(T)值约为此前报道的三倍，使输运各向异性在各向同性弛豫时间近似下与已知费米面几何定量一致，解决了输运与量子振荡测量之间的长期分歧。
AI.conclusion: 低温FIB微加工可作为量子材料中进行可靠定量输运测量的有效途径，特别适用于此前因无序、不均匀性、几何或小晶体尺寸而限制实验精度的情况。该技术为铜氧化物超导体及其他量子材料的精确输运表征开辟了新道路。

title: Bulk-Boundary Correspondence in Semi-Infinite Chains from Sublattice Zeros
summary: We provide an alternative derivation of the bulk-boundary correspondence for semi-infinite chains. To describe edge states, we analytically continue the usual Bloch Hamiltonian to complex wave vectors $k$. To start, we note that the zeros of a Bloch wavefunction are related to edge states, at least in systems with nearest-neighbour hoppings. We show that an analytically continued Bloch Hamiltonian with chiral symmetry has exceptional points, where two different states coalesce. These special points are related to the adiabatic protection of edge states. We derive a winding number that counts the number of topological edge states protected by chiral symmetry.

AI.tldr: 本文为半无限链的体边对应提供了一种替代推导方法。通过将布洛赫哈密顿量解析延拓到复数波矢，作者发现手性对称系统的解析延拓布洛赫哈密顿量具有异常点（两个不同态在此融合），并推导了一个绕数来计数受手性对称性保护的无间隙边界态数量。
AI.motivation: 传统的体边对应通常通过拓扑不变量（如缠绕数）来建立，但需要更直观且直接的推导方法来理解边界态的形成机制，特别是在具有最近邻跳跃的系统中。
AI.method: 将布洛赫哈密顿量解析延拓到复数波矢k，利用布洛赫波函数零点与边界态的关系，发现手性对称系统中存在异常点（exceptional points）导致两个态融合，基于此推导出计数手性对称保护拓扑边界态的绕数。
AI.result: 成功建立了解析延拓的布洛赫哈密顿量与边界态之间的严格联系，识别出异常点在绝热保护边界态中的关键作用，并导出了能够计数拓扑边界态数目的绕数公式。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种新的、更深层的体边对应推导视角，将边界态的拓扑保护与解析延拓哈密顿量的异常点直接联系起来，为理解手性对称系统的拓扑现象提供了新的理论基础。

title: Emergent modular Luttinger liquid from spin-partitioned entanglement in the one-dimensional Hubbard model
summary: We study the spin-partitioned entanglement Hamiltonian of the one-dimensional repulsive Hubbard model. By combining bosonization with exact diagonalization, we show that tracing out one spin species produces a modular Luttinger liquid, whose properties fundamentally differ from those of the physical system. While the modular spectrum is fully dispersionless and possesses a momentum-independent entanglement gap, its eigenstates exhibit algebraic correlations governed by a single effective Luttinger parameter equal to the geometric mean of the charge and spin Luttinger parameters. The resulting entanglement spectrum displays a universal branching hierarchy in excellent agreement with exact diagonalization. We further demonstrate that the modular ground state is nearly identical to that of the spinless Luttinger liquid. These results uncover a universal modular structure in interacting one-dimensional fermionic systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了一维排斥性Hubbard模型中自旋分区的纠缠哈密顿量。通过结合玻色化与精确对角化方法，发现追踪一种自旋种类会产生模Luttinger液体，其性质与物理系统根本不同：模谱完全无色散且具有与动量无关的纠缠能隙，但其本征态表现出由单一有效Luttinger参数（电荷与自旋Luttinger参数的几何平均）控制的代数关联。纠缠谱展示出普适的分支层级结构，与精确对角化结果高度吻合。模基态与无自旋Luttinger液体基态几乎相同。
AI.motivation: 理解相互作用一维费米子系统中自旋分区的纠缠结构，探索模自旋分区纠缠哈密顿量的普适性质，揭示纠缠哈密顿量与物理哈密顿量之间可能存在的深刻差异。
AI.method: 结合一维排斥性Hubbard模型的玻色化分析（bosonization）与精确对角化（exact diagonalization）方法，通过追踪一种自旋种类（spin species）来构造自旋分区的纠缠哈密顿量，并分析其模谱（modular spectrum）、关联函数及基态性质。
AI.result: （1）自旋分区的纠缠哈密顿量产生模Luttinger液体，其模谱完全无色散并具有动量无关的纠缠能隙；（2）本征态由单一有效Luttinger参数=电荷与自旋Luttinger参数的几何平均（√(K_c K_s)）所控制的代数关联描述；（3）纠缠谱展示普适的分支层级结构，与精确对角化结果极好吻合；（4）模基态与无自旋Luttinger液体基态几乎完全相同。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果揭示了一维相互作用费米子系统中存在普适的模结构，表明自旋分区纠缠哈密顿量具有超越物理系统的普适性特征，为理解强关联系统纠缠结构提供了新的理论框架。

title: High-speed and high-gain graphene photovoltaic phototransistor gated by a van der Waals heterojunction
summary: Two-dimensional (2D) material-based phototransistors offer a unique combination of optical sensing, signal amplification, and logic operation within a single device, yet fundamentally suffering from an inherent gain-speed trade-off. Here, we demonstrate a 2D photovoltaic phototransistor that overcomes this limitation using a MoS2/PtSe2 heterojunction to gate a graphene channel. The ultrafast photovoltaic effect in the heterojunction enables charge separation, yielding ultrahigh photoconductive gain (up to 10^8) in graphene channel via interfacial gating. Besides, the response time (below the instrumental resolution of 550 ns) is governed by carrier transit in graphene channel, enabling simultaneous high speed and high gain. Moreover, broadband photodetection from visible to near-infrared is enabled by the optical properties of the MoS2/PtSe2 heterojunction, with the detectivity exceeding 10^11 Jones. These results establish a new paradigm for high-performance 2D phototransistors by harnessing photovoltaic and photogating effects to overcome the classical gain-speed trade-off.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了一种基于MoS2/PtSe2异质结栅控石墨烯通道的二维光伏光电晶体管，通过利用异质结中的超快光伏效应实现电荷分离，在石墨烯通道中通过界面栅控实现高达10^8的超高光电导增益，同时响应时间低于550 ns（仪器分辨率极限），克服了传统光电晶体管固有的增益-速度权衡问题。器件在可见光到近红外波段具有宽带光探测能力，探测率超过10^11 Jones。
AI.motivation: 二维材料光电晶体管虽然能在单个器件中同时实现光传感、信号放大和逻辑操作，但传统设计从根本上受限于增益与响应速度之间的固有折衷。突破这一物理瓶颈，实现高增益与高速度的兼得，是推动高性能二维光电探测器发展的关键挑战。
AI.method: 采用MoS2/PtSe2异质结作为光伏转换单元来栅控石墨烯通道。通过异质结中的超快光伏效应实现有效的电荷分离，产生的界面电场对石墨烯通道进行栅控，从而实现超高光电导增益；同时响应时间由石墨烯通道中载流子渡越时间决定，与增益产生机制解耦，打破了传统增益-速度权衡。
AI.result: 实现了高达10^8的光电导增益，响应时间低于550 ns（受限于仪器分辨率），宽带光探测范围覆盖可见光至近红外，探测率超过10^11 Jones，同时实现了高增益、高速度和宽带探测的综合性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过巧妙结合光伏效应与光栅控效应，建立了一种克服经典增益-速度权衡的高性能二维光电晶体管新范式，为未来二维光电器件的发展提供了新的设计思路。

title: Superconducting ternary compounds Li-X-B (X=Mo, W) within the mild pressure range: First-principles predictions
summary: Among the superconducting hydrides under high pressure, a number of studies concentrate on the ternary compounds to explore unique superconductors, which are capable of reducing the stable pressure and maintain superconductivity. In this work, to verify our proposed strategy of ternary composition lines (TCLs) to explore ternary compounds, we combined the first-principles calculations and crystal structure predictions to study the ternary compounds Li-X-B (X=Mo, W) under high pressure. After calculations along five and four TCLs in Li-W-B and Li-Mo-B, respectively, five Li-W-B compounds and four Li-Mo-B compounds were predicted. The compositions of LiWB4, Li4MoB2 and LiMo2B2 could be thermodynamically stable under high pressure, and Li2WB6 is around 0.02 eV/atom above the convex hull at 0 GPa, which has potential for synthesizing. Both of the predicted Li2WB6 P6/mmm and Li2WB4 R-3m are superconducting and their Tc are around 11 K, which are similar to the Tc of WB2 P6/mmm around 100 GPa. An anomalous increase of Tc was found in Li4MoB2 C2/m upon compression. We carried out full ternary search (FTS) to evaluate the validity of the TCLs strategy in Li-W-B system at 0 GPa. Our results are helpful for understanding the phase diagram of Li-X-B (X=Mo, W) under high pressure and the introducing of Li atoms provide candidate structures to reduce the measured stable pressure from ~100 GPa in WB2 P6/mmm to 0 GPa. Meanwhile, we preliminary validate the strategy of TCLs in structure predictions and we expect to improve this strategy in the future, shedding light on the studies of ternary compounds.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算和晶体结构预测，研究了高压下三元化合物Li-X-B（X=Mo, W）体系，验证了三元组成线（TCLs）策略的有效性。预测出多个新化合物，其中Li2WB6和Li2WB4具有约11 K的超导转变温度，且Li原子的引入可以将稳定压力从~100 GPa降低到0 GPa。
AI.motivation: 超导氢化物研究中，三元化合物被认为能在降低稳定压力的同时维持超导性。作者提出三元组成线（TCLs）策略来系统探索三元化合物，并希望验证该策略的可行性。
AI.method: 结合第一性原理计算与晶体结构预测方法，沿Li-W-B体系的五条TCLs和Li-Mo-B体系的四条TCLs进行计算，并对Li2WB6和Li4MoB2等候选结构进行超导性质分析（如Tc计算），同时使用全三元搜索（FTS）评估TCLs策略的有效性。
AI.result: 预测出5个Li-W-B化合物和4个Li-Mo-B化合物；LiWB4、Li4MoB2和LiMo2B2在高压下热力学稳定，Li2WB6在0 GPa时仅高于凸包约0.02 eV/atom，具有合成潜力。Li2WB6（P6/mmm）和Li2WB4（R-3m）的Tc约为11 K，与WB2 P6/mmm在~100 GPa时的Tc相当。Li4MoB2（C2/m）在压缩时出现Tc异常升高。
AI.conclusion: Li原子的引入可将稳定压力从约100 GPa降至0 GPa，为降低超导氢化物稳定压力提供了新思路；同时初步验证了TCLs策略在结构预测中的可行性，为未来三元化合物的研究提供了方向。

title: Layer-Hybridized Wigner Crystals in MoSe2/WS2 Moiré Superlattice
summary: Transition metal dichalcogenide moiré heterobilayers with type-II band alignment provide a versatile platform for layer-polarized generalized Wigner crystals, in which strong Coulomb interactions drive charge ordering at fractional lattice fillings. With a finite interlayer band offset, an out-of-plane electric field can tune layer-resolved moiré bands through resonance and enable controllable interlayer hybridization. Although hybridized Mott insulators have been previously demonstrated, whether fractional charge-ordered states can survive such hybridization remains elusive. Here we drive an H-stacked MoSe2/WS2 moiré heterobilayer through a type-I-to-type-II band-alignment transition and realize layer-hybridized Mott insulator and generalized Wigner crystals. For fillings below one electron per moiré cell, tunneling delocalizes electrons and modifies Wigner crystallization. However, above one electron per cell, Coulomb repulsion overcomes tunneling and favors layer-separated occupation, stabilizing stronger charge-ordered states. These results establish electrically tunable hybridized moiré heterobilayers as a powerful platform for engineering correlated charge order and exploring fractional Chern phases and emergent magnetism.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了MoSe2/WS2莫尔异质双层中通过电场调控实现I型到II型能带对齐转变，从而在层杂化状态下实现Mott绝缘体和广义维格纳晶体，发现低于每个莫尔胞一个电子时隧穿阻碍维格纳结晶，而高于一个电子时库仑排斥稳定更强的电荷有序态。
AI.motivation: 虽然层杂化的Mott绝缘体已被证明，但分数电荷有序态能否在层间杂化中存活仍不清楚。作者希望探索在可调层间杂化条件下广义维格纳晶体的行为。
AI.method: 使用H型堆叠的MoSe2/WS2莫尔异质双层，通过外加垂直电场驱动能带对齐从I型向II型转变，实现层杂化的Mott绝缘体和广义维格纳晶体，并系统研究不同填充率下的电荷有序行为。
AI.result: 在每莫尔胞一个电子以下填充时，隧穿使电子离域并削弱维格纳结晶；而在每莫尔胞一个电子以上时，库仑排斥克服隧穿，促进层分离占据，从而稳定更强的电荷有序态。
AI.conclusion: 电可调的杂化莫尔异质双层为工程化相关电荷有序、探索分数量子霍尔相和涌现磁性提供了强大平台。

title: Topological Defects in Triple-$Q$ Magnetic Orders: A Fixed-Lattice Homotopy Classification
summary: Multiple-$Q$ magnetic orders combine continuous spin rotations with discrete crystalline sectors associated with translations and point-group transformations, producing a richer defect structure than conventional single-$Q$ magnets. We classify the bulk defects of all seven stable phases for $N=2$ and $3$ in the $M$-point triple-$Q$ Ginzburg--Landau theory with $(\Vfour\rtimes\Dthree)\times\OO(N)$ symmetry, where $\Vfour$ is the translation-generated Klein four-group. The atomic lattice is treated as a prescribed background, with lattice dislocations and disclinations excluded and the three Fourier fields retaining their physical $M$-point labels. The parent-group transformations continuously connected to the identity form $G_0=\{e\}\times\SO(N)$. For a reference-state stabilizer $H$, the connected component containing the reference state is $G_0/(H\cap G_0)$, not the quotient obtained by projecting $H$ onto spin space. This distinction gives the orthogonal triple-$Q$ phase the full manifold $\OO(3)$, with chirality walls and Abelian $\ZZ_2$ frame vortices rather than non-Abelian binary-polyhedral vortices. Every connected component of the $\OO(2)$ phases supports an integer $2π$ vortex, whereas fractional windings close only when attached to a discrete-domain wall and are linearly confined at nonzero wall tension. Translation symmetry further forbids cross-gradient bilinears, reducing the quadratic elastic sector to an isotropic and an $M$-point-locked anisotropic stiffness. The classification separates free internal defects, crystalline domain walls, and wall-bound composites in triple-$Q$ magnets.

AI.tldr: 本文对N=2和3、具有(V₄⋊D₃)×O(N)对称性的M点三Q金兹堡-朗道理论中所有七个稳定相的体缺陷进行了分类。研究表明连接恒等元的父群变换构成G₀={e}×SO(N)，参考态稳定子H的连通分支为G₀/(H∩G₀)而非投影商，这一区别使正交三Q相具有完整流形O(3)。所有O(2)相的每个连通分量都支持整数2π涡旋，而分数绕数必须附着在离散畴壁上并受到线性禁闭。
AI.motivation: 多Q磁序将连续自旋旋转与平移和点群变换相关的离散晶体扇区结合，产生比传统单Q磁体更丰富的缺陷结构。理解这些系统的拓扑缺陷对于三Q磁体的物理性质和应用具有重要意义。
AI.method: 作者在M点三Q金兹堡-朗道理论框架下，将原子晶格视为给定背景（排除晶格位错和向错），保留三个傅里叶场的M点标签。通过分析参考态稳定子与G₀的交集来确定序参量流形的连通分量，进而对所有稳定相的缺陷进行分类，区分自由内部缺陷、晶体畴壁和壁束缚复合体。
AI.result: 关键结果为：(1) 正交三Q相具有完整流形O(3)，表现为手性壁和Abel Z₂框架涡旋，而非非Abel二元多面体涡旋；(2) 所有O(2)相的每个连通分量支持整数2π涡旋，分数绕数需附着在离散畴壁上且受非零壁张力线性禁闭；(3) 平移对称性禁止交叉梯度双线性项，将二次弹性扇区简化为各向同性和M点锁定各向异性两个刚度项。
AI.conclusion: 该分类为三Q磁体中的自由内部缺陷、晶体畴壁和壁束缚复合体提供了完整的拓扑描述，揭示了多Q磁序中缺陷结构的丰富性和独特性。

title: A Large-scale Parallel Implementation of Quasi-Four-Component Relativistic Density Functional Theory with Numeric Atom-centered Orbitals
summary: We present a large-scale parallel implementation of fully relativistic density functional theory (DFT) for both molecules and periodic solids, using the quasi-four-component (Q4C) method and numeric atom-centered orbital basis sets. Our approach employs a domain decomposition method on nonuniform real-space integration grids, which enables order-N integration of the Q4C Hamiltonian matrix elements using efficient, distributed-memory and compute-parallel real-space operations. Next, we build the Hamiltonian and overlap matrices in a two-dimensional block-cyclic distribution layout. The resulting generalized eigenvalue problems are solved with the massively parallel ELPA eigenvalue solver library. We benchmark memory usage, parallel efficiency, and scalability across multiple MPI tasks and compute nodes. This algorithm extends the reach of fully relativistic DFT simulations for periodic solids, tested up to 3,383 atoms per unit cell (216,628 basis functions) and likely still well below the true reach of the implementation. As a demonstration, we calculate the fully relativistic band structure for a 3,383 atom-per-unit-cell doped hybrid organic-inorganic perovskite, (PEA)2(Pb1-xBix)I4 (PEA=phenethylammonium), showing nearly ideal scalability between 336 and 672 physical CPU cores.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种大规模并行的全相对论密度泛函理论（DFT）实现，基于准四分量（Q4C）方法和数值原子中心轨道基组，适用于分子和周期性固体。通过非均匀实空间积分网格上的域分解方法实现order-N计算，并使用ELPA特征值求解器处理广义特征值问题，可扩展至每晶胞3383个原子（216,628个基函数）。
AI.motivation: 全相对论DFT对于重元素体系至关重要，但现有实现的可扩展性和计算效率有限，难以处理大体系周期性固体。开发一种能高效利用大规模并行计算资源、同时适用于分子和固体的全相对论DFT算法是该研究的主要驱动力。
AI.method: 采用准四分量（Q4C）方法结合数值原子中心轨道基组；在非均匀实空间积分网格上使用域分解方法，实现Q4C哈密顿矩阵元的高效order-N积分（分布式存储与计算并行）；以二维块循环分布构建哈密顿和重叠矩阵；利用ELPA大规模并行特征值求解器求解广义特征值问题。
AI.result: 针对多个MPI任务和计算节点测算了内存使用、并行效率和可扩展性；周期性固体测试规模达到每晶胞3383个原子（216,628个基函数），且可能仍远低于实现的实际能力；在掺杂杂化有机-无机钙钛矿(PEA)2(Pb1-xBix)I4的能带结构计算中，336到672个物理CPU核心之间表现出近乎理想的扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 该算法显著扩展了全相对论DFT模拟周期性固体的能力边界，展示了在大规模并行环境下良好的可扩展性，为大规模含重元素体系的相对论电子结构计算提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Emergence of Double-Dome Superconductivity in the Pressurized Dirac Semimetal BaMg2Bi2
summary: Dirac semimetal BaMg2Bi2 is reported to be a unique topological material that manifests surface superconductivity that coexistswith bulk band topology at ambient pressure. Here, we present a comprehensive investigation of high-pressure superconductingproperties in BaMg2Bi2 single crystal. Significantly, a pressure-driven double-dome superconducting behavior was revealed, withthe superconducting transition temperature Tc approaching the maximum values of 6.67 K at 4.5 GPa and 7.22 K at 10.4 GPafor the first and second superconducting domes, respectively. The combination of high-pressure X-ray diffraction, Hall resistivitymeasurements, and theoretical calculations demonstrates that, the first superconducting regime is closely related to the pressure-modulated Lifshitz transition, whereas the second superconducting phase emerges concurrently with a structural transition fromthe ambient-pressure P3m1 phase to a high-pressure Pnma phase.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了BaMg2Bi2单晶的高压超导特性，发现压力驱动的双穹顶超导行为，第一个超导穹顶与压力调制的Lifshitz转变相关，第二个超导相则伴随着从P3m1到Pnma的结构相变而出现。
AI.motivation: BaMg2Bi2作为一种Dirac半金属，在常压下表现出表面超导性与体态带拓扑共存的独特性质。作者希望探究高压对该材料超导性质的影响，特别是探索压力如何调制其超导行为以及背后可能的物理机制。
AI.method: 采用高压电阻测量揭示超导相图；结合高压X射线衍射表征结构变化；霍尔电阻率测量探测载流子行为；理论上通过计算辅助理解超导机制的起源。
AI.result: 发现压力驱动的双穹顶超导行为：第一个超导穹顶在4.5 GPa时Tc达到最大值6.67 K，与压力调制的Lifshitz转变密切相关；第二个超导穹顶在10.4 GPa时Tc达到最大值7.22 K，与从P3m1相到Pnma相的结构相变同时出现。
AI.conclusion: BaMg2Bi2的第一个超导区间源于压力调制的Lifshitz转变（电子拓扑相变驱动超导增强），而第二个超导相则是由于结构相变导致的新的超导态，两个超导穹顶具有不同的物理起源。

title: Non-linear spin current in the surface states of topological insulators
summary: Spin Hall effect is one of the primary sources of pure spin current in spintronic devices, observed in spin-orbit coupled materials. In this work, we investigate linear and non-linear pure spin currents in the hexagonally warped surface states of topological insulators like $\rm Bi_2Te_3$, using the formalism of conserved spin transport. The hexagonal warping effect enables the application of this formalism by providing a well-defined Berry curvature without breaking the time-reversal symmetry. The absence of in-plane spin currents in the linear response motivates the extension of the formalism to the non-linear regime, by combining the perturbation of Bloch states with the Boltzmann transport equation. The second-order response exhibits both intrinsic and extrinsic in-plane spin currents induced by the spin-weighted Berry curvature, Berry connection polarizability (BCP) dipole and Berry curvature dipole (BCD) respectively. The band anisotropy due to the $C_{3v}$ symmetry of the material ($\rm Bi_2Te_3$) propagates through the spin textures and the band geometric quantities, resulting in the selection of certain components of the spin conductivity tensors.

AI.tldr: 本文利用守恒自旋输运理论，研究了拓扑绝缘体（如Bi₂Te₃）六角翘曲表面态中的线性和非线性纯自旋流，发现二阶响应中由自旋加权Berry曲率、BCP偶极子和BCD分别产生内禀与外禀的面内自旋流，材料C₃ᵥ对称性导致自旋电导张量特定分量的选择。
AI.motivation: 自旋霍尔效应是自旋电子器件中纯自旋流的主要来源之一，但此前在拓扑绝缘体表面的研究中，线性响应的面内自旋流缺失，因此需要将守恒自旋输运理论扩展到非线性领域，以探索更丰富的自旋电流产生机制。
AI.method: 采用守恒自旋输运形式体系，利用六角翘曲效应提供定义良好的Berry曲率（无需破坏时间反演对称性），并结合Bloch态微扰与Boltzmann输运方程，将理论扩展到二阶非线性响应区域。
AI.result: 发现二阶响应中同时存在内禀和外禀的自旋流面内分量，分别由自旋加权Berry曲率、Berry连接极化率（BCP）偶极子和Berry曲率偶极子（BCD）驱动。Bi₂Te₃的C₃ᵥ对称性导致的能带各向异性传播到自旋纹理和带几何量中，从而使得自旋电导张量的某些特定分量被选择（非零）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作成功地将守恒自旋输运形式体系推广到非线性区域，揭示了拓扑绝缘体六角翘曲表面态中新的自旋流产生机制，为自旋电子器件中纯自旋流的产生和调控提供了新的理论途径。

title: Diodes and capacitors for the transport of monopoles in fragmented spin ice
summary: Spin-ice materials are famous for their quasi-particle excitations that behave like magnetic monopoles. Magnetricity is the concept that these monopoles can conduct an AC magnetic current, in analogy with conduction electrons. While monopole dynamics has been intensively studied and is reasonably well understood, very little has been done to design devices in order to control magnetricity. Here we develop a theoretical proof of concept for the design of diodes and capacitors for the transport of monopoles. We use the property of systems with magnetic fragmentation, where spin-ice physics co-exists with long-range antiferromagnetic order. The key point is that magnetic order allows for the existence of domain walls. Under certain conditions of preparation, this domain wall is equivalent to an asymmetric filter for monopoles. In a given direction, positive charges can go through while negative ones are repelled; the opposite applies in the opposite direction. This asymmetry effectively functions like a diode for monopole current. Successive domain walls separate positive from negative charges with a vacuum of charge in between, producing a capacitor for monopoles. Once the capacitor is charged, it can in principle be used as a battery for monopoles. All microscopic mechanisms are explained and our proof of concept is validated by simulations of more than a million spins. Application to experiments are discussed for rare-earth pyrochlore oxides and artificial spin ice. Finally, we discuss in general terms how a domain wall in fragmented spin ice can also be seen as an emergent boundary separating two mirror "worlds" separated by time-reversal symmetry. Beyond spin ice, our work opens a promising direction of investigation for the dynamics of emergent quasi-particles crossing domain walls in chiral and nematic spin liquids, which also possess a broken symmetry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个理论概念验证，展示了如何在磁性碎裂的自旋冰系统中设计用于磁单极子输运的二极管和电容器装置，并通过超过百万自旋的模拟验证了其可行性。
AI.motivation: 自旋冰材料中的磁单极子激发（磁电性）已被广泛研究，其动力学也较为清楚，但在如何设计器件来控制磁电性方面研究甚少。本文旨在填补这一空白，提出控制单极子输运的器件设计方案。
AI.method: 利用具有磁性碎裂性质的系统（其中自旋冰物理与长程反铁磁序共存），通过磁有序引入畴壁。在特定制备条件下，畴壁可作为单极子的不对称过滤器——某一方向上正电荷可通过而负电荷被排斥，反方向则相反，形成单极子二极管；连续畴壁可将正负电荷分离并在中间形成电荷真空区，构成单极子电容器。通过大规模模拟（超过百万自旋）验证概念。
AI.result: 成功实现了单极子二极管和电容器的概念验证，所有微观机制均得到解释，并通过超过百万自旋的模拟得到验证。讨论了在稀土焦绿石氧化物和人工自旋冰中的实验应用前景。
AI.conclusion: 本文为控制磁单极子输运提供了器件设计的理论框架，并推广了畴壁的概念——可视为分隔两个由时间反演对称性联系起来的镜像"世界"的涌现边界。该工作也为手性和向列自旋液体中涌现准粒子穿过畴壁的动力学研究开辟了新方向。

title: Non-relativistic spin splitting in a triangular metal-excess magnet Fe$_{1+δ}$Sb
summary: Non-relativistic spin-splitting (NRSS) antiferromagnets have recently emerged as an important class of magnetic materials that combine compensated magnetism with momentum-dependent spin splitting, offering new opportunities for spintronic applications.
