Here, we investigate a NiAs-type Fe$_{1+δ}$Sb series ($δ= 0.17$-0.30) using neutron diffraction, pair distribution function, magnetometry and density functional theory calculations. Neutron diffraction establishes that Fe$_{1+δ}$Sb adopts a $120^\circ$ coplanar compensated magnetic order with a non-zero propagation vector $\mathbf{k}=(1/3,\,1/3,\,0)$. Increasing interstitial Fe suppresses the ordered magnetic moment while inducing local symmetry lowering, as revealed by pair distribution function refinements. Density functional theory predicts momentum-dependent spin splitting, dominated by an out-of-plane spin polarization with an odd-parity f-wave-like symmetry, establishing the material as a non-collinear NRSS antiferromagnet. Motivated by the structural similarities between Fe$_{1+δ}$Sb and a known altermagnet CrSb, we further investigate their solid solution and find that Cr substitution at intermediate concentrations gives rise to a ferromagnetic component and a cluster spin-glass behavior. These results establish Fe$_{1+δ}$Sb as a new platform for non-collinear NRSS antiferromagnetism and demonstrate metal interstitial and substitution as effective parameters for tuning the magnetic order and properties.

AI.tldr: 本文通过中子衍射、PDF、磁测量和DFT计算研究了NiAs型Fe₁₊δSb系列，发现其为具有120°共面补偿磁序的非共线NRSS反铁磁体，并探索了与CrSb的固溶体中Cr取代对磁性的调控作用。
AI.motivation: 非相对论自旋劈裂（NRSS）反铁磁体是新兴的重要磁性材料类别，兼具补偿磁性与动量相关自旋劈裂，为自旋电子学应用提供新机遇。作者希望寻找和表征新的NRSS反铁磁材料平台，并探索调控其磁性的有效参数。
AI.method: 综合运用多种实验与理论手段：中子衍射确定磁结构；对分布函数（PDF）分析局域结构畸变；磁强计测量宏观磁性质；密度泛函理论（DFT）计算预测动量依赖的自旋劈裂及其对称性特征；同时研究Fe₁₊δSb与已知交变磁体CrSb的固溶体，考察Cr取代对磁性的影响。
AI.result: Fe₁₊δSb采用具有非零传播矢量k=(1/3,1/3,0)的120°共面补偿磁序；增加间隙Fe会抑制有序磁矩并诱发局域对称性降低；DFT预测动量依赖的自旋劈裂以面外自旋极化为主，具有奇宇称f波类对称性，确认其为非共线NRSS反铁磁体；Cr取代在中等浓度下产生铁磁分量和团簇自旋玻璃行为。
AI.conclusion: Fe₁₊δSb被确立为非共线NRSS反铁磁性的新平台，金属间隙原子和取代是有效调控磁序和磁性的参数，为NRSS反铁磁材料的设计与调控提供了新思路。

title: Screening phonon-mediated superconductors from static orbital Hamiltonians
summary: The first-principles search for superconductors is severely limited by the high cost of electron-phonon coupling (EPC) calculations. Here we develop a low-cost, physically transparent framework that identifies strong-EPC materials directly from static orbital-based Hamiltonians without explicit phonon perturbation calculations. Verification using density functional perturbation theory (DFPT) for representative superconductors shows that the framework captures semi-quantitatively the EPC scale at substantially lower computational cost. Applied to more than 36,000 compounds in the MattKeyBond database, it identifies 34 dynamically stable superconducting candidates with calculated $T_c > 10$ K after DFPT verification. These candidates reveal two distinct routes to relatively high-$T_c$ superconductivity: a metallized covalent $σ$-bond route that is more favorable for achieving high-$T_c$ superconductors, and a Fermi-level density-of-states accumulation route that can enhance $T_c$ but usually to a more limited extent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种低成本、物理透明的框架，直接从静态轨道基哈密顿量识别强电子-声子耦合材料，无需显式声子微扰计算。通过DFPT验证后，在36000多种化合物中筛选出34种动态稳定且Tc>10K的超导候选材料，并揭示了两种实现相对高Tc超导的路径。
AI.motivation: 第一性原理搜索超导材料严重受限于电子-声子耦合计算的高昂成本，需要开发一种更低成本的方法来加速高通量超导材料筛选。
AI.method: 开发了一个基于静态轨道哈密顿量的框架，无需显式声子微扰计算即可直接识别强EPC材料；使用DFPT对代表性超导体进行验证；随后对MattKeyBond数据库中超过36,000种化合物进行高通量筛选。
AI.result: 该框架以显著更低的计算成本半定量捕获EPC尺度；识别出34种经DFPT验证的动态稳定且Tc>10K的超导候选材料；揭示了两种高Tc路径：金属化共价σ键路线（更有利于实现高Tc）和费米能级态密度积累路线（增强Tc但程度有限）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为高通量超导材料搜索提供了低成本的有效途径，并揭示了两种不同的高Tc超导机制路径，为超导材料设计提供了新的物理洞察。

title: Wannier-Stark localization, confinement and edge states
comment: Accepted for publication in Am. J. Phys
summary: The boundary between a system's bulk and the vacuum can be modeled by a potential which confines the electrons to the bulk. Here we present the example of the Wannier-Stark linear potential, generated by an electric field along one axis of a two-dimensional lattice. Along that axis, the potential generates electronic states which are localized around each lattice site, with eigenenergies which form the Wannier-Stark ladder. In the transverse direction, the states are governed by a tight binding model with free Bloch states. In the ground state, filling these states under the Pauli principle generates an insulating bulk and an edge which can be metallic in the transverse direction. This paper explains the concepts of localization, localization length, filling and confinement. The paper also acquaints the readers with the use of Bessel functions in the solution of a simple physical model. These topics can be easily included in courses on solid state physics, and only require prior knowledge of quantum mechanics.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Wannier-Stark线性势模型，该势沿二维晶格的一个轴施加电场，使电子在该方向局域化于各格点并形成Wannier-Stark阶梯，而在横向则由自由Bloch态支配。基态填充下该模型产生绝缘体体态和可金属化的边缘态，适合作为固体物理教学案例。
AI.motivation: 作者希望通过Wannier-Stark线性势这一具体模型，向学生阐释局域化、局域化长度、填充和约束等固体物理核心概念，同时引入贝塞尔函数在物理模型求解中的应用，为固体物理课程提供简单且易于理解的教学素材。
AI.method: 该模型将系统体态与真空之间的边界建模为一个约束电子的势。沿电场方向的Wannier-Stark势使电子态局域于每个晶格位置，本征能量形成Wannier-Stark阶梯；横向方向则采用紧束缚模型描述自由Bloch态。通过Pauli原理填充基态，分析体态绝缘性与边缘态金属性。
AI.result: 基态填充下，该模型产生绝缘体体态，同时边缘在横向方向上可以呈现金属性。文章成功演示了局域化、局域化长度、填充和约束等概念，并展示了贝塞尔函数在求解简单物理模型中的应用。
AI.conclusion: 该Wannier-Stark线性势模型概念清晰、求解简单，仅需量子力学背景知识即可掌握，适合纳入固体物理课程教学，是连接理论与教学的良好桥梁。

title: Microscopic magnetic phase evolution in the Weyl semimetal Mn$_3$Sn revealed by $μ^+$SR
comment: 13 pages total (8 pages main text, 5 pages appendix and references), 7 Figures
summary: We report a comprehensive muon spin relaxation ($μ^+$SR) and bulk magnetization study of the antiferromagnetic (AFM) Weyl semimetal Mn$_3$Sn (composition Mn$_{2.99}$Sn). Mn$_3$Sn is reported to exhibit a commensurate inverse triangular (IT) AFM phase, an incommensurate (IC) helical AFM phase, and a proposed low-temperature spin-glass-like state. In our sample, we establish the respective transition temperatures for these phases to be $T_\mathrm{N} = 418$ K, $T_\mathrm{t} \approx 275$ K, and $T_\mathrm{f} = 21$ K. Investigating the low-temperature regime below $T_\mathrm{f}$, we find no evidence of a static spin-glass state. Instead, the sample exhibits an increasing ferromagnetic (FM) component accompanied by a localized slowing of spin fluctuations, indicating that these phenomena may be decoupled. In the IC helical AFM phase, fitting the zero-field (ZF) spectra reveals an asymmetric internal magnetic-field distribution, indicating that the magnetic structure is heavily modified by anharmonicity. Upon warming above 150 K, a continuous redistribution of muon spectral weight reveals a broad regime of coexisting local magnetic environments associated with the IC helical and IT-AFM phases. In the commensurate IT-AFM phase above $T_\mathrm{t}$, a persistent missing fraction in the initial asymmetry indicates that a subset of implanted muons, corresponding to roughly 20% of the sample-related asymmetry, undergoes unresolved ultrafast depolarization. Finally, we observe temperature-driven shifts in muon site populations above 325 K. Ultimately, our results show a highly dynamic magnetic landscape in Mn$_3$Sn, demonstrating how its complex magnetic orders often coexist and evolve continuously with temperature.

AI.tldr: 本文通过μSR和体磁化率测量，系统研究了反铁磁Weyl半金属Mn₃Sn的磁性相图。发现在Tf=21K以下不存在静态自旋玻璃态，而是铁磁分量增加伴随局域自旋涨落减慢；在非公度螺旋反铁磁相中存在非对称内磁场分布（非谐性影响）；在IT-AFM相中约20%的μ子经历超快退极化；整个温区显示出高度动态的磁性景观，多种磁序共存并随温度连续演化。
AI.motivation: Mn₃Sn作为反铁磁Weyl半金属，具有复杂的磁性相图（共度逆三角AFM相、非公度螺旋AFM相及可能的低温自旋玻璃态），全面理解这些磁相的性质及其演化对于深入认识其拓扑电子结构和潜在自旋电子学应用至关重要。
AI.method: 采用零场μSR（纵向场和横向场）技术结合体磁化率测量，系统研究了Mn₂.₉₉Sn样品在不同温区的磁行为。通过拟合ZF谱获得内磁场分布，通过初不对称度分析缺失分数，并追踪μ子占据位点的温度依赖性。
AI.result: 确定了三个相变温度：TN=418K、Tt≈275K、Tf=21K。低温下未发现静态自旋玻璃态；IC螺旋相中磁场分布呈非对称（非谐性）；150K以上观察到IC螺旋与IT-AFM相的局部磁环境共存；IT-AFM相中约20%的μ子经历超快退极化；325K以上观察到μ子占据位点的温度驱动变化。
AI.conclusion: Mn₃Sn的磁性景观高度动态且复杂，多种磁序并非简单分离，而是随温度连续共存和演化。这对理解和调控Mn₃Sn这类拓扑反铁磁材料的磁性行为具有重要意义。

title: Spin-chirality-driven nonrelativistic Edelstein effects in two-dimensional antiferromagnets
summary: Charge current-induced magnetic moment accumulation-Edelstein effect has been extensively attracting attention for its promising applications in spintronics. While most prior works focus on the spin-orbit coupling (SOC) induced Edelstein responses that rely on the presence of heavy elements, the nonrelativistic Edelstein effect (in the absence of SOC) that could be applied in a broader material family has been largely unexplored. Here, we perform a combined group-theoretical and ab initio numerical simulation study to show that vector spin chirality could serve as an effective control parameter of nonrelativistic Edelstein responses in antiferromagnetic system. In addition to spin degree of freedom, we also explore the orbital angular momentum contributions to current-induced magnetic moments (dubbed orbital Edelstein effect), which obey distinct symmetry constraints from the spin counterpart. Microscopically, vector spin chirality k gives rise to electronic and Zeeman-like band-geometric quantities, such as the anomalous spin/orbital polarizability and the Berry connection polarizability, which govern the nonrelativistic Edelstein responses. Our work identifies vector spin chirality as a key magnetic order parameter to enable and tune nonrelativistic Edelstein effects, and uncovers a new route toward electrically controlling magnetization without relying on SOC effect.

AI.tldr: 本文通过群论和第一性原理数值模拟，证明矢量自旋手性可以作为反铁磁系统中非相对论性Edelstein效应的有效控制参数，该效应不依赖于自旋轨道耦合（SOC），适用于更广泛的材料体系。研究还区分了自旋和轨道角动量对电流诱导磁矩的不同贡献（即自旋Edelstein效应和轨道Edelstein效应），它们在对称性约束上有所不同。
AI.motivation: 传统Edelstein效应依赖于重元素产生的自旋轨道耦合（SOC），限制了其材料适用范围。虽然非相对论性（无SOC）Edelstein效应理论上可应用于更广泛的材料家族，但此前鲜有研究探索其实现机制。作者希望找到无需SOC即可实现电学控制磁化的新途径。
AI.method: 采用群论分析与从头算（ab initio）数值模拟相结合的方法。系统研究反铁磁体系中矢量自旋手性作为非相对论性Edelstein响应的控制参数，并分别考察自旋和轨道角动量对电流诱导磁矩的贡献，分析相应的对称性约束以及带几何量（如反常自旋/轨道极化率和Berry连接极化率）的微观机制。
AI.result: 发现矢量自旋手性能够有效控制和调节反铁磁系统中的非相对论性Edelstein效应；轨道Edelstein效应与自旋Edelstein效应遵循不同的对称性约束；从微观上揭示了矢量自旋手性通过Zeeman-like带几何量（反常自旋/轨道极化率和Berry连接极化率）驱动非相对论性Edelstein响应的机制。
AI.conclusion: 矢量自旋手性被确定为调控非相对论性Edelstein效应的关键磁序参量，为不依赖自旋轨道耦合实现电学控制磁化开辟了新途径，有望扩展Edelstein效应在实际自旋电子学应用中的材料选择范围。

title: Composite quantum geometry of superconductors
summary: The interplay of superconductivity and the quantum geometry of the normal state has recently been the subject of an array of studies, especially regarding the superfluid weight. In this work, we turn our attention to the quantum geometry of the superconducting state itself, set by the Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG) Hamiltonian, which dictates the geometric and topological properties of superconductivity. We show that under three general conditions, namely superconducting fitness, orbital uniformity of the superconducting pairing, and absence of normal-state spin-flip terms, the BdG quantum geometry exactly separates into a sum of the normal-state quantum geometry and an additional pairing quantum geometry, thereby displaying a simple composite structure. We show that this separation holds for all spin-singlet and -triplet pairings, including nonunitary spin-triplet pairing. We further provide explicit analytical formulas for the pairing quantum geometry for all these cases. These results establish how superconducting pairing alone easily drives both topology and a finite quantum metric, thus being present even in topological trivial or flat band superconductors, with no normal state quantum geometry. To complement these results, we also derive the BdG quantum geometry of a general two-orbital spin-singlet superconductor with non-uniform pairing and finite superconducting fitness. Here, our explicit analytical results establish a non-separable composite BdG quantum geometry, with the normal state and pairing contributions generally intertwining, thereby producing even more possibilities for finite quantum geometry. Our results provide design rules for creating superconductors and superconducting hybrid structures with nontrivial topology and finite quantum metric and will additionally help in the experimental diagnosis of unconventional superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了超导态本身的量子几何性质（由BdG哈密顿量决定）。作者证明在三个一般性条件下（超导适配性、配对轨道的均匀性、无正常态自旋翻转项），BdG量子几何可以精确分解为正常态量子几何与配对量子几何之和，呈现简单的复合结构。该分解适用于所有自旋单重态和三重态配对（包括非幺正三重态）。作者还推导了非均匀配对的一般双轨道自旋单重态超导体的BdG量子几何，显示正常态与配对贡献会相互交织，产生更多量子几何的可能性。
AI.motivation: 近期研究关注超导与正常态量子几何的相互作用（尤其是超流权重），但超导态本身的量子几何（由BdG哈密顿量决定）尚未被系统研究。作者希望理解超导体的几何与拓扑性质是如何由BdG量子几何所决定的。
AI.method: 作者推导了BdG量子几何的解析分解公式。首先在三个一般条件（超导适配性、配对轨道均匀性、无自旋翻转项）下，证明BdG量子几何可分解为正常态部分加配对部分；然后对所有自旋单重态和三重态配对（含非幺正三重态）给出配对量子几何的显式解析公式。最后推导了一般双轨道自旋单重态超导体（具有非均匀配对和有限超导适配性）的BdG量子几何，展示了不可分离的复合结构。
AI.result: (1) 在三个一般条件下，BdG量子几何精确分离为正常态量子几何加配对量子几何；(2) 该分离适用于所有自旋单重态和三重态配对； (3) 提供了所有情况下的配对量子几何解析公式；(4) 证明仅靠超导配对即可驱动拓扑和非零量子度规，即使在正常态无量子几何的拓扑平庸或平带超导体中亦然；(5) 对于非均匀配对的一般双轨道超导体，正常态与配对贡献相互交织，导致不可分离的复合BdG量子几何。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为设计具有非平凡拓扑和有限量子度规的超导体及超导混合结构提供了设计规则，并有助于非常规超导电性的实验诊断。

title: Extracting higher-order nonlinearities in nanomechanical resonators using the backbone relation
summary: Nanomechanical resonators are a powerful platform for studying nonlinear dynamics with high sensitivity and precision. We explore the nonlinear response of a high-Q nanomechanical string resonator in and beyond the Duffing regime and introduce a robust framework for accurately extracting its conservative nonlinearities. The method is based on the backbone curve obtained from ringdown measurements, making it inherently resilient to small frequency fluctuations while explicitly accounting for both symmetry-breaking and non-symmetry-breaking nonlinearities. To validate the approach, we perform complementary ringdown and frequency-response measurements on the nanostring resonator and benchmark the backbone-based extraction against established frequency-response techniques. The comparison confirms the accuracy of the proposed framework and demonstrates its advantages over conventional methods for nonlinear characterization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于ringdown测量获得backbone曲线的框架，用于准确提取高Q纳米机械弦谐振器的守恒非线性，该方法对频率波动具有鲁棒性，并通过与传统频率响应技术的对比验证了其准确性。
AI.motivation: 纳米机械谐振器是研究非线性动力学的高灵敏度平台，但现有的非线性表征方法（基于频率响应技术）容易受到频率波动的影响，且难以同时处理对称破缺和非对称破缺的非线性效应，需要一种更稳健、更精确的表征框架。
AI.method: 该方法基于ringdown（振铃衰减）测量获得的backbone曲线来提取非线性参数。这一方法天然对小的频率波动具有鲁棒性，并且明确考虑了对称破缺和非对称破缺两类非线性效应。作者在纳米弦谐振器上进行了互补的ringdown和频率响应测量，将backbone曲线提取结果与传统频率响应技术进行基准对比。
AI.result: 与已建立的频率响应技术对比确认了所提框架的准确性，并证明了该方法在非线性表征方面相较于传统方法的优势。
AI.conclusion: 基于backbone曲线的ringdown方法为纳米机械谐振器的非线性表征提供了一种更稳健、更精确的替代方案，克服了传统频率响应方法的局限性。

title: Pressure-Driven Evolution of Electronic and Magnetic Correlations in Bilayer Nickelate La3Ni2O7
summary: The recent discovery of high-temperature superconductivity in pressurized bilayer La3Ni2O7 has sparked intense research interest, yet the microscopic mechanism governing its pressure-dependent superconducting transition temperature (Tc) remains elusive. In this work, we investigate the electronic and magnetic correlations of La3Ni2O7 under high pressure using a combination of density-functional theory (DFT), constrained random phase approximation (cRPA), and dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT). We find that while hydrostatic pressure enhances the interlayer hopping and the bare superexchange energy scale (4t2/U), it simultaneously drives the system toward a more itinerant regime by reducing the relative correlation strength (U/W). Crucially, our results reveal a distinct orbital-selective evolution: the Ni dx2-y2 states become increasingly itinerant, whereas the Ni dz2 orbitals retain a more localized character. This pressure-induced itinerancy significantly enhances the hybridization between the two, leading to a dramatic amplification of the Kondo-like screening of the local dz2 moments by the itinerant dx2-y2 electrons. Consequently, the effective magnetic exchange coupling (Jeff), which serves as the pairing glue, is suppressed in the high-pressure regime. Our findings suggest that the monotonic decrease of Tc at high pressures is driven by the dominance of Kondo screening over superexchange interactions, providing a coherent microscopic explanation for the dome-shaped superconducting phase diagram in La3Ni2O7.

AI.tldr: 本文通过DFT、cRPA和DMFT方法研究高压下La3Ni2O7的电子与磁关联，发现压力虽增强层间跳迁和超交换能标，但使体系更巡游，削弱相对关联强度。关键发现是轨道选择性演化：dx2-y2变巡游而dz2保持局域，二者杂化增强导致Kondo屏蔽主导，抑制有效磁交换耦合Jeff，从而解释高压下Tc单调下降及穹顶型超导相图。
AI.motivation: 高压双层La3Ni2O7中发现高温超导，但其压力依赖的Tc微观机制尚不明确，需要从电子结构和磁关联角度揭示其压力演化的物理本质。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）获得电子结构，结合约束随机相位近似（cRPA）计算有效相互作用参数，再通过动力学平均场理论（DMFT）研究压力下的电子关联和磁性质，分析轨道分辨的巡游性、Kondo屏蔽效应及有效磁交换耦合Jeff的变化。
AI.result: 静水压力增强层间跳迁和裸超交换能标（4t2/U），但降低相对关联强度（U/W）使体系更巡游；Ni dx2-y2轨道变巡游而dz2保持局域；两者杂化增强导致Kondo屏蔽大幅放大，抑制Jeff，解释了高压下Tc的单调下降。
AI.conclusion: 高压下Tc的下降由Kondo屏蔽主导超交换相互作用所致，为La3Ni2O7穹顶型超导相图提供了统一的微观解释。

title: EBSD and Subtle Crystallographic Differences - A Study of Resolving Interlayer Spacings in Nb-Ni and Nb-Co mu-phases
summary: In ordered intermetallics, slight variations in lattice site occupancy and specific interlayer spacings have been identified as the sources of significant changes in critical resolved shear stress and therefore how a given phase may affect alloy properties. So far, atom positions and lattice site occupancies have traditionally been characterised by high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HR-TEM) and X-ray diffraction (XRD), which are methods that offer either local detail or high statistical significance but not both. Electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD), by contrast, provides high spatial resolution across large sample areas and therefore, has the potential to enable the local investigation of interlayer spacing and site lattice occupancy with improved statistical reliability. The objectives of the study are to benchmark EBSDs capability for resolving these subtle features and to correlate them with compositional and mechanical properties. In this case study, we therefore show that EBSD can resolve key crystallographic features of mu-phase intermetallics, specifically interlayer spacings. We combine pattern matching with large-scale dynamical simulations of template libraries guided by XRD based information on lattice parameters. For this, we generate structures that vary in the spacing between triple-layer and Kagome layer and in the site lattice occupancy of the 3a site. This approach successfully predicts the change of interlayer spacing between Kagome and triple layers in Nb-Co and Nb-Ni mu-phases, in good agreement with XRD and HR-TEM.

AI.tldr: 本研究展示了EBSD结合大尺度动力学模拟和模式匹配，能够解析μ相金属间化合物的晶格层间距等关键晶体学特征，结果与XRD和HR-TEM良好吻合。
AI.motivation: 有序金属间化合物中，晶格位点占据和层间距的微小变化会显著影响临界分切应力，从而影响合金性能。传统表征方法（HR-TEM和XRD）要么只提供局部细节，要么只提供高统计显著性，难以兼得。EBSD具有大面积高空间分辨率潜力，但尚未被验证能否分辨这些细微晶体学特征。
AI.method: 将EBSD模式匹配与大尺度动力学模拟相结合。基于XRD提供的晶格参数信息构建模板库，生成在Kagome层与三层之间间距以及3a位点占据率上有所变化的结构，用于解析μ相金属间化合物的层间距和位点占据特征。
AI.result: 该方法成功预测了Nb-Co和Nb-Ni μ相中Kagome层与三层之间的层间距变化，结果与XRD和HR-TEM获得的数据高度一致。
AI.conclusion: EBSD具备解析金属间化合物细微晶体学特征的能力，能够在大面积范围内实现对层间距等关键特征的高统计可靠性局部表征，为合金设计提供了新的表征途径。

title: Superconducting dome due to the Fano-Feshbach shape resonance in artificial high-Tc superlattices
summary: In this work we provide compelling experimental validation of the Bianconi Perali Valletta (BPV) theory predicting a superconducting dome based on a quantum material design of Artificial High TC Superlattices (AHTS) made with a selected nanoscale heterostructure geometry. These AHTS are SNSN superlattices of quantum wells of period d, composed of first units, superconducting doped Mott insulator layers with Rashba spin orbit coupling (S) of thickness L, intercalated by second units, normal metal spacers (N). In these superlattices, grown by molecular beam epitaxy (MBE), the experimental superconducting dome is obtained by material quantum design changing the chemical potential via the quantum geometrical factor L/d which tunes the Fano-Feshbach shape resonance in the pair transfer between superconducting gaps in the BCS regime and different gaps in the BEC-BCS crossover. Here we present a systematic magneto-transport study of AHTS artificial superlattices across the full doping range of the superconducting dome, from the deeply underdoped to the overdoped regime, using pulsed magnetic fields up to 72 T. By varying the L/d ratio, we tune the effective hole concentration delta=0.45(1-L/d) and map the evolution of the resistive transitions, the upper critical magnetic field and the Ginzburg-Landau coherence length

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分子束外延生长的SNSN人工高Tc超晶格（AHTS），系统验证了Bianconi-Perali-Valletta（BPV）理论预测的超导穹顶。通过调节量子几何因子L/d来调控化学势和Fano-Feshbach形状共振，并在高达72 T的脉冲磁场下对整个掺杂范围内的超导穹顶进行了系统的磁输运研究。
AI.motivation: 验证BPV理论对人工高Tc超晶格中基于量子材料设计（量子阱几何结构调控）的超导穹顶的预测，并通过全掺杂范围的磁输运研究深入理解超导机制。
AI.method: 采用分子束外延（MBE）生长SNSN超晶格结构（超导掺杂Mott绝缘体层S与正常金属间隔层N交替排列，周期为d），通过改变量子几何因子L/d（L为超导层厚度）来调节有效空穴浓度δ=0.45(1-L/d)，利用高达72 T的脉冲磁场进行系统的磁输运测量。
AI.result: 实验观测到了与BPV理论预测一致的超导穹顶。通过调节L/d比值成功跨越从深度欠掺杂到过掺杂的完整掺杂范围，绘制了电阻转变、上临界磁场和Ginzburg-Landau相干长度的演化图谱。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为BPV理论关于超导穹顶源于Fano-Feshbach形状共振的预测提供了有力的实验证据，展示了通过量子几何设计人工超晶格来调控超导转变的实现路径。

title: Emission dynamics in zincblende InAsxP1-x quantum dots in InP nanowires: influence of quantum dot size, composition and nanowire geometry
comment: 22 pages, 7 figures, submitted to: Photonics and Nanostructures - Fundamentals and Applications
summary: Hereby, we present an experimental and theoretical investigation of emission dynamics in zincblende InAsxP1-x quantum dots (QDs) embedded in InP nanowires (NWs) grown via vapour-liquid-solid mechanism by chemical beam epitaxy, using Au nanoparticles as a nucleation catalyst. By measuring time-resolved photoluminescence from an ensemble of QD-NWs it was possible to determine the exciton lifetime dependence on QD composition and height. Changes in the InP shell thickness surrounding the InP NW stem with a QD, brought additional insight into the influence of photonic environment on the carrier dynamics. High-resolution transmission electron microscopy, combined with energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy, provided actual structural parameters. The experimentally obtained lifetimes were interpreted in the light of results of 8 band kp calculations combined with configuration-interaction model to take into account the Coulomb interactions and finite-difference time domain photonic simulations to include the effect of optical confinement. The full understanding of the experimental results required considering both, the changes in the QD potential and the Purcell effect, the latter leading to spontaneous emission inhibition in the case of NWs with thin InP shell.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验和理论方法研究了嵌在InP纳米线中的闪锌矿InAsxP1-x量子点的发射动力学，利用时间分辨光致发光测量激子寿命，并结合8带kp计算、组态相互作用模型和时域有限差分光子模拟来解释实验结果。
AI.motivation: 理解量子点组成、高度和光子环境（InP壳层厚度）对载流子动力学和激子寿命的影响，以全面掌握量子点发射行为。
AI.method: 采用化学束外延和VLS机制生长InAsP量子点嵌入InP纳米线；通过时间分辨光致发光测量激子寿命；结合高分辨透射电镜和能谱分析获取结构参数；利用8带kp计算与组态相互作用模型处理库仑相互作用，并通过时域有限差分光子模拟考虑光学限制效应。
AI.result: 激子寿命取决于量子点组成和高度；InP壳层厚度影响光子环境进而影响载流子动力学；薄InP壳层时Purcell效应导致自发辐射抑制。
AI.conclusion: 完整理解实验结果需同时考虑量子点势能变化和Purcell效应，两者共同决定自发发射行为。

title: Long and short time linear response of metals: a geometric approach
summary: The time-dependent quantum geometric tensor, which captures dipole fluctuations of bound electrons, is essential for understanding the electronic properties of insulators, superconductors, and flat bands. It is often considered subleading for low-energy descriptions of metals that are dominated by intra-band processes. Here, we revisit this perspective and highlight scenarios where the quantum geometry of the wavefunctions close to the Fermi surface plays a significant role. We compute the time-dependent quantum geometric tensor for metals, explain its divergence, and contrast it against singular geometric tensors of Dirac and Weyl semi-metals. We identify the ratio of Drude to total spectral weight, $D/\mathcal{S}_1$, as a lattice-scale probe of bound versus itinerant charge, and quantify it in the kagome metal, where the two van Hove fillings respond differently despite identical Fermi surfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了量子几何张量在金属中的角色。传统观点认为它在以带内过程为主的金属低能描述中是次主导的，但作者指出在费米面附近的波函数量子几何在某些场景中扮演重要角色。他们计算了金属的含时量子几何张量，解释了其发散行为，并与狄拉克和外尔半金属的奇异几何张量进行对比。作者进一步提出D/S₁（Drude权重与总谱权重之比）作为晶格尺度上束缚电荷与巡游电荷的探针，并在kagome金属中验证了该比值。
AI.motivation: 量子几何张量对绝缘体、超导体和平带的理解至关重要，但传统上被认为在金属的低能描述中不重要。本文的动机是挑战这一观点，揭示在费米面附近的量子几何在金属中同样具有显著作用，并提供一个可量化探针（D/S₁）来区分束缚与巡游电荷。
AI.method: 作者计算了金属的含时量子几何张量，分析了其发散的原因，并将其与狄拉克和外尔半金属的奇异几何张量做了系统对比。同时，提出了Drude权重与总谱权重之比 D/S₁ 作为晶格尺度上的探针，并在kagome金属中进行了定量验证（两个van Hove填充位点具有相同费米面但响应不同）。
AI.result: 研究发现金属中费米面附近的量子几何并不总是次主导的，在某些场景下显著影响低能物理。含时量子几何张量在金属中表现出发散行为，其性质与半金属的奇异几何张量不同。D/S₁比值成功区分了束缚与巡游电荷，且在kagome金属中揭示了两个van Hove填充位点尽管具有相同费米面却表现出不同响应。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作修正了对金属中量子几何张量角色的传统认知，表明费米面附近的量子几何在金属中同样重要。D/S₁作为一个有效的实验可测量的探针，为理解束缚电荷与巡游电荷的晶格尺度行为提供了新工具，尤其在具有平带或van Hove奇点的体系中。

title: Twist-induced magnetic topological phase transition in stacked altermagnetic CrO
summary: Interlayer twisting offers a geometric route to controlling electronic states, but whether it can simultaneously reconstruct magnetic symmetry and band topology remains unclear. Here, based on symmetry analysis and first-principles calculations, we show that commensurate twisting drives magnetic topological phase transitions in stacked bilayer CrO. In particular, it transforms an antiferromagnetic Dirac semimetal into either a $d$-wave altermagnetic bipolarized Weyl semimetal or an unconventional compensated magnetic Weyl semimetal. A key result is that the Weyl points in the $d$-wave altermagnetic phase lie at generic $k$ points in the Brillouin zone and are protected by the spin symmetry $\left\{ C_2 T||C_{2z} T\right\}$. This sharply contrasts with conventional two-dimensional Weyl semimetals, where Weyl points are typically protected by mirror or rotational symmetries and thus pinned to high-symmetry lines. We further show that commensurate twisting preserves the spin symmetry $\left\{ C_2 T||C_{2z} T\right\}$, making the Weyl phase a robust consequence of twisting rather than a fine-tuned feature of a specific angle. Our work establishes a symmetry-based route to engineering magnetic topological phases in twisted two-dimensional materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对称性分析和第一性原理计算，证明在双层CrO中，相称扭转可以同时重构磁对称性和带拓扑，将反铁磁Dirac半金属转变为d波交替磁性双极化Weyl半金属或非常规补偿磁Weyl半金属。关键的Weyl点位于布里渊区的一般k点，由自旋对称性\{C2T||C2zT\}保护，这与传统二维Weyl半金属中Weyl点由镜面或旋转对称性保护并被锁定在高对称线上的情况形成鲜明对比。
AI.motivation: 层间扭转提供了一种几何上调控电子态的手段，但能否同时重构磁对称性和带拓扑尚不清楚。作者希望探索扭转是否能够同时驱动磁性和拓扑的相变。
AI.method: 采用对称性分析与第一性原理计算相结合的方法，研究双层CrO在相称扭转下的电子结构、磁对称性和带拓扑变化。
AI.result: 发现相称扭转将反铁磁Dirac半金属转变为d波交替磁性双极化Weyl半金属或非常规补偿磁Weyl半金属；Weyl点在d波交替磁性相中位于一般k点，由自旋对称性\{C2T||C2zT\}保护；相称扭转保持该自旋对称性，使Weyl相成为扭转的稳健结果。
AI.conclusion: 建立了基于对称性设计扭转二维材料中磁拓扑相的方法，表明扭转是工程化磁拓扑材料的有效几何途径。

title: Resolving High-Energy States of Interlayer Excitons in MoSe$_2$/WSe$_2$ Heterostructures
summary: High-energy states of interlayer excitons (IXs) in van der Waals heterostructures remain largely unexplored despite their importance for understanding many-body interactions and nonlinear optical phenomena. Here, we use photoluminescence excitation (PLE) spectroscopy to resolve a Rydberg-like series of excited IX states in MoSe$_2$/WSe$_2$ heterostructures. We observe multiple PLE resonances below the intralayer exciton energies, which we assign to the 2s-, 3s-, and 4s-like states of the IXs. These resonances are consistently observed across heterostructures with different twist angles, indicating that the high-energy state spectrum is only weakly affected by the twist angle. Wannier-exciton calculations incorporating screened Coulomb interactions reproduce the overall energy scale and qualitative trends of the measured Rydberg-like series, supporting the assignment of the observed resonances. Our findings demonstrate that PLE provides direct experimental access to the previously unexplored high-energy IX states in van der Waals heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 本文利用光致发光激发（PLE）光谱首次解析了MoSe₂/WSe₂异质结构中层间激子（IX）的类里德伯激发态系列（2s、3s、4s态），并通过Wannier激子理论计算验证了实验观测，证明PLE可直接探测此前未被探索的高能层间激子态。
AI.motivation: 层间激子的高能态尽管对理解多体相互作用和非线性光学现象至关重要，但至今仍未被充分探索。这一研究空白限制了人们对van der Waals异质结构中激子物理的完整理解。
AI.method: 采用光致发光激发（PLE）光谱技术，在MoSe₂/WSe₂异质结构中系统扫描激发能量，分辨出层内激子能量以下的多个PLE共振峰；结合不同扭转角度的异质结构进行对比实验，并与考虑屏蔽库仑相互作用的Wannier激子计算进行验证。
AI.result: 观测到多个PLE共振，分别归属于层间激子的2s、3s和4s态；这些共振在不同扭转角度的异质结构中一致出现，表明高能态谱对扭转角度不敏感；Wannier激子计算在能量尺度和定性趋势上与实验测量的类里德伯系列吻合。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次为van der Waals异质结构中的高能层间激子态提供了直接实验观测途径，PLE光谱被证明是探测此类此前未探索激发态的有效工具，对深入理解层间激子的多体相互作用具有重要价值。

title: Optimized Tensor-Network Renormalization for Quantum Dynamics: Resolving the Spectral Function of $\mathrm{K_2Co(SeO_3)_2}$
summary: Tensor-network methods have opened a powerful route for the study of dynamical spectral functions in two-dimensional quantum systems. However, existing approaches within the framework of infinite projected entangled-pair states construct the required renormalization tensors solely from the ground-state environment and can suffer from severe numerical instability. We identify the origin of this instability and introduce an excitation-tailored corner-transfer-matrix renormalization-group (ET-CTMRG) method to resolve it. By incorporating excitation tensors into the renormalization procedure, the method constructs a substantially more accurate effective Hamiltonian matrix and thereby yields reliable and well-converged excitation spectra. For Heisenberg antiferromagnets, it reduces truncation errors by orders of magnitude and for the particularly complex case of the supersolid phase in the triangular-lattice XXZ magnet $\mathrm{K_2Co(SeO_3)_2}$, it achieves excellent quantitative agreement with inelastic neutron-scattering measurements. ET-CTMRG therefore provides a robust framework for investigating the dynamical properties of strongly correlated quantum systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种激发态定制的角转移矩阵重整化群（ET-CTMRG）方法，通过在重整化过程中纳入激发张量，解决了无限投影纠缠对态（iPEPS）框架下计算二维量子系统动态谱函数时的数值不稳定性问题，显著提高了激发谱的计算精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的iPEPS框架下的方法仅从基态环境构建重整化张量，导致严重的数值不稳定性，限制了二维量子系统动态谱函数的可靠计算。
AI.method: 提出ET-CTMRG方法，将激发张量纳入重整化过程，构建更精确的有效哈密顿量矩阵，从而获得可靠且良好收敛的激发谱。
AI.result: 对于海森堡反铁磁体，截断误差降低了数个数量级；对于三角晶格XXZ磁体K2Co(SeO3)2的超固态相这一复杂情况，与非弹性中子散射测量结果达到了出色的定量吻合。
AI.conclusion: ET-CTMRG为研究强关联量子系统的动力学性质提供了稳健的框架。

title: Why Ammoniated Lithium Borohydrides Liquefy and Resolidify?
summary: Ammonia ($\mathrm{NH_3}$) absorption drives $\mathrm{LiBH_4}\!\cdot\!x\mathrm{NH_3}$ through a re-entrant "solid-liquid-solid" transition: $\mathrm{LiBH_4\cdot NH_3}$ is a well-defined solid ammoniate, compositions near $\mathrm{LiBH_4\cdot 2NH_3}$ are liquid-like or partially liquefied, whereas $\mathrm{LiBH_4\cdot 3NH_3}$ returns to a more rigid, non-liquid ammoniate state. However, the microscopic origin of this unintuitive response remains a long-lasting mystery. Here, we uncover its mechanism. Cross-database analysis identifies borohydrides as a particularly state-diverse and composition-responsive material family. Structure prediction and ab initio molecular simulations reveal that $\mathrm{NH_3}$ progressively replaces $\mathrm{BH_4^-}$ in the Li coordination shell. The liquid-like state emerges not at the highest $\mathrm{NH_3}$ loading but near $x \approx 2$, where Li-N and Li-B coordination modes are strongly mixed, coordination memory is weakest, and the sampled Li-N/N$\cdots$B coordination landscape is broadest. Further ammoniation produces Li-N-dominant coordination and slows $\mathrm{BH_4^-}/\mathrm{NH_3}$ contact renewal, resulting in increased network persistence and recovery of a rigid ammoniate state. Pressure-composition isotherm, $^1\mathrm{H}$ and $^{11}\mathrm{B}$ nuclear magnetic resonance, and Raman measurements support this non-monotonic state evolution and the associated $\mathrm{BH_4^-}/\mathrm{NH_3}$ reorganization. These findings transform ammonia-induced liquefaction from an empirical phase anomaly into a competition among native-network disruption, mixed-coordination frustration, and ligand-built network reconstruction, providing a framework for chemically switching between transport-favouring fluidity and stability-favouring rigidity in hydrogen-rich materials.

AI.tldr: 本研究揭示了LiBH₄·xNH₃体系中氨吸收驱动"固-液-固"再入相变的微观机制：当x≈2时，Li-N和Li-B配位模式强烈混合，配位记忆最弱，形成液态；进一步氨化后Li-N主导配位恢复刚性固态。
AI.motivation: LiBH₄·xNH₃体系在氨吸收过程中表现出反直觉的"固-液-固"再入相变（x=1为固态，x≈2为液态，x=3恢复固态），但其微观起源长期以来是未解之谜。
AI.method: 结合跨数据库材料分析、晶体结构预测和从头算分子动力学模拟，并通过压力-组成等温线、¹H和¹¹B核磁共振及拉曼光谱实验验证。
AI.result: 发现NH₃逐步取代Li配位壳层中的BH₄⁻；液态出现在x≈2处（非最高氨负载量），此时Li-N与Li-B配位模式强烈混合、配位记忆最弱、配位景观最广；进一步氨化后Li-N主导配位导致BH₄⁻/NH₃接触更新变慢，恢复刚性。
AI.conclusion: 将氨诱导液化从经验性相异常转化为"本征网络破坏-混合配位挫伤-配体构建网络重建"三者竞争的统一框架，为含氢材料中输运性流动与稳定性刚性的化学切换提供设计指导。

title: Complete Structural Determination of Mesostructural Dodecagonal Quasicrystalline Particles
summary: Quasicrystals have revolutionized our understanding of order in solids by demonstrating exotic structural and physicochemical properties with diverse potential applications. Despite the development of various theoretical models and experimental techniques to describe quasicrystal structures, the precise determination of local three dimensional (3D) arrangements of constituent atoms, or of secondary building units such as clusters or micelles, remains elusive. This challenge is particularly acute in self assembled soft matter quasicrystalline systems, where the complex assembly of molecular groups introduces additional defects and structural modulations. Herein, we report the first complete structural determination of self-assembled mesostructural dodecagonal quasicrystalline particles. Employing advanced electron tomography, combined with dedicated structural tracing and processing workflows, the 3D coordinates of all nodal sites were extracted. This approach reveals that the actual structure deviates from the conventionally assumed tetrahedral close packing geometry, exhibiting diverse coordination environments and displacive fluctuations. We identified and quantified rotational intergrowths arising from node exchange, as well as various defects and disorder, with these features discernible only through 3D analysis. Additionally, we propose a simplified two-layer stacking of isomorphic hexagonal model to form dodecagonal quasicrystal. This work advances our understanding of soft-matter dodecagonal quasicrystals and paves the way for detailed structural elucidation of self-assembled systems.

AI.tldr: 本文首次实现了自组装软物质十二方准晶颗粒的完整三维结构解析。通过先进电子层析成像技术结合专门的结构追踪与处理流程，提取了所有节点的三维坐标，揭示了实际结构与传统假设的四面体密堆积几何存在偏差，呈现多样的配位环境和位移涨落，并识别量化了由节点交换引起的旋转共生以及各种缺陷和无序。
AI.motivation: 尽管已有多种理论模型和实验技术用于描述准晶结构，但精确测定构成原子的局域三维排列（或次级构建单元如团簇、胶束的排列）仍然困难。这一问题在自组装软物质准晶体系中尤为突出，因为分子基团的复杂组装会引入额外的缺陷和结构调制。
AI.method: 采用先进电子层析成像技术，结合专门开发的结构追踪与处理工作流程，从自组装介观结构十二方准晶颗粒中提取所有节点的三维坐标。基于这些坐标进行结构分析，并提出一种由两个同构六方模型层堆叠形成十二方准晶的简化模型。
AI.result: 实际结构与传统假设的四面体密堆积几何不符，表现出多样的配位环境和位移涨落；识别并量化了由节点交换引起的旋转共生，以及各种缺陷和无序，这些特征只能通过三维分析才能分辨。
AI.conclusion: 该工作推进了对软物质十二方准晶的理解，为自组装体系的详细结构阐明铺平了道路。

title: Performance of Tkatchenko-Scheffler Dispersion Method with Updated van der Waals Radii: Importance for Alkali-Containing Systems
comment: The following article has been submitted to the Journal of Chemical Physics
summary: The Tkatchenko-Scheffler (TS) pairwise method to calculate dispersion interactions is a widely used approach to incorporate missing long-range van der Waals contributions in semilocal and hybrid density functional calculations. Despite numerous refinements of the approach to include many-body terms, the original formulation still remains highly relevant as an efficient and robust method, especially for organic and/or insulating materials. In 2018, Fedorov et al. reported updated van der Waals radii to the seminal work published in 2009. The present work examines the accuracy of the TS method with updated van der Waals radii (abbreviated as TS_2018), coupled with the semilocal Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof density functional, for structural predictions of semiconducting and insulating materials in comparison to the non-local many-body dispersion method and the original TS method (TS_2009). Special attention is paid to materials containing alkali elements, for which the TS_2009 method exhibits a large overbinding, associated with potentially large errors in predicted atomic structures. We also consider a more narrow reformulation (TS_alkali) where only the the alkali atoms are corrected, so the method remains otherwise compatible with TS_2009. The binding energy curves of five alkali dimers are used to assess the TS_2009 and the TS_2018 methods in comparison to the random phase approximation. Using 45 inorganic solid compounds with available experimental reference data, as well as three widely studied, Cs-containing halide perovskites, CsPb$X_3$ ($X$ = Cl, Br, I), we then examine the performance of the TS_2018 and TS_alkali approaches compared to TS_2009 and the beyond-pairwise, nonlocal many-body dispersion method; the latter found to give good results as well.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了使用更新范德华半径的Tkatchenko-Scheffler (TS_2018) 方法在半导体和绝缘体材料结构预测中的精度，并与原始TS_2009方法及非局域多体色散方法进行了系统比较。研究发现TS_2018改善了含碱金属材料（特别是TS_2009存在严重过束缚问题）的结构预测，并提出了只修正碱金属原子的TS_alkali方法以保持与TS_2009的兼容性。
AI.motivation: TS方法广泛用于补充半局域和杂化密度泛函中的长程色散相互作用，但原始TS_2009方法在处理含碱金属元素材料时表现出严重的过束缚问题，导致原子结构预测存在较大误差。2018年Fedorov等人更新了范德华半径，但该更新在半导体和绝缘体材料中的系统性能尚不清楚，因此需要全面评估其精度。
AI.method: 将TS_2018与PBE泛函结合，用于半导体和绝缘体材料的结构预测；与多体色散方法（MBD）和原始TS_2009方法进行对比。使用五种碱金属二聚体的结合能曲线评估TS_2009和TS_2018（以随机相位近似为参考），并利用45种具有实验参考数据的无机固体化合物及三种Cs基卤化物钙钛矿CsPbX3 (X=Cl, Br, I)进行系统测试。同时提出TS_alkali方案，仅修正碱金属原子参数，保持与TS_2009其余部分的兼容性。
AI.result: 通过45种无机固体化合物和3种Cs基卤化物钙钛矿的系统测试，评估了TS_2018和TS_alkali相比TS_2009及非局域多体色散方法的结构预测性能。研究发现TS_2018显著改善了含碱金属材料的结构预测，而非局域多体色散方法也表现出良好的结果。
AI.conclusion: TS_2018（更新范德华半径）有效缓解了TS_2009在含碱金属材料中的过束缚问题，是比非局域多体色散方法更高效且精度良好的选择，特别适用于有机和绝缘材料的结构预测。

title: Time reversal symmetry broken quantum spin hall effect in pseudospin-1 Dirac-Rashba system
summary: The Quantum spin Hall (QSH) phase is conventionally understood to be protected by time-reversal symmetry (TRS). Here, we theoretically investigated the fate of the QSH phase in a pseudospin-1 fermionic $α-\mathcal{T}_3$ system in the presence of a TRS-breaking ferromagnetic exchange field and spin-nonconserving Rashba spin-orbit coupling. Despite broken TRS, the QSH phase survives over a finite parameter regime and is characterised by a non-zero projected spin-Chern number $C_σ(σ= \uparrow, \downarrow)$, protected by a spin-spectral gap. In the absence of Rashba coupling, the QSH phase remains robust up to an $α$-dependent critical exchange field. Rashba SOC qualitatively reshapes the phase diagram by driving transitions into two distinct quantum anomalous Hall (QAH) phases: a $C=2$ phase, irrespective of $α$-values, and a $C=1$ phase for $α\neq 0,1$, which is further identified as a valley-polarized QAH phase arising from a single valley. Rotating the magnetization to in-plane gaps out the first-order helical edge states and gives rise to second-order topological insulator (SOTI) phases that host localized corner states in suitable finite geometry. We further identify a topological phase transition between two different SOTI phases, mediated by nanoribbon edge states at an exchange field equal to $α$. These results establish spin-resolved topology in a higher pseudospin system as well as the $α-\mathcal{T}_3$ lattice as a versatile platform for engineering and controlling multiple topological phases through magnetic exchange and spin-orbit coupling.

AI.tldr: 本文理论研究了在时间反演对称性破缺的α-T₃赝自旋-1费米子系统中，量子自旋霍尔（QSH）相在铁磁交换场和Rashba自旋轨道耦合作用下的命运。研究发现，尽管TRS被破坏，QSH相仍可在有限参数区域内存活，并由非零投影自旋陈数表征。Rashba耦合驱动系统进入C=2和C=1两种不同的量子反常霍尔（QAH）相，其中C=1相为谷极化QAH相。将磁化方向旋转到面内可打开一阶螺旋边缘态，产生承载局域角态的二阶拓扑绝缘体（SOTI）相，并在交换场等于α处识别出两种SOTI相之间的拓扑相变。
AI.motivation: 传统认知中QSH相由时间反演对称性保护，但作者希望探索在更高赝自旋系统（赝自旋-1的α-T₃晶格）中，打破TRS后QSH相是否仍能存活，以及Rashba自旋轨道耦合和铁磁交换场如何重塑拓扑相图，从而为多拓扑相的工程调控提供新平台。
AI.method: 通过理论分析，在α-T₃赝自旋-1系统中同时引入破坏TRS的铁磁交换场和自旋不守恒的Rashba自旋轨道耦合，利用投影自旋陈数（projected spin-Chern number）和自旋谱隙（spin-spectral gap）来表征拓扑相，并研究面内磁化对一阶和二阶拓扑相的影响。
AI.result: (1) 即使TRS被破坏，QSH相仍在有限参数范围内存活，由非零投影自旋陈数保护；(2) 无Rashba时，QSH相在依赖于α的临界交换场以下保持鲁棒；(3) Rashba耦合驱动出C=2和C=1两种QAH相，后者为单谷来源的谷极化QAH相；(4) 面内磁化打开一阶螺旋边缘态，产生承载角态的SOTI相；(5) 在交换场等于α处识别出两种SOTI相之间的拓扑相变。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果确立了更高赝自旋系统中的自旋分辨拓扑性质，并将α-T₃晶格确立为一个通过磁交换和自旋轨道耦合调控多种拓扑相的通用平台，为QSH、QAH和SOTI相之间的切换提供了理论依据。

title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Sparse Strain-Field Reconstruction in 4D-STEM
comment: 18 pages, 7 figures, 1 table, and Supplementary Material. Code and processed data are available at https://github.com/rmsreis/pinns-4dstem
summary: Quantitative strain mapping using four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM) typically requires densely sampled scans that can damage beam-sensitive specimens. We develop a physics-informed neural network (PINN) for sparse 4D-STEM strain reconstruction that embeds elastic equilibrium and Saint-Venant compatibility in the training loss through automatic differentiation. The architecture combines a coordinate-based implicit representation, sine activations with stable second derivatives, frozen residual-scale normalization, an exponential physics-weight ramp, and residual-based adaptive collocation. We apply a sine-activated residual network to an experimental $180\times400$-pixel strain map of domain-structured PbGeSnSe$_{1.5}$Te$_{1.5}$. Across $1$-$75%$ sampling ($720$-$54{,}000$ probe positions), $R^2$ for $\varepsilon_{xx}$ reaches $0.80$ at $10%$ sampling and saturates near $0.86$ by $25%$; the chevron strain-band morphology is recovered from $10%$ of probe positions. At $10%$ sampling, the PINN reduces mean absolute error by approximately $26%$ relative to compressed sensing and $22%$ relative to Gaussian-process regression. An ablation against an equal-capacity data-only SIREN shows that the PDE prior improves accuracy at extreme sparsity and consistently improves physical self-consistency, but biases the reconstruction when data are abundant. Monte Carlo dropout and mean-field variational inference provide per-pixel epistemic uncertainty maps correlated with reconstruction error. With an appropriate constitutive model, the framework is adaptable to strain mapping across diverse material systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于4D-STEM稀疏应变重建的物理信息神经网络（PINN），通过将弹性平衡方程和Saint-Venant相容性条件嵌入训练损失函数，在极低采样率（10%）下即可恢复材料应变图，相比压缩感知和GP回归分别降低约26%和22%的平均绝对误差。
AI.motivation: 传统4D-STEM定量应变绘图需要密集扫描，这对束敏感样品会造成损伤。为了降低电子束剂量，需要开发能够在稀疏采样下仍能准确重建应变图的方法，同时要保持物理一致性和不确定性量化能力。
AI.method: 该方法采用坐标基隐式表示的物理信息神经网络（PINN），关键设计包括：1）使用正弦激活函数以保证稳定的二阶导数；2）冻结残差尺度归一化；3）指数物理权重斜坡（physics-weight ramp）；4）基于残差的自适应配点。通过自动微分将弹性平衡和Saint-Venant相容性条件嵌入训练损失，并利用MC Dropout和平均场变分推断提供逐像素认知不确定性图。
AI.result: 在PbGeSnSe1.5Te1.5的畴结构应变图上，1%-75%采样范围内，10%采样时εxx的R²达到0.80，25%采样时饱和于约0.86；仅用10%探针位置即可恢复chevron应变带形态。在10%采样率下，相比压缩感知和GP回归分别降低约26%和22%的MAE。消融实验表明PDE先验在极端稀疏时提高精度并保持物理自洽性，但数据充足时可能引入偏置。
AI.conclusion: 该PINN框架在稀疏4D-STEM应变重建中展现出优越性能，显著降低了对束敏感材料的电子束损伤风险，并能提供与重建误差相关的不确定性估计。通过适配合适的本构模型，该框架可推广到多种材料体系的应变绘图。

title: Band topology and symmetry-driven magneto-optical response in two-dimensional d-wave altermagnets with staggered spin-orbit coupling
summary:
Altermagnets combine compensated collinear magnetic order with momentum-dependent spin splitting, providing a route to transverse electronic and optical responses without a net ferromagnetic moment. We develop a strictly periodic four-band tight-binding model for a two-dimensional d-wave altermagnet and distinguish the roles of three spin orbit coupling (SOC) channels: uniform Rashba SOC, a sublattice-staggered Rashba interaction, and bond-staggered SOC.
  In the absence of SOC, the d-wave kinetic anisotropy produces spin-polarized Dirac points on orthogonal Brillouin-zone boundaries, related by the altermagnetic fourfold spin-group symmetry. Uniform Rashba SOC mixes the spin sectors and shifts these nodes but preserves the antiunitary symmetry that forbids an integrated Hall response. The sublattice-staggered Rashba term breaks this symmetry and activates transverse optical response, whereas the bond-staggered SOC provides the mass that gaps the boundary nodes. Their combined action generates strong Berry-curvature hot spots and, within a narrow parameter window, an isolated lower two-band manifold with Chern number C=-2. For the representative parameters considered here it is possible to stabilize a Chern insulator phase.
  Using covariant-velocity Kubo calculations, we show that large optical Hall conductivity and circular dichroism extend well beyond the nonzero-Chern region and are controlled by SOC-induced avoided crossings and symmetry breaking. We further find that carrier doping strongly modifies the resonant and dc Hall responses through Pauli blocking and the occupation of Berry-curvature hot spots, enabling gate-controlled sign reversals. These results identify the complementary roles of distinct interfacial SOC mechanisms in producing topology and tunable magneto-optical activity in compensated two-dimensional magnets.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个严格周期性的四带紧束缚模型，用于研究二维d波交替磁体（altermagnet）中三种不同自旋轨道耦合（SOC）通道的作用，揭示了均匀Rashba、亚晶格交错Rashba和键交错SOC如何协同产生拓扑Chern绝缘体相，并通过协变速度Kubo计算展示了大的光学霍尔电导和圆二色性，以及载流子掺杂对磁光响应的可调控性。
AI.motivation: 交替磁体结合了补偿性共线磁序与动量依赖的自旋劈裂，无需净铁磁矩即可实现横向电子和光学响应，但此前对多种界面SOC机制如何协同影响其拓扑和磁光性质的研究尚不充分，特别是不同SOC通道的角色分工不明。
AI.method: 发展了一个严格周期性的四带紧束缚模型描述二维d波交替磁体，分别纳入均匀Rashba SOC、亚晶格交错Rashba相互作用和键交错SOC三种通道，并利用协变速度Kubo公式计算光学霍尔电导和圆二色性，系统分析能带拓扑、Berry曲率分布及掺杂效应。
AI.result: 在不含SOC时，d波动能各向异性在布里渊区边界产生自旋极化Dirac点。均匀Rashba SOC保持反幺正对称性（禁止净Hall响应），亚晶格交错Rashba打破该对称性激活横向光学响应，键交错SOC提供能隙质量项。三者的协同作用产生强Berry曲率热点，可在窄参数窗口内实现C=-2的Chern绝缘体相。大光学霍尔电导和圆二色性超出非零Chern区域，载流子掺杂可通过Pauli阻塞和Berry曲率热点占据实现栅控符号反转。
AI.conclusion: 不同的界面SOC机制在补偿性二维磁体中分别扮演互补角色——均匀Rashba混合自旋扇区、交错Rashba打破对称性、键交错SOC提供质量项——共同决定拓扑相和可调的磁光活性，为设计无净磁矩的拓扑与磁光器件提供了理论路线。

title: Charge Tunable Optical Nonlinearity of Moiré Exciton-Polaritons
summary: Transition metal dichalcogenides represent a versatile platform to study strong light-matter interactions based on excitons and electrons in ordered lattices. Twist-engineering of moiré structures further enables the manipulation of the polaritonic nonlinearities via engineering the exciton landscape on the nanoscale. In this work, we demonstrate in-situ control of the optical saturation-based nonlinearity of moiré exciton-polaritons by phase space restriction via charge doping. Strong exciton-photon coupling is established in a gate-controllable MoTe$_2$-MoSe$_2$ heterobilayer, embedded in a spectrally-tunable open cavity. A small gate voltage can effectively lower the necessary polariton density by one order of magnitude to achieve a similar nonlinear saturation effect as in the charge-neutral case. Our microscopic description successfully explains the observed phenomena in the framework of Pauli blocking for the moiré superlattices with charge preoccupation.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了一种通过电荷掺杂实现莫尔激子极化激元光学饱和非线性原位调控的方法。在可调开放式微腔中嵌入MoTe₂-MoSe₂异质双层，通过栅极电压控制电荷填充来限制相空间，从而将实现相同非线性饱和效应所需的极化激元密度降低一个数量级。微观理论基于莫尔超晶格中Pauli阻塞原理成功解释了观测现象。
AI.motivation: 过渡金属硫族化合物（TMDs）是研究强光-物质相互作用的理想平台，而扭曲莫尔结构能通过纳米尺度操控激子景观来调控极化激元非线性。然而，如何在原位动态调控这种非线性仍是一个挑战。本文旨在通过电荷掺杂实现莫尔激子极化激元非线性强度的原位控制。
AI.method: 构建了嵌入光谱可调开放式微腔中的栅极可控MoTe₂-MoSe₂异质双层结构，实现强激子-光子耦合。通过施加微小栅极电压进行电荷掺杂，利用相空间限制效应调控光学饱和非线性。理论方面采用Pauli阻塞框架下的微观模型描述莫尔超晶格中电荷占据对非线性效应的影响。
AI.result: 证明了电荷掺杂可有效增强莫尔激子极化激元的非线性饱和效应。仅需施加微小栅极电压，就能将实现相同非线性效应所需的极化激元密度降低约一个数量级，实现了对非线性强度的原位高效调控。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作展示了通过电荷掺杂进行相空间限制可以有效调控莫尔激子极化激元的非线性，为动态可调的极化激元非线性器件提供了新的设计思路，拓展了莫尔光子学在量子光学和非线性光学领域的应用前景。

title: Dual-Mode Exciton Coupling in Epitaxially Registered Organic-Inorganic 2D Heterocrystals
summary: Two-dimensional (2D) heterocrystals comprising molecules and semiconductors can serve as an ideal platform for studying interfacial excitons and for future optoelectronic applications, yet the energy and charge flow across these atomically sharp interfaces remain unclear. In this work, we investigated PTCDA-MoS2 as a prototypical 2D organic-inorganic heterostructure and revealed dual-mode exciton coupling between the constituent crystals. Monolayer-resolved PTCDA molecular crystals were grown on monolayer MoS2 via physical vapor assembly, and their crystallographic details, including the stacking angle, were determined by electron diffraction. Upon the formation of the heterostructures, PTCDA's photoluminescence was completely quenched because of organic-to-inorganic hole transfer, whereas that of MoS2 increased markedly with PTCDA thickness. Using differential reflectance and photoluminescence excitation spectroscopy, we found that the enhancement arises from two distinct mechanisms. Ground-state charge transfer injects holes into MoS2, which suppresses negative trion formation and enhances the radiative recombination of neutral excitons. In addition, resonant energy transfer, enabled by spectral overlap between PTCDA and MoS2, diverts excitation energy from PTCDA to MoS2. Our findings reconcile previously proposed mechanisms and establish a unified framework in which charge and energy transfer cooperate to govern exciton coupling at organic-inorganic interfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了PTCDA-MoS2二维有机-无机异质结构中激子耦合的双模机制，揭示了电荷转移（空穴注入抑制负三子形成）与能量转移（共振能量转移）共同协同调控界面激子的统一框架。
AI.motivation: 二维异质晶体是研究界面激子和未来光电器件应用的理想平台，但跨原子级尖锐界面的能量和电荷流动机制尚不明确，且已有研究提出的机理存在争议。
AI.method: 通过物理气相沉积在单层MoS2上生长单层分辨的PTCDA分子晶体，利用电子衍射确定晶体学细节（包括堆叠角）；采用差分反射光谱和光致发光激发光谱研究激子耦合机制。
AI.result: 发现PTCDA荧光完全猝灭（有机-无机空穴转移），而MoS2荧光随PTCDA厚度显著增强，增强源于两个机制：基态电荷转移注入空穴抑制负三子形成并增强中性激子辐射复合；PTCDA与MoS2光谱重叠实现的共振能量转移。
AI.conclusion: 研究调和了先前提出的竞争性机制，建立了电荷转移与能量转移协同调控有机-无机界面激子耦合的统一框架。

title: Proximity effects of chiral magnetization on transition metal dichalcogenides monolayers
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, joint submission with "Valley-controlled chiral magnetism in transition metal dichalcogenide monolayers" by the same authors
summary: We consider the proximity effects of a commensurate chiral $120^{\circ}$ Néel magnetic structure on the transport and optical properties of a transition metal dichalcogenide monolayer (TMD ML). The enlarged magnetic unit cell leads to the folding of the Brillouin zone and enables efficient intervalley spin-flip scattering. Starting from a six band tight binding model, we develop an effective $k\cdot p$ model, which describes the coupling between charge carriers in the TMD ML and the chiral magnetization. We predict the anomalous antiferromagnetic Hall effect (AHE) for conduction electrons and describe it accounting for the interplay between anomalous velocity, side jump, and skew scattering contributions. The proximity of the chiral magnetization also leads to the mixing and splitting of the exciton resonances in the two valleys which are related by the time reversal symmetry despite zero net magnetization. Finally, we demonstrate the possibility to measure the distribution of in-plane orientation of the chiral magnetization through Faraday rotation and the ellipticity of incident linearly polarized light.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了手性120° Néel磁结构对过渡金属二硫化物单层（TMD ML）输运和光学性质的邻近效应。增大的磁单胞导致布里渊区折叠，实现高效的谷间自旋翻转散射。基于六带紧束缚模型发展了有效k·p模型，预测了导带电子的反常反铁磁霍尔效应（AHE），并发现手性磁化导致两个谷中激子共振的混合与劈裂，最后展示了通过法拉第旋转和椭圆率测量手性磁化面内取向的可能性。
AI.motivation: 探索手性反铁磁结构作为TMD单层的邻近衬底所产生的物理效应，特别是实现零净磁化下的时间反演对称性破缺相关的输运和光学响应，为反铁磁自旋电子学和谷电子学提供新的调控手段。
AI.method: 从六带紧束缚模型出发，发展有效的k·p模型来描述TMD单层中载流子与手性磁化之间的耦合。考虑了反常速度、侧跳和斜散射三种贡献来解释反常反铁磁霍尔效应，并分析了激子混合劈裂及光学响应。
AI.result: 预测了导带电子的反常反铁磁霍尔效应（AHE），描述了手性磁化导致的谷间激子共振混合与劈裂（尽管零净磁化但谷间由时间反演对称性关联），并展示可通过法拉第旋转和椭圆率测量手性磁化的面内取向分布。
AI.conclusion: 手性120° Néel磁结构邻近效应为TMD单层提供了丰富的物理现象，包括反常反铁磁霍尔效应、激子共振劈裂和光学探测手性磁化取向的可能性，拓展了反铁磁自旋电子学与光学探测的应用前景。

title: Machine Learning Assisted Design of Complex and High Entropy Alloys by Hybrid HiPIMS/Pulsed-DC PVD Process for Low Carbon Energy Applications in Extreme Environments
summary:
Complex and high entropy alloys are attracting much attention currently thanks to their mechanical and corrosion resistance properties in harsh environments, in particular needed for carbon-free energy applications. However, their elaboration in bulk and in thin film form in a trial-and-error approach is impractical due to their complexity and the cocktail effect. The recent development of artificial intelligence brings a new possibility for their elaboration and adjustment of their properties.
  Firstly, we present an overview of Materials and data science research. Then we describe how DIADEM - French initiative for Materials and Data science convergence - tackles the development of innovative coatings for carbon-free energy applications (nuclear, high temperature electrolysis, ...) thanks to the development of a nationwide network of synthesis and characterization platforms - the DIADEM discovery hub. We describe in particular DIADEM-2D, an AI-driven Hybrid HiPIMS/Pulsed-DC PVD process using 4 cathodes in confocal combinatorial configuration. We present the high entropy alloy determination using data from the literature for corrosion resistance in molten salt media and nuclear accidental conditions. An element-independent model gathering deposition parameters and coating properties has been implemented allowing the design of protective coatings with a particular composition. We demonstrate the feasibility of this process and its accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了法国DIADEM计划如何利用人工智能驱动的数据科学与材料科学融合方法，开发用于无碳能源应用（核能、高温电解等）的复杂高熵合金防护涂层，通过全国性合成与表征平台网络以及AI驱动的混合HiPIMS/脉冲DC PVD工艺（DIADEM-2D），实现了从文献数据出发的高熵合金成分设计，并验证了该方法的可行性与准确性。
AI.motivation: 复杂高熵合金因其在恶劣环境中的优异力学和耐腐蚀性能而备受关注，但传统的试错法（trial-and-error）研发方式由于其复杂性和鸡尾酒效应而变得不切实际，亟需新的方法来实现其高效制备和性能调控。
AI.method: 1) 建立法国材料与数据科学融合的全国性合成与表征平台网络（DIADEM discovery hub）；2) 开发DIADEM-2D，一种AI驱动的混合HiPIMS/脉冲DC PVD工艺，采用4个阴极的共聚焦组合配置；3) 利用文献数据确定适用于熔盐介质和核事故条件下的耐腐蚀高熵合金成分；4) 构建元素无关的模型，将沉积参数与涂层性能关联，以实现特定成分防护涂层的设计。
AI.result: 实现了元素无关的沉积参数-涂层性能关联模型，成功设计了具有特定成分的防护涂层，并验证了该AI驱动PVD工艺的可行性和准确性。
AI.conclusion: 人工智能与数据科学方法的融合为高熵合金涂层的研发提供了全新途径，DIADEM计划展示了AI驱动工艺在无碳能源应用防护涂层设计中的有效性。

title: Valley-controlled chiral magnetism in transition metal dichalcogenide monolayers
comment: 7+2 pages, 4+1 figures, joint submission with "Proximity effects of chiral magnetization on transition metal dichalcogenides monolayers" by the same authors
summary: We put forward the Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) interaction in transition metal dichalcogenide monolayers as a tool to create and control a chiral magnetic texture. We show that in the spin-valley locking regime, the RKKY interaction acts as a Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya coupling with an effective spin rotation period exactly equal to the tripled lattice constant. Using mean field theory and classical Monte Carlo simulations, we demonstrate that this interaction qualitatively reshapes the phase diagram of atomically thin antiferromagnets. It destroys the chirality-related phase transition by selecting a single chirality value even when the RKKY interaction is small. At the same time, it shifts the Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless transition associated with spins orientation to higher temperatures. We argue that the valley degree of freedom of electrons mediating the RKKY interaction provides a powerful control knob for exploring non-universal phase transitions and quantum spin liquid states in two-dimensional van der Waals heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在过渡金属二硫族化物（TMD）单层中，RKKY相互作用可作为产生和控制手性磁织构的工具。在自旋-谷锁定区，RKKY相互作用表现为等效Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya耦合，其有效自旋旋转周期恰好等于三倍晶格常数。通过平均场理论和经典蒙特卡洛模拟，作者证明该相互作用能重塑原子级薄反铁磁体的相图，破坏与手性相关的相变，同时将BKT转变推向更高温度。
AI.motivation: 探索在二维范德华异质结构中利用RKKY相互作用的谷自由度作为控制旋钮，以产生手性磁织构并调控非普适相变和量子自旋液体态。
AI.method: 采用平均场理论（Mean Field Theory）和经典蒙特卡洛模拟（Classical Monte Carlo simulations）研究RKKY相互作用对手性磁织构和相图的影响，重点分析自旋-谷锁定区域中的等效Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya耦合效应。
AI.result: RKKY相互作用在自旋-谷锁定区表现为DM型耦合，自旋旋转周期为三倍晶格常数；该相互作用即使在强度很小时也能破坏手性相关的相变，选择单一手性值；同时将自旋取向相关的BKT相变温度推向更高温度。
AI.conclusion: 介导RKKY相互作用的电子的谷自由度是探索二维范德华异质结构中非普适相变和量子自旋液体态的强有力调控手段。

title: Synthesis and structural validation of close-to-stoichiometric NiTe$_2$ single crystals
summary: We report the synthesis of stoichiometric NiTe$_{2}$ single crystals via chemical vapor transport together with precise structural characterization. A combined analysis using powder X-ray diffraction (XRD) and single crystal XRD was performed to determine lattice parameters and structural details. High-resolution single crystal XRD reveals no evidence of interstitial nickel, confirming a close-to-stoichiometric composition. This work establishes a reliable benchmark for the crystal structure of stoichiometric NiTe$_{2}$, offering a reference for future studies on its physical properties.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了通过化学气相输运法合成化学计量比NiTe₂单晶，并利用粉末X射线衍射和单晶X射线衍射进行了精确的结构表征，确认晶体为接近理想化学计量比且无间隙镍原子，为后续物理性质研究提供了可靠的结构基准。
AI.motivation: NiTe₂的物理性质与其晶体结构的化学计量比密切相关，而以往研究中晶体质量或化学计量比的不确定性可能影响对物理性质的解释。因此需要制备高质量、精确化学计量比的单晶并建立可靠的结构基准。
AI.method: 采用化学气相输运（CVT）方法合成了化学计量比NiTe₂单晶；结合粉末X射线衍射（XRD）和单晶X射线衍射进行晶格参数与结构细节的精确测定；利用高分辨单晶XRD检测是否存在间隙镍原子，以验证化学计量比。
AI.result: 成功合成了化学计量比NiTe₂单晶；精确测定了晶格参数和结构细节；高分辨单晶XRD未发现间隙镍的存在，确认样品为接近化学计量比的组成。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为化学计量比NiTe₂的晶体结构建立了可靠的基准，为未来相关物理性质的研究提供了重要的参考依据。

title: Resonantly-enhanced Raman response in graphene-capped bismuthene on SiC
summary: Two-dimensional quantum spin Hall insulators based on atomic monolayers offer a promising route toward dissipationless electronics, yet their practical use is often limited by environmental instability. Encapsulating the system with a graphene capping layer has been shown to be a reliable method to prevent oxidation and degradation. However, the confirmation of a successful encapsulation still relies on ultra-high vacuum techniques, that considerably slow the process. Here, we present an ex situ, rapid, nondestructive and spatially resolved Raman characterization of graphene-capped bismuthene, a honeycomb monolayer of Bi on SiC. A pronounced Raman scattering peak at around 122 cm-1 is identified as the E2g phonon of bismuthene, via a comparison with density functional perturbation theory calculations. We use excitation-energy and polarization-dependent Raman measurements to enable an unambiguous assignment of the spectral features. Tuning the excitation energy close to the excitonic transition in pristine bismuthene, we observe a strong enhancement of the Raman response and the emergence of additional scattering peaks. In this regime, higher-order phonon features, as well as interfacial modes between bismuthene and the SiC substrate, become visible, suggesting the involvement of resonant scattering processes. Our results establish Raman micro-spectroscopy as a versatile tool for probing graphene-protected quantum materials, providing access to lattice dynamics and interlayer coupling.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了利用拉曼显微光谱对外延石墨烯封装的铋烯（bismuthene）进行非原位、快速、无损且具有空间分辨率的表征方法。通过密度泛函微扰理论计算对比，识别出约122 cm⁻¹处的E2g声子模式，并通过激发能量和偏振依赖测量进行明确归属。
AI.motivation: 二维量子自旋霍尔绝缘体（如铋烯）有望实现无耗散电子学应用，但环境不稳定性限制了其实用性。石墨烯封装可防止氧化，但现有封装确认方法依赖超高真空技术，过程缓慢。因此需要一种快速、非破坏性的表征手段来验证封装质量并研究被封装材料的性质。
AI.method: 采用激发能量和偏振依赖的拉曼显微光谱技术，对SiC基底上的石墨烯封装铋烯单层进行表征。结合密度泛函微扰理论（DFPT）计算进行声子模式归属，并通过调节激发能量接近激子跃迁来增强拉曼响应，从而观测高阶声子特征和界面模式。
AI.result: 识别出约122 cm⁻¹处铋烯的E2g声子峰；接近激子跃迁时拉曼响应显著增强，并出现高阶声子特征及铋烯-SiC界面模式，表明存在共振散射过程。
AI.conclusion: 拉曼显微光谱可作为一种多功能工具，用于探测石墨烯保护的量子材料，能够提供晶格动力学和层间耦合信息，可作为超高真空技术之外的高效替代方案。

title: Optical switching of magnetic order in few-layer CrSBr
summary: Manipulating magnetism with light is crucial for both fundamental understanding and technological advancements of information storage devices. The layered antiferromagnet CrSBr, part of the recently emerging class of two-dimensional van der Waals magnets, offers a unique path towards optical control of magnetism via magneto-excitons, which allow optical readout of the spin alignment and also provide a strong absorption channel. Here, we use exciton absorption and photoluminescence to demonstrate optical switching of the magnetic order in bi- and trilayer CrSBr. Using a continuous-wave laser with a power as low as a few microwatts at near-critical external magnetic fields, we demonstrate both local and remote switching of the magnetic configuration in extended lateral domains and further employ this mechanism to deterministically prepare the zero-field magnetic configuration. Our results establish optical switching as a useful means of controlling magnetism in CrSBr, with potential applications in magneto-optoelectronic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了在双层和三层CrSBr范德华磁体中利用连续波激光（功率低至几微瓦）在近临界外磁场条件下实现对磁序的光学切换，并利用磁激子实现光读取，可将该机制用于零场磁构型的确定性制备。
AI.motivation: 利用光操控磁性对信息存储器件的基础理解和科技进步至关重要。层状反铁磁体CrSBr作为新兴的二维范德华磁体，通过磁激子为光学操控磁性提供了独特途径，但尚需展示其实际的光学切换能力。
AI.method: 使用激子吸收和光致发光光谱技术，在双层和三层CrSBr中，利用功率仅几微瓦的连续波激光，在近临界外磁场下实现局部和远程的磁构型切换，并利用该机制在零场下确定性制备目标磁构型。
AI.result: 在近临界外磁场条件下，低功率（微瓦级）连续波激光即可在扩展的横向磁畴中实现局部和远程的磁序光学切换，并能确定性制备零场下的磁构型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了光学切换作为控制CrSBr磁性的有效手段，具有在磁光电器件中的应用潜力。

title: Gradient expansion approximation of the inhomogeneous electron-gas revisited: Higher-order corrections
summary: In our recently published work (our Ref. 1) we revisited the gradient expansion approximation (GEA) of the interacting electron gas, and recalculated the leading-order contribution$-$with respect to the Wigner-Seitz radius $r_s$$-$to the coefficient $B_{xc}[n]$ of the square of the gradient of the electron density in the high-density and slowly varying limits. That work resolved historical controversies regarding these coefficients and demonstrated that serious misconceptions have led to incorrect constraints being imposed on popular functionals within the generalized gradient approximation (GGA). In the present paper, we extend this calculation to obtain the coefficient of the next-to-leading term, which scales as $r_s \ln(r_s)$ relative to the leading order. First, we establish a systematic framework to evaluate the integral expressions for the $b_{xc}$ coefficient of the leading term ($\sim q^2$) of the density-density response function in the long-wavelength limit ($q \to 0$)$-$a prerequisite for computing $B_{xc}[n]$. The significance of the calculation stems from the proof that the coefficient of this $r_s \ln(r_s)$ term receives no corrections from higher-order diagrammatic expressions. Consequently, our derived value serves as an exact, definitive constraint for future GGA functional development; in the high-density slowly-varying limit, any valid functional must reproduce the exact constraints established in both our previous work and the present paper.

AI.tldr: 本文在前期工作的基础上，将梯度展开近似（GEA）中交换关联系数Bxc[n]的计算从领头阶（r_s的零次幂）扩展到次领头阶（r_s ln r_s量级），并证明该系数不受高阶费曼图修正的影响，从而为广义梯度近似（GGA）泛函在高密度缓慢变化极限下提供了精确的约束条件。
AI.motivation: 前期工作已解决Bxc[n]领头阶系数的历史争议，并指出此前对GGA泛函施加了错误的约束。本文的目标是将计算推进到次领头阶（r_s ln r_s量级），以提供更精确且完备的约束条件，进一步指导未来GGA泛函的发展。
AI.method: 作者建立了系统的理论框架来评估长波长极限（q→0）下密度-密度响应函数的bxc系数（~q²项）的积分表达式，这是计算Bxc[n]的前提。通过图论方法分析，证明该r_s ln r_s项的系数不受到高阶图表达式的修正，从而保证了结果的精确性。
AI.result: 推导出了Bxc[n]次领头阶（r_s ln r_s量级）系数的精确值，并严格证明了该系数不受高阶图修正的影响，即所得到的值是一个精确的、确定性的约束。
AI.conclusion: 该结果为GGA泛函的构建提供了新的精确约束：在高密度缓慢变化极限下，任何有效的泛函都必须同时满足前期工作所确立的领头阶约束和本文建立的次领头阶约束，这将对未来密度泛函理论的发展产生重要指导意义。

title: Exciton-induced magnons carrying orbital angular momentum in CrI3
summary: Magnons are collective spin excitations that contain and transport spin angular momentum in magnetic materials. It has been suggested that they can also carry orbital angular momentum in analogy to the electronic motion around the nucleus. We explore the real-space topology of magnon wave-packets emanating from atomic-like excitons in the ferromagnetic insulator CrI3 and demonstrate the existence of orbital angular momentum in such wave-packets. We reveal that orbital angular momentum of magnons is nearly equal to their spin angular momentum and compensates the latter. This illustrates the existence of an unexplored internal angular momentum balance and demonstrates that the magnetization can be quenched without the need of angular momentum exchange with the lattice.

AI.tldr: 本文在铁磁绝缘体CrI₃中研究了磁振子波包的实空间拓扑，首次证明了磁振子可以携带轨道角动量，且其轨道角动量与自旋角动量几乎相等并相互补偿，展示了内部角动量平衡的新机制。
AI.motivation: 磁振子作为集体自旋激发，传统上被认为只携带自旋角动量。研究者提出磁振子可能像电子绕核运动一样携带轨道角动量，这在实空间中尚未得到充分探索，因此需要验证磁振子轨道角动量的存在及其物理意义。
AI.method: 在铁磁绝缘体CrI₃中，从类似原子的激子激发出发，探索磁振子波包的实空间拓扑结构，通过分析波包的拓扑性质来揭示其轨道角动量的存在，并定量比较轨道角动量与自旋角动量的大小关系。
AI.result: 证明了磁振子波包中存在轨道角动量，且其轨道角动量几乎等于自旋角动量，两者方向相反、相互补偿，导致净角动量趋于零，从而无需与晶格交换角动量即可实现磁化淬灭。
AI.conclusion: 该发现揭示了磁振子中存在未被探索的内部角动量平衡机制，表明磁化可以仅通过磁振子内部的轨道-自旋角动量补偿来实现淬灭，无需依赖与晶格的角动量交换，这为理解磁性材料的角动量动力学提供了新的视角。

title: Second-harmonic generation in twisted double bilayer graphene: Double-resonant enhancement from moiré flat bands
summary: We theoretically investigate second-harmonic generation (SHG) in twisted double bilayer graphene (TDBG) with AB--AB and AB--BA stacking configurations using a perturbative approach based on an effective continuum Hamiltonian. We present a systematic analysis of the SHG response as a function of twist angle, vertical bias voltage, Fermi energy, and stacking configuration. We find that the SHG signal is strongly enhanced at small twist angles due to the emergence of moiré flat bands and the associated increase in the joint density of states. Beyond this conventional enhancement mechanism, we demonstrate that the reduced bandwidth enables a pronounced double-resonant process, in which optical transitions at both $ω$ and $2ω$ are simultaneously satisfied over extended regions of the moiré Brillouin zone. This mechanism leads to a substantial amplification of the SHG response, analogous to the enhancement observed in systems with discrete energy levels, but realised here in a tuneable moiré band structure. Furthermore, we show that the AB--AB and AB--BA configurations exhibit a systematic $π$ phase shift in the SHG response at large bias voltages, reflecting their distinct symmetry and electronic structure. Our results identify double-resonance effects as a generic mechanism for enhancing SHG in moiré systems and provide a unified framework for understanding and controlling nonlinear optical responses in tuneable flat-band materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过微扰方法结合有效连续哈密顿量，理论研究了扭转双层石墨烯（TDBG）中AB-AB和AB-BA两种堆叠构型的二次谐波产生（SHG）。发现小扭转角下SHG信号显著增强，并揭示了一种双重共振机制——在莫尔布里渊区扩展区域同时满足ω和2ω的光学跃迁，导致SHG响应大幅放大。此外，两种堆叠构型在大偏压下表现出系统性π相位差。
AI.motivation: 理解并控制可调平带材料中的非线性光学响应，特别是在莫尔体系中探索SHG增强的新机制，为非线性光学在可调谐平带材料中的应用提供统一框架。
AI.method: 采用基于有效连续哈密顿量的微扰理论方法，系统分析了SHG响应随扭转角、垂直偏压、费米能量和堆叠构型的变化规律。
AI.result: 发现小扭转角下SHG信号显著增强（源于莫尔平带和联合态密度增加），并揭示双重共振机制可实现SHG的大幅放大；AB-AB与AB-BA构型在大偏压下的SHG响应存在系统性π相位差。
AI.conclusion: 双重共振效应是莫尔体系中增强SHG的通用机制，为理解和控制可调平带材料的非线性光学响应提供了统一框架。

title: Transient Ferromagnetism in Ultrafast Phase Transitions in Perovskites under XUV Irradiation: A Comparative Study of SrTiO3 and KTaO3
summary: We study ultrafast structural and electronic responses of strontium titanate and potassium tantalate to intense femtosecond irradiation using the XTANT3 multiscale code. It is found that at threshold doses of 0.7 eVatom in STO and 0.9 eVatom in KTO, a superionic state thermally forms with selective melting of the oxygen subsystem while metallic sublattices remain ordered. This state persists up to 1.6 eVatom STO and 1.5 eVatom KTO, above which complete disorder occurs. Analysis of the transient electronic density of states suggests that the B site d orbitals govern the divergent behaviour of the two materials: the compact Ti 3d orbitals in STO produce a narrow conduction band and large intraatomic exchange parameter, driving a transient ferromagnetic instability on 1 ps timescales, whereas the more spatially extended Ta 5d orbitals in KTO yield a broader conduction band and smaller exchange parameter, keeping KTO paramagnetic. These results suggest d orbital spatial extent as a structural parameter that influences phase transition sequences, and magnetic response under extreme electronic excitation, with implications for the ultrafast optical control of electronic and magnetic properties in perovskite based optoelectronic devices. Landau Devonshire analysis shows that irradiation at 0.3 eVatom transiently deepens the polar potential well in unstrained and strained STO and KTO, with the effect amplified approximately 2 fold in strained STO and 6 fold in strained KTO with respect to the unstrained cases.

AI.tldr: 本文利用XTANT3多尺度代码研究了钙钛矿材料钛酸锶(STO)和钽酸钾(KTO)在飞秒级强激光辐射下的超快结构和电子响应。研究发现阈值剂量下两种材料会形成氧亚晶格选择性熔化的超离子态，且B位d轨道空间延展程度决定了二者的磁性响应差异（STO出现瞬态铁磁不稳定性，KTO保持顺磁）。此外，Landau-Devonshire分析表明辐射可瞬态加深极化势阱，且在应变材料中效应被放大。
AI.motivation: 理解钙钛矿材料在强飞秒激光激发下的超快结构相变和电子响应机制，特别是d轨道空间延展程度如何影响相变序列和磁性响应，为基于钙钛矿的光电器件中超快光学控制电子和磁性性质提供理论指导。
AI.method: 采用XTANT3多尺度模拟代码研究飞秒辐射下的结构动力学；通过分析瞬态电子态密度（DOS）研究B位d轨道（Ti 3d与Ta 5d）对能带结构的影响；结合Landau-Devonshire热力学分析评估应变对极化势阱深度的影响。
AI.result: 1) STO和KTO在阈值剂量（分别为0.7和0.9 eV/atom）下形成超离子态，氧亚晶格选择性熔化而金属亚晶格保持有序，该状态持续到1.6 eV/atom (STO)和1.5 eV/atom (KTO)。2) STO中紧凑的Ti 3d轨道产生窄导带和大原子内交换参数，驱动1 ps时间尺度的瞬态铁磁不稳定性；KTO中扩展的Ta 5d轨道产生宽导带和较小交换参数，保持顺磁。3) 辐射在0.3 eV/atom时可瞬态加深极化势阱，应变STO和应变KTO中效应分别放大约2倍和6倍。
AI.conclusion: d轨道空间延展程度是影响钙钛矿在极端电子激发下相变序列和磁性响应的关键结构参数，这为利用超快光学手段调控钙钛矿基光电器件的电子和磁性性质提供了理论基础，也凸显了应变工程在增强超快极化响应中的重要作用。

title: Floquet spin-group framework and its application to light-tailored spin splitting in collinear magnets
summary: Altermagnets combine momentum-dependent spin splitting with vanishing net magnetization, opening new opportunities for spintronics. Recent studies have shown that periodic driving by linearly or circularly polarized light, as well as by multicolor light fields, can control spin splitting in altermagnets and conventional antiferromagnets, and can even generate spin splitting patterns absent in equilibrium. Despite this progress, a unified principle connecting the dynamical symmetry of light to the symmetry of spin-split bands remains lacking, limiting the systematic design of light-induced spin structures. Here, by combining the spin group of crystals with the dynamical group of light, we establish a unified Floquet spin group framework for the study of periodically driven collinear magnets with negligible spin-orbit coupling. This framework systematically determines the allowed parity, momentum dependence, and nodal structure of spin splitting under different driving protocols. Guided by this symmetry classification, we show that odd-parity, even-parity, and mixed-parity spin splittings can be switched within the same material by tailoring the driving field. We further uncover higher-order $h$-wave and $k$-wave spin splittings in three-dimensional systems. Our work establishes a unified symmetry framework for light-controlled spin splitting and provides general principles for engineering nonequilibrium spin-band structures in altermagnets and related magnetic materials.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了一个统一的Floquet自旋群（Floquet spin group）理论框架，将晶体的自旋群与光的动力学群相结合，用于研究周期性驱动的共线磁体中的自旋劈裂现象。该框架系统性地决定了不同光驱动协议下自旋劈裂的宇称、动量依赖性和节点结构，并通过对称性分类展示了在同一材料中可通过调控光场来切换奇宇称、偶宇称和混合宇称的自旋劈裂，还发现了三维系统中的高阶h波和k波自旋劈裂。
AI.motivation: 尽管已有研究表明线偏振、圆偏振及多色光场可以调控交错磁体（altermagnets）和传统反铁磁体中的自旋劈裂，甚至产生平衡态下不存在的自旋劈裂模式，但缺乏一个统一原理将光的动力学对称性与自旋劈裂带的对称性联系起来，这限制了光诱导自旋结构的系统性设计。
AI.method: 将晶体的自旋群（spin group）与光的动力学群（dynamical group）结合，建立了统一的Floquet自旋群框架。该框架基于周期性驱动共线磁体（忽略自旋轨道耦合）的对称性分析，系统地确定了不同驱动协议下自旋劈裂的宇称、动量依赖性和节点结构。
AI.result: 该框架成功指导实现了在同一材料中通过调控光场切换奇宇称、偶宇称和混合宇称自旋劈裂的效果；进一步发现了三维系统中的高阶h波（h-wave）和k波（k-wave）自旋劈裂模式。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了光控自旋劈裂的统一对称性框架，为在交错磁体及相关磁性材料中工程设计非平衡自旋能带结构提供了普适原则。

title: Ab initio High-Pressure Phase Diagrams of Al-Mg Alloys in the Low Solute Concentration Limit
summary: Binary alloy phase diagrams at high pressure are essential for understanding solidification and chemical partitioning in both engineered materials and planetary interiors, yet their experimental determination becomes increasingly challenging under extreme conditions. We apply a fully ab initio approach [J. Chem. Phys. 162, 184502 (2025)], based on density-functional theory, to compute the dilute-limit phase diagram of the Al-Mg system from ambient conditions up to 150 GPa. As a first step, we calculate the melting curves of pure fcc Al and pure hcp/bcc Mg, including the hcp-bcc phase boundary and triple point of Mg, all of which agree closely with available experimental data. The binary phase diagram is then constructed at both compositional extremes. On the Al-rich side, Mg consistently favours the liquid throughout the entire pressure range, with this preference strengthening monotonically under compression. On the Mg-rich side, Al partitions preferentially into the liquid at ambient pressure but undergoes a complete reversal above ~60 GPa, becoming solid-favouring as the Mg host transitions from hcp to bcc. This pressure-driven reversal inverts the topology of the Mg-rich coexistence field from a conventional downward-sloping to an upward-sloping phase boundary, and has direct implications for models of planetary differentiation and interior chemical stratification.

AI.tldr: 本文基于密度泛函理论的完全从头算方法，计算了Al-Mg二元合金从常压到150 GPa的稀溶液极限相图，发现Mg侧Al的分配行为在约60 GPa发生从液相偏好到固相偏好的完全反转，这对行星分异和内部化学分层模型有直接意义。
AI.motivation: 二元合金高压相图对理解工程材料和行星内部的凝固与化学分配至关重要，但极端条件下实验测定越来越困难，因此需要可靠的理论计算方法来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用完全从头算方法（基于密度泛函理论），首先计算纯fcc Al和纯hcp/bcc Mg的熔化曲线、hcp-bcc相界及Mg的三相点，然后分别在Al富集和Mg富集两个组成端构建二元相图。
AI.result: 纯金属熔化曲线与实验数据高度吻合；Al侧Mg在整个压力范围内均倾向液相且随压缩增强；Mg侧Al在常压下偏好液相，但在约60 GPa以上发生完全反转倾向于固相，伴随Mg宿主从hcp向bcc转变。该反转使Mg富集共存场从传统的下倾相界变为上倾拓扑。
AI.conclusion: 压力驱动的分配行为反转改变了Mg富集侧相图拓扑，对行星分异和内部化学分层模型有直接影响，展示了从头算方法在极端条件下预测合金相图的能力。

title: Discrete states and ballistic interference in quantum wires approaching macroscopic lengths
summary: Increasing the size of a system showing quantum effects is a difficult task limited by decoherence, a diminishing quantum level spacing, and the effects of disorder spoiling the quantum behavior when growing in size. Systems in 1D offer very strong confinement in the transverse directions, thus generally enhancing quantum effects, but are notoriously sensitive to disorder. In this work, we present a system of 1D electrons exhibiting discrete quantum levels and fully ballistic coherent quantum interference with lengths of up to 18\,$μ$m. Tunneling spectroscopy between two parallel quantum wires with a central gated segment shows intricate interference patterns exhibiting several different periods in magnetic field and density. An analysis over three different wire lengths and a comparison with single particle numerical simulations without any free parameters remarkably explains the full pattern including the observed periods. Therefore, these wires are essentially ideal 1D systems with aspect ratios approaching 1'000. In addition, at low bias, we also observe not only the Coulomb charging energies but can clearly resolve the discrete orbital and spin states in up to 10\,$μ$m long wires when filling 100 electrons with the center gate. This is made visible by a state-of-the-art low temperature and low noise measurement system. The spin filling sequence is completely regular, strictly alternating spin up and down, avoiding high spin states, while the peak conductance is modulated in accordance with the previously discussed interference patterns. These striking results show that single particle Schrödinger quantum mechanics such as ballistic quantum interference and discrete quantum states may be observed, under the right conditions, in systems of up to 18\,$μ$m length, thus approaching macroscopic sizes.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了一种1D电子系统，在长达18微米的尺度下表现出完全弹道相干量子干涉和分立量子能级。通过隧穿谱学和数值模拟的对比，系统呈现出多周期干涉图案，并且能分辨长达10微米导线中100个电子的分立轨道和自旋态。这证明在适当条件下，单粒子薛定谔量子力学现象可以在接近宏观的尺度上观察到。
AI.motivation: 增大量子系统的尺寸受到退相干、量子能级间距减小和无序效应等限制。虽然1D系统具有强横向约束从而增强量子效应，但对无序非常敏感。作者旨在展示一个接近理想的1D电子系统，在宏观尺度（微米级）上仍能保持完全弹道相干量子行为。
AI.method: 使用两个平行量子线之间的隧穿谱学，中间设有栅控段。在三种不同线长下分析干涉图案，并与无自由参数的单粒子数值模拟进行比较。采用极低温低噪声测量系统，通过自旋填充序列和峰电导调制来揭示量子能级结构。
AI.result: 系统在长达18微米尺度上表现出完全弹道的量子干涉，具有多个磁场和密度周期。数值模拟无需任何自由参数即可完全解释实验干涉图案。在10微米长的导线中填充100个电子时，能清晰分辨分立轨道和自旋态，自旋填充序列严格交替上下，避免高自旋态。
AI.conclusion: 在适当条件下，单粒子薛定谔量子力学现象（如弹道量子干涉和分立量子态）可以在长达18微米的系统中观察到，该系统纵横比接近1000，本质上是理想的1D系统，其尺寸已接近宏观尺度。

title: Polaron-mediated metal-insulator transition and proton conduction in hydrogenated nickelate perovskites
summary: Nickel-based perovskites, owing to their spontaneous hydrogen uptake and the dramatic increase in resistivity upon hydrogenation, have emerged as promising candidates for proton-conducting fuel cell electrolytes. However, the mechanism of the hydrogen-induced metal-insulator transition (MIT) in rare-earth nickelates remains under debate, particularly regarding whether the doped electrons occupy Ni e$_g$ states or O 2p ligand hole states. Here, we reveal a comprehensive MIT mechanism using first-principles calculations on NdNiO$_3$: the electrons introduced by hydrogen doping occupy the O 2p ligand hole states of the Ni-O hybridized d$_8$L configuration, promoting electron-polaron formation. The resulting electron polarons, together with proton polarons, weaken the Ni-O hybridization and thereby drive the originally itinerant Ni e$_g$ electrons toward localization. This generates a local d8 (t$_{2g}$$^6$e$_g$$^2$) electronic configuration, leading to a Mott transition. In addition, we also find that compared with NdNiO$_3$, SmNiO$_3$ with a smaller A-site ionic radius more readily absorbs hydrogen but exhibits weaker proton diffusion capability. Hydrogenation promotes proton permeation along the [001] direction via the intraoctahedral transfer, whereas the overall proton diffusivity is reduced. These results provide guidance for experimental screening of strongly correlated oxides as electrolyte materials and offer theoretical insights for enhancing proton conductivity in rare-earth nickelates.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算，揭示了NdNiO₃中氢掺杂诱导金属-绝缘体转变（MIT）的完整机制：氢掺杂引入的电子占据Ni-O杂化d⁸L构型中的O 2p配体空穴态，促进电子极化子形成，进而与质子极化子共同削弱Ni-O杂化，驱动Ni e_g电子局域化，引发Mott转变。此外还发现SmNiO₃比NdNiO₃更易吸氢但质子扩散能力更弱，为稀土镍酸盐作为电解质材料的筛选提供了理论指导。
AI.motivation: 稀土镍酸盐因自发吸氢及氢化后电阻率急剧增加，有望成为质子导电燃料电池电解质材料，但其氢诱导金属-绝缘体转变机制仍存争议，特别是掺杂电子是占据Ni e_g态还是O 2p配体空穴态尚不明确，亟需澄清。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算，对NdNiO₃进行系统研究，分析氢掺杂后电子占据态、极化子形成、Ni-O杂化变化及电子局域化过程；并对比NdNiO₃与SmNiO₃（不同A位离子半径）的吸氢能力与质子扩散行为。
AI.result: 发现氢掺杂电子占据O 2p配体空穴态并促进电子极化子形成；电子极化子与质子极化子协同削弱Ni-O杂化，使Ni e_g电子局域化，形成局部d⁸电子构型，触发Mott转变。SmNiO₃较NdNiO₃更易吸氢但质子扩散能力较弱；氢化沿[001]方向通过八面体内转移促进质子渗透，但整体质子扩散率降低。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了稀土镍酸盐氢诱导MIT的完整微观机制，为强关联氧化物电解质材料的实验筛选提供了指导，并为提升稀土镍酸盐质子电导率提供了理论见解。

title: Comparison of Lindblad and circuit approaches for quantum heat transport
summary: We compare two popular models applicable to analyzing heat transport by thermal microwave photons in quantum circuits. The first model is derived from a weak-coupling Lindblad master equation, with transition rates determined by Fermi's golden rule induced by thermal dissipation sources. The second approach employs a circuit model, where thermal Johnson-Nyquist noise generated by dissipative elements introduces currents, and consequently Joule power, in other parts of the circuit. This leads to a Landauer type expression of heat transport where the transmission coefficient is proportional to the transconductance in the circuit. We find that the two models yield identical results in a linear circuit in the weak coupling limit with an analytic expression of power in an archetypal circuit of a cavity mediating heat between two baths. Our analysis yields a quantitative assessment of the range of validity of the weak coupling assumption in a circuit. Due to the correspondence of the two results, we feel confident in applying the weak coupling Lindblad model also for analyzing heat transport in quantum circuits consisting, e.g. of qubits and/or non-linear resonators.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了两种用于分析量子电路中热微波光子热输运的模型：一种基于弱耦合Lindblad主方程（费米黄金法则决定跃迁率），另一种基于电路模型（Johnson-Nyquist热噪声驱动的Landauer型表达式）。研究发现两者在线性电路弱耦合极限下产生完全相同的结果，并给出了弱耦合假设有效性的定量评估，从而支持将该模型推广到含有量子比特或非线性谐振器的量子电路分析。
AI.motivation: 在量子电路中研究热微波光子的热输运时，存在两种流行的建模方法（Lindblad主方程方法和电路/噪声方法），但此前不清楚两者是否一致、各自的有效范围如何。作者希望通过明确比较，验证弱耦合Lindblad模型在更复杂量子电路（如含量子比特或非线性谐振器）中的适用性。
AI.method: 1) 建立两种热输运模型：一是基于弱耦合Lindblad主方程，跃迁率由费米黄金法则确定；二是基于电路模型，利用耗散元件的Johnson-Nyquist热噪声诱导电流和焦耳功率，得到Landauer型热输运表达式（透射系数正比于跨导）。2) 在一个典型电路（腔作为两个热浴之间的热中介）中进行解析推导和对比。3) 定量评估弱耦合假设在电路中的有效范围。
AI.result: 在线性电路的弱耦合极限下，两种模型给出了完全相同的结果，并在典型腔中介电路中得到功率的解析表达式。分析还给出了弱耦合假设有效性的定量评估。
AI.conclusion: 由于两种方法结果一致，作者对将弱耦合Lindblad模型推广应用于更复杂的量子电路（如含量子比特和/或非线性谐振器）的热输运分析充满信心。

title: Second-Harmonic Imaging of Magnetic Domains in Thin Film Hematite
comment: 26 pages, 13 figures; First two authors contributed equally to this work
summary: Hematite is an antiferromagnetic oxide and candidate altermagnetic insulator whose Néel order reorients from an easy-axis to an easy-plane phase at the Morin transition.
