Interpreting altermagnetic transport and symmetry sensitive optical responses requires knowledge of the Néel vector orientation relative to the crystal axes and of the domain structure within the probed device. Here, we show that polarization-resolved second-harmonic generation (SHG) microscopy resolves magnetic symmetry and domains in epitaxial (0001)-oriented hematite films. Across the Morin temperature, the SHG polarization anisotropy evolves from an approximately sixfold pattern consistent with the easy-axis orientation to pronounced twofold patterns consistent with the easy-plane orientation. A symmetry analysis based on magnetic-dipole and electric-quadrupole contributions reproduces this evolution. Importantly, the interference between SHG amplitudes that are odd and even under reversal of the magnetic order renders opposite Néel-vector orientations optically distinguishable. Consistently, opposite directions of an applied in-plane magnetic field produce distinct SHG responses in our experiments. Using this magnetic contrast, we image micrometer-scale domains, their reorganization across the Morin transition, and their reconfiguration under magnetic and thermal cycling, including a remanent change after cycling through the spin-flop transition. These results establish SHG microscopy as a local probe of magnetic symmetry, Néel-vector orientation, and domain evolution in hematite films.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了偏振分辨二次谐波(SHG)显微术可以作为赤铁矿薄膜中磁对称性、Néel矢量取向和磁畴演化的局部探针，能够区分相反Néel矢量方向并追踪Morin相变及磁场/热循环下的畴重构。
AI.motivation: 赤铁矿是候选的交变磁性绝缘体，其Néel序在Morin转变处从易轴相重定向到易面相。解释交变磁输运和对称敏感光学响应需要了解Néel矢量相对于晶轴的方向以及探测器件内的畴结构，但目前缺乏有效的局部探测手段。
AI.method: 使用偏振分辨SHG显微术对(0001)取向的外延赤铁矿薄膜进行研究；基于磁偶极和电四极贡献进行对称性分析以复现SHG偏振各向异性随温度的变化；利用对磁序反转呈奇偶不对称的SHG振幅干涉来区分相反Néel矢量方向，并结合外加磁场进行验证。
AI.result: SHG偏振各向异性在Morin温度以下呈现约六重图案（对应易轴取向），以上转变为明显的二重图案（对应易面取向）。相反的Néel矢量方向在光学上可区分，外加反向面内磁场产生不同的SHG响应。利用该磁对比度成功成像了微米尺度畴、跟踪了Morin转变处的畴重组以及磁场和热循环下的畴重构，包括自旋翻转转变后观察到的残余变化。
AI.conclusion: SHG显微术被确立为赤铁矿薄膜中磁对称性、Néel矢量取向和畴演化的局部探针，为研究交变磁性材料提供了有力的实验工具。

title: Strain engineering of transient exciton diffusion in WSe2 monolayers at cryogenic temperatures
summary: Tungsten-based transition metal dichalcogenides exhibit dark excitons as the energetically lowest states. These are crucial for exciton thermalization and propagation and they dominate low-temperature photoluminescence via the emergence of pronounced phonon sidebands. After a resonant excitation, highly mobile hot dark excitons are formed, which quickly thermalize into an equilibrium distribution. The application of strain modifies the exciton energy landscape and, in particular, the relative energy separation between bright and dark exciton states. The impact of strain on the transient photoluminescence and diffusion of non-equilibrium excitons has remained largely unexplored so far. In this work, we investigate the spatiotemporal exciton dynamics in strained hBN-encapsulated WSe2 monolayers at cryogenic temperatures. We demonstrate that tensile strain abruptly increases the excess energy of hot excitons, thereby accelerating their transient diffusion. We trace this back to suppressed phonon-mediated scattering from bright to dark excitons. Furthermore, we predict a periodic modulation of the transient exciton diffusion in the presence of a compressive strain resulting from strain-driven emission of M phonons. The gained microscopic insights illustrate how strain can be used to engineer transient photoluminescence and exciton diffusion in technologically promising 2D semiconductors.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了应变对hBN封装WSe2单层中非平衡激子时空动力学的影响，发现拉伸应变会增大热激子的过剩能量从而加速其瞬态扩散，压缩应变则通过M声子发射引起瞬态激子扩散的周期性调制。
AI.motivation: 钨基过渡金属二硫化物中暗激子是最低能量态，对激子热化、传播以及低温光致发光至关重要。应变可以调控明暗激子之间的能级分离，但其对非平衡激子的瞬态光致发光和扩散的影响此前尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 在低温条件下对hBN封装的WSe2单层施加应变，研究拉伸和压缩应变作用下激子的时空动力学，通过瞬态光致发光和扩散测量分析激子行为，并结合声子介导散射的微观机制进行解释。
AI.result: 发现拉伸应变会急剧增加热激子的过剩能量，从而加速其瞬态扩散，这归因于明暗激子间声子介导散射被抑制；压缩应变下预测会出现由应变驱动的M声子发射导致的瞬态激子扩散周期性调制。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了应变可作为调控二维半导体瞬态光致发光和激子扩散的有效工程手段，为技术上极具前景的2D半导体应用提供了微观层面的理解和指导。

title: Thermal Stability of Two-Dimensional Crystals with Extended OH Hydrogen-Bonded Chains
summary: Numerical simulations of the dynamics of monolayer structures of molecules deposited on a sheet of hexagonal boron nitride (h-BN) have been performed. It is shown that molecules containing benzene rings and hydroxyl groups in their structure can form stable two-dimensional crystals with linear chains of hydrogen bonds OH$\cdots$OH$\cdots$OH$\cdots$ Such structures are formed by the following molecules: phenol (C$_6$H$_5$OH), hydroquinone (C$_6$H$_4$(OH)$_2$), 4-phenylphenol (C$_6$H$_5$--C$_6$H$_4$OH), 4-(4-phenylphenyl)phenol (C$_6$H$_5$--C$_6$H$_4$--C$_6$H$_4$OH), paracetamol (CH$_3$C(O)NHC$_6$H$_4$OH), 4-hydroxybenzanilide (C$_6$H$_5$C(O)NHC$_6$H$_4$OH) and 4,4-dihydroxybenzanilide (C$_6$H$_4$OHC(O)NHC$_6$H$_4$OH). On the one hand, the benzene rings in these molecules ensure their strong interaction with the flat substrate; on the other hand, they do not hinder the formation of extended hydrogen-bonded chains. The monolayer structures of these molecules exhibit high thermal stability: the onset melting temperatures of their 2D crystals are 47, 187, 127, 247, 167, 307, and 377 $^\circ$C, respectively. The simulations allow us to conclude that multilayer structures composed of h-BN sheets and molecules of hydroquinone, paracetamol, and 4-hydroxybenzanilide can be used for the development of novel proton-exchange membranes capable of operating at elevated temperatures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过数值模拟研究了沉积在六方氮化硼(h-BN)基底上的分子单层结构动力学，发现含苯环和羟基的分子（如苯酚、对苯二酚等七种分子）可通过OH⋯OH线性氢键链形成稳定的二维晶体。这些单层结构具有高热稳定性，起始熔融温度从47°C到377°C不等。模拟结果表明，由h-BN片层与对苯二酚、扑热息痛和4-羟基苯甲酰苯胺分子组成的多层结构可用于开发能在高温下运行的质子交换膜。
AI.motivation: 探索在h-BN基底上形成稳定二维分子晶体的可能性，并评估这类分子/基底复合多层结构作为高温质子交换膜材料的潜力，以满足燃料电池等在高温下运行的需求。
AI.method: 采用数值模拟方法，对沉积在h-BN单层上的多种含苯环和羟基的有机分子（苯酚、对苯二酚、4-苯基苯酚、4-(4-苯基苯基)苯酚、扑热息痛、4-羟基苯甲酰苯胺、4,4-二羟基苯甲酰苯胺）进行单层结构动力学模拟，研究其二维晶体形成、氢键网络结构及热稳定性（起始熔融温度）。
AI.result: 七种目标分子均能在h-BN基底上通过OH⋯OH线性氢键链形成稳定的二维晶体。苯环确保分子与平面基底强相互作用的同时不阻碍氢键链延伸。各分子二维晶体的起始熔融温度分别为：苯酚47°C、对苯二酚187°C、4-苯基苯酚127°C、4-(4-苯基苯基)苯酚247°C、扑热息痛167°C、4-羟基苯甲酰苯胺307°C、4,4-二羟基苯甲酰苯胺377°C。
AI.conclusion: h-BN与对苯二酚、扑热息痛和4-羟基苯甲酰苯胺构成的多层复合结构可作为高温质子交换膜材料，具有实际应用前景。

title: GRADAR: orientation-map-driven detection and ranking of grains for targeted two-beam electron channeling contrast imaging
summary: Electron channeling contrast imaging (ECCI) resolves individual dislocations in bulk samples, but only when the imaged grain is held in a two-beam diffraction condition to well under half a degree. In a polycrystal it must be re-established grain by grain, and every published workflow we are aware of chooses the grain first and solves the stage for that orientation. This paper treats the inverse problem: nominate one reflection family and a stage envelope, and determine which grains of an EBSD-mapped polycrystal can reach that family's two-beam condition, a question posed in 2019 and open since. At fixed tilt $t$, stage rotation sweeps the incident beam around a cone of half-angle $t$ in each grain's crystal frame, and a family with Bragg angle $θ_B$ is reachable exactly when one of its plane normals lies within $(t + θ_B)$ of the specimen surface. On a measured 163-grain austenitic stainless steel map at 20 kV, {111} reachability rises from 38.7% at 7 deg tilt to 77.3% at 15 deg; {220} and {311} already reach 79.8% and 91.4% at 7 deg. Ranking survivors by predicted darkness alone is wrong: same-family candidates are equivalent with respect to their own band at exact Bragg incidence, and the darkest tend to lie closest to rival-band Bragg conditions. GRADAR therefore ranks darkest-clean, gating every candidate on a minimum clearance from all rivals, and returns a dial-ready stage move per selected grain. Because the beam moves only ~0.12 deg per degree of stage rotation at 7 deg tilt, an ordinary rotation stage sets the selected condition to better than 0.1 deg. The predicted sweep is checked against the AstroECP dataset's published silicon precession series: simulated and measured traces agree at r = 0.84, and the measured intensity is dark at all 16 predicted two-beam edges. Per-grain polycrystal validation is deferred to a companion study.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GRADAR方法，解决多晶材料中电子通道衬度成像（ECCI）的逆问题：在给定反射族和载物台倾转范围下，预测EBSD图中哪些晶粒能达到两束衍射条件。在163晶粒奥氏体不锈钢中，{111}在7°倾转时可达率38.7%，15°时升至77.3%；方法通过"最暗-最干净"排序和最小间隙门控来消除竞争带干扰，并能输出可直接用于载物台的旋转步骤。模拟与实验硅数据吻合良好（r=0.84）。
AI.motivation: ECCI成像需要晶粒精确对准两束衍射条件（精度优于半度），在多晶材料中每个晶粒都需要重新调整。现有工作流都是先选晶粒再解算载物台姿态，但2019年以来一直悬而未决的逆问题——给定反射族和载物台范围，哪些晶粒能达到两束条件——从未被系统解决。
AI.method: 核心洞察：在固定倾转角t下，载物台旋转使入射束在晶粒晶体坐标系中扫过一个半角为t的锥面。当某晶面族的一个面法线落在距样品表面(t+θ_B)范围内时，该族即可达两束条件。GRADAR算法：先确定所有可达晶粒，再对同族候选按"最暗-最干净"排序——因为同族候选在其自身布拉格带内等效，最暗者往往最接近竞争带的布拉格条件，因此需设定最小间隙阈值排除竞争带干扰，最后为每个选中晶粒输出可直接执行的载物台旋转步骤。
AI.result: 在20 kV下163晶粒奥氏体不锈钢的EBSD图中：{111}可达率从7°倾转的38.7%升至15°的77.3%；{220}和{311}在7°时即达79.8%和91.4%。7°倾转时载物台每旋转1°仅使束移动约0.12°，普通旋转台可实现优于0.1°的对准精度。在AstroECP硅数据集上模拟与实测轨迹r=0.84，16个预测两束边缘实测强度均为暗。
AI.conclusion: GRADAR成功解决了多晶ECCI的可达性预测问题，实现了从"先选晶粒再调台"到"给定条件预测晶粒"的范式反转，为高通量多晶ECCI成像提供了实用工具，可有效提升实验效率和晶粒筛选精度。

title: Magnetic Skyrmion Interacting with Optical Skyrmion
summary: Magnetic skyrmions (MSks) and optical skyrmions (OSks) embody topology in matter and in light, respectively. Here we investigate the interaction between a single MSk and an OSk beam. Three distinct nonlinear dynamical modes are identified: rotation, skipping, and trochoidal motion. By decomposing the optical driving force into gradient, orbital-angular-momentum, and spin-angular-momentum contributions, we clarify their respective roles of radial confinement, azimuthal drift, and precessional modulation. The skipping motion arises from the azimuthal asymmetry of the OSk beam and exhibits spatial selectivity originating from the magnetization-polarization coupling between the MSk and OSk. In three dimensions, the coupling acquires a propagation-dependent phase dominated by the differential Gouy phase, which yields $z$-asymmetric skipping trajectories. These results bridge topological particles and topological fields within a unified framework, offering helicity-selective and phase-programmable routes to optomagnonic control.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了磁性斯格明子（MSk）与光学斯格明子（OSk）光束之间的相互作用，发现了三种非线性动力学模式：旋转、跳跃和轮滚运动。通过将光驱动力分解为梯度、轨道角动量和自旋角动量贡献，阐明了它们在径向约束、方位漂移和进动调制中的各自作用，并提出了一种统一的拓扑粒子-拓扑场耦合框架。
AI.motivation: 磁性斯格明子和光学斯格明子分别在物质和光中体现拓扑性，但二者之间的相互作用尚未被系统研究。该工作旨在搭建拓扑粒子与拓扑场之间的桥梁，探索利用OSk光束对MSk进行拓扑控制的物理机制。
AI.method: 作者研究了单个MSk与OSk光束的相互作用，通过将光驱动力分解为梯度力、轨道角动量（OAM）力和自旋角动量（SAM）力三个分量，分别对应径向约束、方位漂移和进动调制。进一步分析三维情况下的传播依赖相位（主要由差分Gouy相位主导），揭示z不对称的跳跃轨迹。
AI.result: 识别出三种不同的非线性动力学模式：旋转、跳跃和轮滚运动。跳跃运动源于OSk光束的方位不对称性，并表现出由MSk-OSk磁化-偏振耦合产生的空间选择性。三维耦合呈现由差分Gouy相位主导的传播依赖相位，产生z不对称跳跃轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 该工作在一个统一框架内桥接了拓扑粒子和拓扑场，为光磁子（optomagnonic）控制提供了螺旋度选择性和相位可编程的途径，具有潜在的应用价值。

title: Magnetically tunable symmetry-enforced nodal lines producing huge anomalous Hall conductivity in altermagnetic $α$-MnTe
summary: Altermagnetic $α$-MnTe exhibits huge anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC) up to room-temperature together with weak ferromagnetism arising from spin and orbital polarizations. We clarify the origin of the large value of the AHC by identifying two sets of distinct symmetry-enforced nodal lines in the valence bands with Mn character, located at $k_z=0$ and $k_z=\fracπ{c}$, protected by mirror symmetry $M_z$ and glide symmetry $G_z = \{M_z\,|\,0,0,\tfrac{c}{2}\}$, respectively. Both nodal lines are energy-dependent with an approximate C$_6$ symmetry, which is reduced to an exact C$_2$ symmetry due to the presence of the Néel vector. The highest valence band exhibits a Mexican-hat dispersion, whereas the second-highest valence band exhibits an inverted Mexican-hat dispersion, with nodal lines at the crossing between the two bands. Within first-principles accuracy, we demonstrate that these nodal lines give rise to the large AHC observed experimentally and exhibit a strong interplay with the weak ferromagnetism. We further show that even a small spin canting strongly modifies the nodal lines and the AHC, making them both magnetically tunable. By disentangling the altermagnetic and ferromagnetic contributions to the AHC, the altermagnetic contribution dominates at small canting angles, while the ferromagnetic contribution becomes sizeable for larger values. Using linear dichroism in angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, we show a signature of the nodal line at the border of the Brillouin zone.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算，阐明了交替磁体α-MnTe中巨大反常霍尔电导（AHC）的微观起源——即由镜面对称M_z和滑移对称G_z保护的两组能带节点线，这些节点线与弱铁磁性存在强耦合，且可通过自旋倾斜进行磁调控。
AI.motivation: α-MnTe作为交替磁体，在室温附近展现出巨大反常霍尔电导和弱铁磁性，但其大AHC的微观起源尚不清楚。理解该起源对于交替磁体的基础研究和潜在自旋电子学应用至关重要。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算，系统分析α-MnTe价带中的对称性保护节点线结构；通过识别k_z=0处由镜面M_z保护和k_z=π/c处由滑移对称G_z保护的两组节点线，分析其能量依赖性和C6/C2对称性；结合自旋和轨道极化分析，分解交替磁性与铁磁性对AHC的贡献，并通过线性二色角分辨光电子能谱验证节点线特征。
AI.result: 发现两组对称性强制的节点线分别位于k_z=0和k_z=π/c，对应最高价带的墨西哥帽色散和第二高价带的反向墨西哥帽色散间的交叉。节点线对AHC的大小起决定性作用，并与弱铁磁性存在强相互作用。即使很小的自旋倾斜也会显著改变节点线和AHC，使其可磁调控。在小倾斜角下交替磁贡献占主导，大倾斜角下铁磁贡献变得可观。
AI.conclusion: α-MnTe的巨大AHC起源于对称性强制的节点线结构，这些节点线可通过磁矩倾斜进行有效调控，其中交替磁贡献在多数情况下占主导。线性二色角分辨光电子能谱提供了节点线在布里渊区边界的可观测特征。

title: Real-time dynamics of the two-step charge-density-wave transition in bulk 1T-TaS$_2$
summary: The charge-density wave (CDW) of bulk 1T-TaS2 is built from Star-of-David (SoD) clusters tiling a sqrt{13} x sqrt{13} superlattice, and it melts through a two-step sequence accompanied by order-of-magnitude changes in resistivity. Whether these steps proceed by collapse of the SoD amplitude or by rearrangement of the SoD lattice has remained unresolved, because the relevant dynamics occur on length and time scales beyond the reach of ab initio molecular dynamics. Here we follow the CDW transitions in real time using a machine-learning force field trained on first-principles data, giving access to 1404-atom supercells over 5 ns. The two steps are mechanistically distinct. Above 200 K, SoD clusters translate coherently by transiently dissolving and re-forming about shifted centers, a deformation-formation process that preserves the local SoD amplitude while randomizing the interlayer stacking order and nucleating domain walls. Only near 350 K does the SoD distortion itself collapse. These results provide microscopic support for the recently proposed two-step model of the CDW transition and offer a framework for interpreting light-induced hidden phases and cavity-modified transition temperatures in 1T-TaS2.

AI.tldr: 本文利用基于第一性原理数据训练的机器学习力场，对1404原子超胞进行长达5纳秒的实时模拟，揭示了1T-TaS2中电荷密度波（CDW）两步熔化转变的微观机制：200K以上时SoD团簇通过"变形-再形成"过程相干平移（保持局部SoD振幅但随机化层间堆叠），仅在350K附近SoD畸变本身才发生坍缩。
AI.motivation: 块体1T-TaS2的CDW由Star-of-David (SoD)团簇构成√13×√13超晶格，其熔化经历两步过程并伴随电阻率的数量级变化。关键问题是这两步转变究竟是SoD振幅的坍缩还是SoD晶格的重排主导，但由于相关动力学发生在超越从头算分子动力学能力的时间和空间尺度上，这一问题长期悬而未决。
AI.method: 训练一个基于第一性原理数据（ab initio）的机器学习力场（machine-learning force field），利用该力场对包含1404个原子的超胞进行长达5纳秒的实时模拟，从而在时间和长度尺度上成功追踪CDW转变过程。
AI.result: 发现两步转变机制截然不同：(1) 200K以上，SoD团簇通过瞬态溶解并在移动的中心处重新形成来实现相干平移，该"变形-形成"（deformation-formation）过程保持局部SoD振幅不变，但会随机化层间堆叠顺序并成核畴壁；(2) 只有在接近350K时，SoD畸变本身才发生坍缩。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果为最近提出的CDW转变两步模型提供了微观层面的支持，并为解释1T-TaS2中光诱导的隐藏相和腔修饰转变温度提供了框架。

title: Revealing Intrinsic Anisotropy of Collective Magnetic Excitations in Twinned Crystals of a Kitaev-Heisenberg Quantum Magnet
summary: Quantum magnets with competing interactions often emerge from delicate balances among microscopic parameters, making it essential to disentangle intrinsic spin dynamics from extrinsic disorder effects. Here, we introduce a multimodal optical approach combining magneto-infrared spectroscopy with domain-resolved micro-Raman spectroscopy at high magnetic fields to reconstruct the intrinsic magnetic excitation spectrum of twinned crystals of the Kitaev-Heisenberg quantum magnet Na$_3$Co$_2$SbO$_6$. Far-infrared spectroscopy reveals multiple field-tunable magnetic excitations, but the intrinsic response is obscured by replica features arising from twin domains. By correlating magneto-infrared and domain-resolved Raman spectra, we isolate the single-domain magnon response and uncover a pronounced twofold in-plane magnon anisotropy. This anisotropy far exceeds that expected from the measured in-plane g-factor anisotropy and is instead dominated by anisotropic bond-dependent exchange interactions. By unifying high-field, high-resolution and spatially selective optical probes, our work establishes a broadly applicable framework for revealing intrinsic spin dynamics and constraining the spin Hamiltonian in multidomain quantum magnets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多模态光学方法，结合磁红外光谱与高磁场下的域分辨显微拉曼光谱，成功从孪晶Na₃Co₂SbO₆中分离出本征磁激发谱，揭示由各向异性键依赖交换作用主导的面内磁振子各向异性，为多畴量子磁体的自旋哈密顿量约束提供了通用框架。
AI.motivation: 具有竞争相互作用的量子磁体常源于微观参数的微妙平衡，其固有自旋动力学常被外禀无序效应（如孪晶畴）掩盖。需要一种能够区分本征自旋动力学与外禀无序效应的方法。
AI.method: 结合两种光学探测手段：磁红外光谱（远红外区）观测多个场可调磁激发，以及高磁场下域分辨显微拉曼光谱。通过将二者的谱学数据进行关联，剔除孪晶畴产生的复制特征，从而重建单畴磁振子响应。
AI.result: 发现面内磁振子存在显著的二重各向异性，该各向异性远超由面内g因子各向异性所预期的值，表明其主要来源于各向异性的键依赖交换相互作用，而非朗德因子效应。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了将高场、高分辨与空间选择性光学探针统一起来的通用框架，可用于揭示多畴量子磁体的本征自旋动力学并约束其自旋哈密顿量。
